chapters.title: Chapter 1351: The Lotus Two Souls
paragraphs: "Zhang Fei, we are the souls of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus." The first man answered Zhang Fei, and his appearance looked calm and serene, with a calming aura. "My name is Yang Lianhua."
The second person looked like a female demon, but she was not literally a demon either. "My name is Yin Lianhua, and we have been waiting for your arrival for a long time, Zhang Fei."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked at them suspiciously. "Why are you two waiting for me?"
"We are waiting for you because you are the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Both of them replied.
Zhang Fei frowned. "Did the old fox ask you two to wait for me?"
"No." Both of them shook their heads at Zhang Fei. "We have never met the ten-tailed fox, nor do we have any connection with him."
"Then?"

"We knew about you from something else, but we couldn’t explain anything to you." Both people moved to either side of Zhang Fei and pointed ahead. "People from the past called this domain the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, the home of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus."
"What exactly is the Yin-Yang Lotus? How could it be born in this domain?"

"The giant Yin-Yang Lotus is the embodiment of Yin and Yang in this universe." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows, gazing at the distant lotus and the gathered crowd around it. "Besides the lotus, there is one living being that was born from Yin and Yang, and he—"
"My predecessor, the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
"That’s right." They nodded in response.

Yang Lianhua then spoke. "Therefore, we waited for you to come here because you are his successor, and you will become the second living being to have a direct connection to Yin and Yang, especially after you evolve into the ten-tailed fox and inherit all his abilities."
Even though he had accepted that, Zhang Fei chose not to say anything about it. "Then, what was the use of this monastery in the past?"
"In the past, this monastery served as a link between the two worlds created by the giant Yin-Yang Lotus." Yin Lianhua answered.
"Two worlds?"
Yang Lianhua answered Zhang Fei directly. "The first world was born from Yang, and we call it the Lotus Luminous World."
"The second world was born from Yin, and we call it the Lotus Limbo World." Yin Lianhua added.

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "I’ve heard of the Lotus Limbo World, but I’ve never heard of the Lotus Luminous World. Moreover, someone told me that the Lotus Limbo World was created by one of the hidden powers in this universe as a prison, so the hidden power she meant was the giant Yin-Yang Lotus itself, right?"
"That’s right." Both of them nodded at Zhang Fei. "As we said before, the giant Yin-Yang Lotus is the embodiment of Yin and Yang in this universe, so it is indeed a part of them."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "So, what’s the Lotus Luminous World like?"

"Unlike the gloomy Lotus Limbo World, the Lotus Luminous World is much more cheerful and lively." Since he had never been to either place, Zhang Fei couldn’t imagine them, but he already had an idea of the former from Feng Yao’s story. "The Lotus Luminous World is a place where enlightened souls live, free from doubt and despair. They have the opportunity to be reincarnated, but they choose not to take that chance; instead, they prefer to live in that place because it is free from evil, burdens, and worldly emotions."
"The world without evil, burdens, and worldly emotions, huh? Does such a place really exist?" Zhang Fei softly muttered.
"The Luminous Lotus World truly exists, and the lotus is the gateway to both places."

Zhang Fei simply nodded to Yang Lianhua before asking again. "If both worlds were created by the Yin-Yang Lotus, doesn’t that mean they aren’t real worlds? They exist because of the lotus, and they will disappear if the lotus disappears, right?"

"You’re wrong about that." Yin Lianhua’s answer confused Zhang Fei. "The Lotus Limbo World and the Lotus Luminous World exist because of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, but they are still real worlds separate from this universe."

"If these two worlds are separate from this universe, how can the souls of living beings enter them?" Zhang Fei was truly confused by this because Feng Yao had once told him that the Lotus Limbo World was a prison for those who tried to defy the wheel of reincarnation, so he felt that it didn’t make sense for the two worlds to be separate from the universe.

"We are indeed the souls of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, but we don’t possess that much knowledge, so we have no answer to your question." Yang Lianhua’s answer disappointed Zhang Fei. "Anyways, a disturbance in the balance between Yin and Yang occurred long ago, and that event destroyed everything in this domain."
"How could a disturbance in the balance between Yin and Yang occur?" Zhang Fei asked in shock.
Yin Lianhua sighed softly. "We don’t know what happened at that time because we weren’t born yet, and we were born after the incident at that time."

"After that incident, the giant Yin-Yang Lotus gave birth to the two of us to maintain the balance between Yin and Yang. Everything went smoothly, and Yin and Yang became balanced again to this day. Unfortunately, the lotus continued to weaken, which also affected us. We wouldn’t be able to maintain that balance if we became too weak." Zhang Fei turned to Yang Lianhua. "If that happens, the balance between Yin and Yang will completely disappear, and this universe will be destroyed."

Yin Lianhua spoke again. "The only one who can help us restore the balance is Hu Tianlang, but he has long been dead. Since you are his successor, you are our only hope now. Unfortunately, you haven’t yet gained all of your predecessor’s power, so you can’t help us yet."

"I know that." Zhang Fei naturally knew the limits of his strength, and he asked them another question. "You two didn’t appear in front of me today just for small talk, did you? So, what can I do to strengthen the giant Yin-Yang Lotus?"

"You haven’t reached the level of your predecessors, but the Yang in your body is very high when compared with other male living beings, and you also have several women with high Yin in their bodies." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow at the two. "We hope all of you will be willing to help us strengthen the lotus with Yin and Yang in your bodies."
"How can we do that?"

"All of you only need to carry out dual-soul cultivation by uniting the white and black lotuses in your souls to form the true Yin-Yang Lotus, which is the embodiment of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus." Yang Lianhua’s reply shocked Zhang Fei again. "If you do that, the giant Yin-Yang Lotus will continue to gain your Yin and Yang, which will slowly strengthen it. If the lotus becomes strong again, both of us will also become strong, and we can maintain the balance."

Zhang Fei looked at them in thought. "If you two put it like that, the giant Ying-Yang Lotus intentionally created the Lotus Forbidden Codex, and you two gave it to Qing Qiu’er when she accidentally stepped into this domain."

"So many people have entered this domain in the past, including the ancestors of the Luo Clan. Unfortunately, none of them managed to encounter the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, and Qing Qiu’er was the first to do so." Zhang Fei nodded several times as he listened to them. "Since she managed to meet the lotus at that time, we brought her into the lotus and imparted the Lotus Forbidden Codex to her, and we hoped she would find the right person to be her partner. In the end, our hopes were not in vain because she met you, and the two of you became a couple."

"I guess this is all the work of fate. In the past, I was born as an ordinary human, and I didn’t know about cultivation or anything like that." Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh as he looked off into the distance. "However, my life changed drastically on that fateful day, especially after that young girl accidentally killed me. She killed me, but she also repressed me, and she gave me a gift that changed me into what I am today. Without all that, I would never have met Qing Qiu’er, and your hopes would have ended in vain."
"Yes."

Zhang Fei looked at the two of them again. "I can’t promise you anything, but I will try my best to help you by cultivating dual souls with all my wives as usual, and I hope our efforts will be enough to prevent the lotus from weakening."
"Thank you."

"No need." Zhang Fei shook his head slightly. "I agreed to help you not because you asked, but for myself and the people around me. If the balance between Yin and Yang disappears, this universe will perish, and I don’t want us to die just like that."
Both of them nodded to Zhang Fei. "For now, this is all we can share with you, and we must return to the lotus, so we will return you to your body now."
"Alright." Slowly the area faded from Zhang Fei’s sight.
When Zhang Fei opened his eyes, Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan immediately questioned him. "Are you okay, husband? What happened to you just now?"

"I’m fine." Zhang Fei kissed Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan in turn. "I’ve seen the ancient civilization in this domain before, and this place used to be beautiful without any problems. No virtue and no evil; all inhabitants lived side by side in peace and harmony. Unfortunately, a disturbance occurred in the balance of Yin and Yang, which destroyed this domain and killed all its inhabitants, leaving only ruins of their golden era."

"Actually, the old fox has already told us more or less about this Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, and the monastery used to be the hub that connected this domain with the two worlds created by the giant Yin-Yang Lotus." Zhang Fei nodded at Luo Yunxiao and led them to go to the first building. "What else did you see besides that?"

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh before telling Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan about his previous conversation with Yang Lianhua and Yin Lianhua. But what shocked them most was the fact that the giant Yin-Yang Lotus created the Forbidden Lotus Codex, and its two spirits intentionally gave the technique to Qing Qiu’er. "For now, we have no choice but to strengthen the lotus by dual-soul cultivating as usual, but we must do so by forming the true Yin-Yang Lotus."

"Husband, I think the lotus will take a long time to become strong, especially if you rely solely on us for dual-soul cultivation. I don’t mean to jinx it, but the situation will be even more dire if another disturbance occurs to Yin and Yang, and the balance will be completely destroyed because the lotus is too weak." Zhang Fei looked at Jia Yuyan as if he understood her idea. "The best option is to share the Forbidden Lotus Codex with everyone around us, especially those who already have a partner."

"I agree with Sister Yuyan, Husband." Luo Yunxiao nodded slightly. "Those men’s yang qi may not be as strong as yours, and those women’s yin qi may not be as powerful as mine or some of my sisters’, but it’s a lot better than nothing at all, right? If more people engage in dual-soul cultivation using the Forbidden Lotus Codex, I am confident that the lotus will strengthen more quickly, allowing us to prevent the destruction of the balance between Yin and Yang in this universe."

Zhang Fei naturally understood that, but he was also selfish. The Forbidden Lotus Codex was their main dual-soul cultivation technique, and he was reluctant to share it with anyone apart from his wives. "You two are right; that option is the best for now, especially since I still don’t have another solution to strengthen the lotus. After we go back, I will share the technique with them, so their soul power will also strengthen faster, and they will be safer from soul attacks. By the way, where did the others go?"
"Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin checked the western area, while Qing Qiu’er and Nalan Wangzi checked the eastern area."

After hearing that, Zhang Fei opened the map again. Unlike before, he could see every area of the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, including the locations of those who entered it with him. Since the map didn’t show any red dots, he didn’t worry about them.

From the map, Zhang Fei saw that Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were already approaching Luo Shiwen’s location. Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu, who had previously left with them, was at another location, where the giant Yin-Yang Lotus was located. ’How did she get lost in that place?’
When they entered the first hall, they only saw rubble and traces of broken furniture, and the place was also filled with grass and overgrown vegetation.
"Do you know where my parents went, husband?"

"There." Zhang Fei pointed to one of the passages in the first hall. "I’m not sure what’s in that area, but I’m sure this domain isn’t dangerous. Luo Shiwen is also in that area, and my parents-in-law are already close to his location."
Luo Yunxiao immediately walked towards it. "I will follow my parents first, husband."
"Are there any interesting places in this monastery, husband?" Jia Yuyan curiously asked.

"I can’t say for sure, and we’ll have to look around the area first to be certain." Mei suddenly told Zhang Fei something, and he spoke to Jia Yuyan again. "It seems like there’s something interesting in the western wing, so you can go there if you’re curious about that."
Jia Yuyan looked in that direction while thinking. "I’ll check that area now, and you can check the other areas, so we won’t waste too much time in these ruins."
After Jia Yuyan left, Zhang Fei hurried to the inner sanctum, where the giant Ying-Yang Lotus was located.
When he arrived there, Zhang Fei found Qi Qingxiu standing in thought in front of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus. "What are you thinking about, Qingxiu?"

"I’m not thinking about anything, and I’m just admiring this lotus." Qi Qingxiu turned to Zhang Fei, who was already standing beside her. "This lotus is exactly the same as the one you formed with Qing Qiu’er earlier, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Our soul cultivation technique was created by this lotus, so this lotus is the original Yin-Yang Lotus."
"Eh? How could this lotus create such a technique?" Qi Qingxiu asked in surprise and confusion.

"Didn’t you listen to old fox’s explanation earlier?" Qi Qingxiu shook her head at Zhang Fei, as she had already left before Luo Yunxiao asked Hu Tianlang to leave his soul world. "This lotus is not an ordinary lotus, okay? It is the embodiment of Yin and Yang in our universe, and its existence is more special than ours. This lotus not only created the technique, but it also created two different worlds that are directly connected to it. The first world is the Lotus Luminous World, where evil, burdens, and worldly emotions do not exist. The second world is the Lotus Limbo World, which is the prison of fallen souls who failed to defy the wheel of reincarnation."
"The world without evil, burdens, and worldly emotions, huh?" Qi Qingxiu muttered under her breath while looking at the lotus. "Does such a place really exist?"

"It does." Zhang Fei gave a light nod. "Old fox has been to both worlds in the past, and Feng Yao said that she saw the Lotus Limbo World when she entered the reincarnation circle. Therefore, I believe the Lotus Luminous World really exists, and I want to go there someday."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "If there really is no evil in the Lotus Luminous World, I also want to go there someday. But—"

A black thread suddenly shot out from the black section of the lotus, and a white thread shot out from the white section of the lotus. They coiled around Zhang Fei and Qi Qingxiu’s waists, pulling them both into the lotus.

Qi Qingxiu was pulled to the black section, and Zhang Fei was pulled to the white section. The two threads did not disappear; instead, they connected to each other, making them feel a connection between them.

"What kind of feelings are these?" Just as Qi Qingxiu asked that, her soul was pulled out of her body. The lotus slowly began to absorb her soul power, shocking her. She tried to stop it, but her efforts were unsuccessful, and the lotus continued to absorb it.

"Don’t worry, let the lotus absorb your power, Qingxiu." Zhang Fei released his soul and allowed the lotus to absorb his soul power. He raised an eyebrow when he noticed a black lotus starting to form within Qi Qingxiu’s soul. "The lotus doesn’t absorb your soul power for free, but it also helps you master the Forbidden Lotus Codex, and the black lotus bud is proof of that."
Qi Qingxiu looked up at her soul, finding the black lotus bud. "What exactly is this lotus? Why do I believe it has a will of its own?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei softly laughed. "This lotus does have its own will, and it won’t harm us, so you don’t need to be afraid of it."

Qi Qingxiu nodded to Zhang Fei, but her expression turned to shock the next second, and her dress melted away, leaving her naked. She looked at Zhang Fei, and he was too naked in front of her. ’Tch! This lotus is as perverted as him.’

"I’ve seen you naked countless times, but I can’t stop admiring your body, Qingxiu." Qi Qingxiu glared at Zhang Fei, making him itch to tease her. "Hey, we’ve been intimate dozens of times, and we always enjoy touching each other’s bodies, so you don’t have to be like this, right?"

"Shameless pervert!" Qi Qingxiu shouted at Zhang Fei with an expression full of shame, remembering the intimate activities they shared together in the dream. ’Sigh! I hope this lotus will let us go as soon as possible.’
Unfortunately, the outcome was against Qi Qingxiu’s wishes, as the lotus brought her to Zhang Fei’s lap, causing her to panic as his cock was pressed against her pussy.
"If—Mhmm..." Zhang Fei didn’t waste the opportunity the lotus gave him, and he immediately hugged and kissed Qi Qingxiu.

"Fivefold!" Both Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan screamed in shock.
"Isn’t that too big, husband?"
"Could it be due to the influence of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus, husband?" Luo Yunxiao looked towards the monastery.
"I think so." Zhang Fei nodded.
"The presence of the giant Yin-Yang Lotus does indeed affect everything in this domain."
Jia Yuyan suddenly remembered something.
"Husband, I met Luo Jieyi and Luo Zhigui in the western wing earlier, but their condition was really abnormal.
I’ve tried waking them up several times, but they showed no reaction.
I checked their breathing and pulse, and they were both stable."

"Ancestor Qifeng and Ancestor Meizhen’s conditions are also the same as theirs, husband." Luo Yunxiao informed Zhang Fei about the situation of his two ancestors before he released them from the small room.
"What do you think happened to them?
Why did the four of them end up in such a situation?"
Although Zhang Fei disliked them for refusing to help him, they were still Luo Yunxiao’s ancestors.
Moreover, they were the protectors of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and the sect would be in chaos if anything catastrophic happened to them, which would also be a loss for him.
"I can’t guess what happened to them, but since they’re in such a condition, I think we should go there and check on their condition first.
Moreover, we can return to this domain whenever we want, so we don’t need to be in too much of a rush to cultivate here, and we’ll return here once the situation stabilizes."
"Let’s go."
After they canceled everything, they immediately came out of the lake and got dressed.
Zhang Fei hugged their waists and took them to the main gate of the monastery.
Sometime later, they arrived at the main gate of the monastery.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were also there, especially since they hadn’t found anything interesting in the other areas.
"Where are the others?
Why are only the three of you back?" Huang Xiaoyi asked.
"They’re still in the inner sanctum, specifically inside the giant Yin-Yang Lotus." Zhang Fei’s answer confused Huang Xiaoyi and Luo Fenghan.
"The lotus deliberately hid them, so no one could see them."
Luo Fenghan nodded in understanding before asking, "What do you think happened to the four of them, son?
Xiaoyi and I tried to wake them, but they didn’t respond to us, even though their breathing and pulse were normal."
"Let me check their condition first, Father-in-law." Zhang Fei hurriedly crouched down and examined the four unconscious people, but he and Mei couldn’t find anything strange inside their bodies.
He used his soul domain and pulled their souls out of their bodies, but he also found nothing strange in them. ’This is weird!
What exactly happened to them?’
’Zhang Fei, they’re not good people, and the lotus sealed their consciousness, so they didn’t give you any reaction.’ Yin Lianhua’s voice startled Zhang Fei.
’They’ll wake up on their own after you take them out of this domain.’ Yang Lianhua added.
’Thank you.’ Zhang Fei looked at the four people. ’Why does the Yin-Yang Lotus consider them bad people?
I don’t find anything negative in their souls, so they must be decent people, right?’
Yin Lianhua spoke to Zhang Fei again. ’I don’t understand why the lotus considers them bad people, but the lotus is never wrong.
Therefore, you must be careful of them, or you will suffer because of them.’
’Yeah.’ Zhang Fei immediately informed Luo Fenghan and the others.
"You guys don’t need to worry about them, and the Yin-Yang Lotus deliberately sealed their consciousness.
I don’t understand why the lotus did that to them, but they will wake up on their own after we leave this domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1358: Meet A Guest
paragraphs: "Are we leaving this domain now? What about the others?" Huang Xiaoyi asked.

"Mother-in-law, you don’t need to worry about them." Zhang Fei turned to Luo Fenghan, who lifted two of the four Luo Ancestors with his aura. He lifted the other two while asking Luo Shiwen. "Can you walk by yourself?"
"Yes." Luo Shiwen immediately rose to his feet, but he staggered backwards, forcing Huang Xiaoyi to support him. "How do we get out of this domain?"
"We—" A portal suddenly appeared in front of them, and Zhang Fei immediately led them into it. "Let’s go back."

"Zhang Fei." Zhang Fei looked at Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang, who had just landed in front of them. Both women were shocked to see the condition of the four Luo Ancestors. "Did something happen to them?"
"Something happened to them, but they’re fine now." Zhang Fei asked them. "Why are you two here?"

"The appearance of the light pillar attracted all the cultivators here, but they have already returned to their respective sects and clans." Nong Qinwei explained to Zhang Fei the reasons behind her and Yin Chang’s decision to wait for them. "Are you going back to the Moonlit Passion Temple?"

"Do you want to see changes to our sect and domain after half a year?" Both Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang nodded to Zhang Fei. "Let’s go to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary first, and we will return to my sect after that."
"Alright."

Upon their arrival at the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, Zhang Fei and Luo Fenghan laid the four unconscious Luo Ancestors in one place. Meanwhile, Luo Shiwen went straight back to her private residence to recover.
"We will return to our sect now."
Not long after Zhang Fei and the four women left, the four Luo Ancestors opened their eyes, but they felt that their bodies were so weak. "What happened to us?"

"The Yin-Yang Lotus rendered you unconscious, and it also absorbed your Yin and Yang Qi." They looked at Luo Fenghan directly. "I don’t know what you guys were thinking when you entered that domain, but it is no ordinary one. It is the birthplace of the Yin-Yang Lotus, and it is still connected to the Ancient Realm."
"The Yin-Yang Lotus." The four Luo Ancestors murmured while looking at Luo Fenghan.
"That’s right." Luo Fenghan nodded at them. "I can’t explain the details to you because I haven’t met the lotus myself; instead, I learned about it from my son-in-law."
"Didn’t Zhang Fei tell you anything else about the Yin-Yang Lotus?"

"No." Luo Fenghan shook his head at Lui Jieyi. "By the way, we’ve already searched the entire monastery ruins, and we couldn’t find anything interesting there. The entire domain area was also completely destroyed, so it’s no longer of any use to us. Moreover, the lotus will only allow its chosen people to enter that domain, so you guys should forget about both."

After he said that, Luo Fenghan led Huang Xiaoyi to leave the place, leaving the four ancestors behind. Using the last of their strength, the four also left the place and returned to their respective residences, but their expressions were obviously not good, and only they knew what was on their minds.
"Husband, I think the lotus had a special reason for treating them like that before."
"Yes," Luo Fenghan agreed with his wife. "Our son-in-law surely knows why the lotus treated them that way, but I don’t understand why he didn’t tell us about it."

Huang Xiaoyi thought for a moment. "Since the Yin-Yang lotus is not an ordinary one, it probably sensed something from our ancestors, and it probably wasn’t a good thing; otherwise, it wouldn’t have treated them like that."

"I think the same as you, wife." Luo Fenghan released a helpless sigh. "They are old, but they cannot control their worldly desires. They are clearly greedy, and I can also see that they are jealous of our son-in-law. They already know about his strength and abilities, so I hope they won’t act stupidly by planning wicked things against him; otherwise, they might die in his hands, and our sect will be significantly weakened if they die."

Huang Xiaoyi shook her head in disagreement. "Our son-in-law must have understood the pros and cons of killing our ancestors, so I’m sure he would never kill them. He might do something else to our ancestors, just like he enslaved those evil beasts."
"Sigh." Luo Fenghan sighed again. "Regardless of what our son-in-law will do to our ancestors, I hope there will be no problems between them."
"The outcome will depend on our ancestors, and we can only hope that they will not act foolishly by antagonizing our sons-in-law."
"Yeah."
"Husband, you can go back first, and I will go see our son and daughter-in-law." Huang Xiaoyi and Luo Fenghan immediately went their separate ways.
Thereafter, Huang Xiaoyi went to see Luo Zhenyu and Bing Xingying, but they were unwilling to tell her the truth; instead, they asked her to wait a few days to find out.

"Unbelievable!" Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang shouted in awe as soon as they arrived at the Twin Flames Domain, especially since the entire area of the domain was filled with tall plants that hid all the sects and clans there.

Nong Qinwei turned to Zhang Fei. "I’ve heard about the change in this domain from Jiang Qingmei and Tan Ziyan, but I still find it hard to believe that you guys could accomplish it in just a few days. Normally, we would need tens or even hundreds of years to change the entire area of one domain, especially since most trees have slow growth."

"That’s the difference between human and natural races, Sect Master Nong." Zhang Fei replied with a smile while looking in another direction. "Dryads, elves, and fairies have a close connection with nature, and they can borrow its power to their advantage. If I didn’t have them by my side, I would never have been able to turn this domain into something like this in just a few days. Furthermore, I also have several members of giant races, other natural races, and hundreds of beast races by my side, which accelerates the change of this domain."
"Are you guys finished now?"

"Not yet." Zhang Fei pointed to the sky. "My people have already built all the access roads connecting all the sects and cities, so they won’t have any trouble carrying out their activities as usual. However, I think this change is not enough, and I plan to build aerial formation arrays, especially flying restriction arrays. This way, all cultivators will not be able to fly in this domain, and I will also build protective barriers that surround the entire area, so other cultivators will have to pass through the teleportation portals that I will place in the outermost area to enter."

Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang exchanged looks of shock after hearing that, and they felt that Zhang Fei’s ambitions were sky-high, especially since creating one formation required a lot of time and huge costs in purchasing the materials, let alone so many formations.

"I understand why you two are shocked, but I already have the support of the Liao Clan of the Sky Pillar Domain, and some of them are in my sect now." Zhang Fei looked at Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang. "How about you two move the Hidden Moon Sect to this domain? I know that your sect has existed in the Empyrean Main Domain for generations, but the sect buildings are only the outer shell, and the people are the core. All your members will feel much safer if you relocate your sect to this domain, especially once we’ve completed all those formations."

Yin Chang spoke to Nong Qinwei directly. "I think that’s a fantastic idea, Big Sis. Our sect has always been safe in the Empyrean Main Domain, but we’ve had to face repeated attacks from the family members of all our targets in the past. If one day they work together, we won’t be able to face them, and this domain will be the best hiding place for us, especially if Zhang Fei has already installed all those formations here."

"I agree with you, Chang’er." Nong Qinwei looked at Zhang Fei. "Your offer is indeed good, but I can’t make the decision myself, and I need to discuss this matter with my master and Senior Xuening first."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "It’s okay, you don’t need to make a decision now, and you can discuss it with them first. If necessary, you can ask them to come here to see me, and I will help you explain everything to them."
"I’ll contact them now." Nong Qinwei readily agreed.
"Let’s wait for them in my sect."
Upon arriving at the Moonlit Passion Sect, Tian Kui and Serpentera informed Zhang Fei that Zhi Yongbo had been waiting for him since yesterday.
Since Zhi Yongbo insisted on seeing him, Zhang Fei went to the guest hall to meet him while awaiting Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening’s arrival.

Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan returned to their residence behind the mountain, informing their other sisters about the lake in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain. Meanwhile, Nong Qinwei and Yin Chang went to the training ground, where the two female disciples from their sect were training with Jian Kuang and the others.
"Are you Zhang Fei?" Zhi Yongbo asked.
"I am." Zhang Fei sat in the head seat and asked the old man, "What brings you here, Senior?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1359: Rejection
paragraphs: Zhi Yongbo released a soft sigh before cupping his hand to Zhang Fei. "First things first, I want to apologize for the actions of my son and daughter-in-law when you came to our clan two weeks ago. As their senior, I failed to educate them, and they behaved so badly."

Zhi Yongbo released a soft sigh before cupping his hand to Zhang Fei. "First things first, I want to apologize for the actions of my son and daughter-in-law when you came to our clan two weeks ago. As their senior, I failed to educate them, and they behaved so badly."

’Heh! This old man must already know about my relationship with Feng Yao; otherwise, he wouldn’t behave like this.’ Zhang Fei answered Zhi Yongbo directly. "Since a senior like you came here to apologize, and I’m not petty, I’ll treat the problem between us as a thing of the past. However, I will never cooperate with your Zhi Clan in any field, even though I need many physicians for my sect. For me, people like them are not worthy business partners because they can change their minds anytime and stab me in the back, so I won’t take such a risk. Moreover, I have already established cooperation with the Qiao Clan, and Senior Yisheng is teaching our physicians to become better, which I think is enough."

Zhi Yongbo was disappointed with Zhang Fei’s decision, especially after witnessing all the changes he brought to the Moonlit Passion Sect. The sect, which was once a dual cultivation sect always looked down upon by other cultivators, has transformed into a capable sect, and they now have many skilled individuals in various fields. Even cultivators like Jian Kuang and Su Shentian, who had previously been unwilling to have any affiliations with others, were willing to join them.

Zhi Yongbo was completely disappointed, but he couldn’t blame Zhang Fei for their problems, which arose from the arrogance of Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong, who had tried to suppress him two weeks ago. He could only blame his son and daughter-in-law’s arrogance for the wasted opportunity. "Is there anything I can do to change your decision?"

"No." Zhang Fei firmly refused. "Some people can change, but some can’t. As their father, you should already be aware of Zhi Shengyan and Lan Yuerong’s characters; you should know that they will never change. Even if you pressure them to change, they will only change temporarily, and they will continue to harbor enmity toward me. I’ve never hesitated to kill my enemies, and I will kill them if they dare attack me again. If that happens, your Zhi Clan will be the one to lose, so I think you should forget about your desire to cooperate with me for the good of both parties."

If someone else said something like that to Zhi Yongbo, he would definitely be furious and attack that person directly. However, he had witnessed Zhang Fei’s ability to change the Moonlit Passion Sect, and he had also known about his relationship with Feng Yao.

Moreover, Zhi Yongbo knew that Empress Huo Yanling was notoriously cruel, and she would never hesitate to kill anyone who dared to harm those affiliated with her, just like when she ordered her subordinates to slaughter those people upon her first return several months ago.
Zhi Yongbo released a helpless sigh and rose to his feet. "Since you have made that decision, I will not force you to cooperate with my Zhi Clan, and I will return to my domain now."
"Yes."

Not long after Zhi Yongbo left, You Feiling appeared in front of Zhang Fei. "Do you really not want to cooperate with the Zhi Clan, Elder Zhang? The Zhi Clan is the best medical clan in the entire paradise realm, so I think we will lose out if we don’t cooperate with them."

"Why are you worried about that, Feiling?" Zhang Fei quickly moved to You Feiling’s side and embraced her. "The Zhi Clan is indeed the best medical clan; however, the characters of their members are truly unpleasant, and they always look down on dual cultivators like us. Zhi Yongbo can force them to change their characters, but no one will ever truly change under pressure, and they might turn their backs against us, so I won’t take that risk."
"But—"

Zhang Fei placed his fingers onto You Feiling’s lips and rubbed them, making her blush. "Furthermore, Senior Yisheng and his Qiao Clan are no less outstanding than the Zhi Clan’s members, and I have more confidence in them than the members of that clan. For now, we just need to give them time to help our members develop, and we will have many skilled physicians by then."
"Are you sure they are enough to help our members grow?" You Feiling pulled Zhang Fei’s hand down.

"One hundred percent." Zhang Fei immediately summoned all the female elders of the Moonlit Passion Sect to meet him. "By the way, I discovered an interesting place earlier, so I’ll send you and the others there."
"What kind of place is that?"
"You’ll find out soon." After the female elders had gathered, Zhang Fei opened the gate to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain. "You guys can enter now, and you should go to the inner sanctum afterward."
You Feiling and the others felt confused by Zhang Fei’s instructions, but they trusted that he would never harm them, so they quickly entered the gate.

After they left, Zhang Fei returned to his residence behind the mountain, but some of his women had not returned, and they were still in other domains under the protection of You Qilin, Fei Lian, and several evil beasts.

Qing Yi informed Zhang Fei that Zhong Yan and a few women had already found suitable domains to open their shops, so he immediately contacted them through the harem link and asked them about the situation.
After listening to their explanation, Zhang Fei instructed Zhong Yan and his other wives to look for one building in each domain, and he sent his other three clones to their locations to help them.

’Old Kui and Old Snake, I will take them to another domain, and you two must contact me through my fourth clone if anything disturbs this sect.’ After the two ancient beasts answered him, Zhang Fei brought all his wives in the residence to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

When they arrived at the lakeside, all the women hurriedly took off their dresses and jumped into the lake with excitement, especially after Luo Yunxiao and Jia Yuyan told them about the extraordinary effects of the lake and the domain.
However, Zhang Yue did not join them, and she spoke to Zhang Fei. "Fei’er, please send me to the Ice Phoenix Domain. I’ll practice there with the others to improve my Ice Phoenix Scripture."
"Is your Ice Phoenix Scripture close to breaking through again?"
"Yes." Zhang Yue nodded slightly. "After this, I’ll be able to use the pinnacle technique of the Ice Phoenix Scripture. I’ll show you the results once I’ve mastered it."
"Alright." After he sent Zhang Yue to the ice phoenix domain, Zhang Fei hurriedly took off his clothes and joined his other wives at the lake.
Zhang Fei pulled Ru Xue into his arms, used his demon touch on her, and penetrated her directly.
"Ahh..." Ru Xue moaned really loud because of Zhang Fei’s actions. "Why are you in such a hurry, Fei’er?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei answered Ru Xue by releasing his cum into her womb, shocking her. "Can you feel it?"
Ru Xue nodded at Zhang Fei. "Your Yang Qi has increased significantly, just like what Sister Yunxiao and Sister Yuyan said before."

"That’s right." Zhang Fei released his soul and summoned his ten avatars, and Ru Xue did the same. They merged the two lotuses in their souls before starting their dual cultivation and dual-soul cultivation. "For now, you guys can cultivate manually, and I’ll do it with all of you after I’m done with Xue’er."
Liu Hua and the others had no problem with that, and they immediately released their souls and avatars before starting their cultivation, waiting for Zhang Fei and Ru Xue to finish.
In the inner sanctum, You Feiling and all the female elders were shocked as soon as the Yin-Yang Lotus pulled them into it, causing their dresses to melt.
Before they could react, the Yin-Yang Lotus had already begun absorbing their soul power, sending them into a panic.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately spoke to them, "Don’t resist it, and let the lotus absorb your soul power. The lotus won’t kill you, and it needs your soul power to strengthen itself. Moreover, it doesn’t absorb your soul power for free, and it will help you with other things."

You Feiling and the female elders calmed themselves, especially after they felt that the Yin-Yang Lotus was not greedy in absorbing their soul power. Additionally, they felt something flowing into their bodies, which they believed came from the lotus.

Moreover, Tianshi Shengjie and the others looked calm, even though the Yin-Yang Lotus continued to absorb their soul power, and their worries immediately vanished. However, some of them felt embarrassed to be naked in front of Zhang Fei [5], even though they were all dual cultivators, especially since a few of them had partners.
"Feiling." You Feiling looked at Qing Qiu’er. "Come here."
"Eh?" You Feiling was taken aback. "What’s wrong, Big Sis?"
"Don’t you already know the reason?" Qing Qiu’er responded while shaking her head. "Come here and take my place."

chapters.title: Chapter 1362: Lan Yuerong’s Foolishness
paragraphs: When Lan Yuerong arrived at the Zhi Clan, Zhi Yongbo was already waiting for her with a furious expression. Zhi Shengyan stood behind him without being able to say a word.
Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen were also present, but they kept quiet because of her stupidity.
Zhi Yongbo threw a storage ring to Lan Yuerong. "You are no longer part of my Zhi Clan, and we will never accept you back into this clan. Don’t come here again, or I will cripple your cultivation."

After saying that, Zhi Yongbo entered their clan, followed by Zhi Qingshong, Nie Shuyin, Zhi Qian, and Zhi Shen. Zhi Shengyan looked at his wife for quite some time before sighing, and he turned to leave, leaving Lan Yuerong behind.

After her grandfather chased her away, Lan Yuerong already realized she was in a tight spot. She didn’t try to protest to Zhi Yongbo because she was familiar with his character, and he would surely cripple her or even kill her if she contradicted him.

Lan Yuerong left the Zhi Clan with an expression full of anger, but she kept blaming Zhang Fei for the situation she had caused herself, and she racked her brains to find a way to destroy him. ’Shit! I don’t know what to do now, but I will find a way to kill that bastard! He put me in this situation, so I will use any means to destroy him and his sect.’
Lan Yuerong decided to leave the Sky Pillar Domain because she had no one left there, and she contacted her friends in another domain, as she thought of several ways to improve her situation.
The night passed quickly, and another day finally arrived.

Early in the morning, Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen decided to head to the Moonlit Passion Temple. They arrived at the Twin Flames Domain at the same time as Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang, who intended to look for Zhang Fei at the sect.

Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen had already heard about the changes Zhang Fei had made in the Twin Flames Domain, so they were no longer surprised to see the entire domain transformed into a dense forest, with the only thing still visible there being the floating plateau where the Moonlit Passion Temple was located.
On the other hand, Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were shocked by the changes in the Twin Flames Domain, but they ignored all that and hurriedly flew to the floating plateau.

When they arrived in front of the barrier, Tian Kui and Serpentera immediately stopped them. The strength of the two ancient beasts shocked the four of them, but Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang remembered Zhuxian Sheng’s words back then that Zhang Fei had many powerful beasts by his side, and the two beasts in front of them were some of them.

Serpentera spoke directly to them. "If the four of you came here to meet our master, you guys can go back to your respective places because he has been gone since yesterday. He brought everyone to another domain for seclusion, and he didn’t tell us when they would return."
"Can you contact Zhang Fei for us, Senior?" Li Meixiang respectfully asked. "We have an important matter to discuss with him, so we hope you will be willing to help us meet him."

Tian Kui shook his head at Li Meixiang. "Unfortunately, we can’t contact our master, and you can come here again someday if you wish to meet him. However, our master usually spends long periods in isolation, so we can’t be sure when he will return, and your visit would be in vain, just like today."
"I see." Feng Lianhe nodded in understanding. "In that case, we won’t make things difficult for you two, and we’ll return to our domain now."
After Feng Lianhe and Li Meixiang left, Tian Kui asked the Zhi twins. "What do you guys want? Why aren’t you leaving?"

"Seniors, we both come from the Zhi Clan." Both Serpentera and Tian Kui frowned at Zhi Shen. "Our grandfather has already told us about the changes in this sect, and we’re curious to see the sect for ourselves, so please allow us to enter."
Zhi Qian also spoke to them. "Senior, we won’t make a fuss about this sect, and we are just curious about the changes."
"Let them in, Old Kui."
Tian Kui nodded at Serpentera. "You two can enter our sect, but we’ll expel you if you cause a disturbance here."
"We dare not, Seniors." Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen hurriedly flew in as soon as Tian Kui opened a gap in the barrier, but the two ancient beasts continued to watch them from a distance.

Since they were physicians, Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen’s first destination was the medical hall, where they saw Qiao Yisheng chatting with Elmyra, Tian Houtian, and Tian Zhiling. They weren’t surprised by the female elf’s presence, but they were surprised by the presence of the two members of the Winged Race, as they hadn’t appeared in Zhi Yongbo’s memories.
"Oh? Are you two curious about this sect?" Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen turned to Tang Qingyan, who had just arrived.
Zhi Shen nodded at Tang Qingyan. "Our grandfather came here yesterday, and we’ve seen his memories about this sect, so we decided to come here to see for ourselves."

"I see." Tang Qingyan nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, your mother made a fatal mistake by acting so arrogantly in front of Zhang Fei back then, and he refused to have any relationship with your Zhi Clan because of her."

Zhi Qian let out a heavy sigh. "Sister Qingyan, you probably haven’t heard about this matter, but our two grandfathers have already severed ties with our mother, and they’ve expelled her from both clans."
"Huh?" Tang Qingyan looked at the Zhi twins in shock, blinking her eyes several times. "Did they really cut ties with Lan Yuerong and expel her from both clans? Why did they do that?"

"This matter still has something to do with Zhang Fei." Zhi Qian told Tang Qingyan about Lan Yuerong’s action of asking for help from the two ancestors of the Tan Clan to attack Zhang Fei, but the result backfired on her. "We don’t know where she is now."
Tang Qingyan nodded slightly. "Even though Lan Yuerong is no longer a member of either clan, you two should not expect that Zhang Fei will be willing to establish a relationship with your Zhi Clan."
"We know." Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen looked at Tian Houtian and Tian Zhiling. "Since when did those two winged race members join this sect?"

"They have been part of this sect since its transformation." Tang Qingyan’s answer surprised the Zhi Twins. "Zhang Fei and Tian Huangjin have known each other since the Three Mortal Realms, and Tian Ziyu decided to cooperate with him because of it."
"Does that mean Tian Huangjin has also joined this sect?"
Tang Qingyan nodded at them. "Tian Huangjin has indeed joined this sect, but she entered seclusion with Zhang Fei. Would you two like to take a look inside?"
"No." Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen refused. "We’re curious about this sect, so we’ll explore the other areas, and we’ll leave after we’ve seen everything."
"Alright then."

After they visited all the halls of the Moonlit Passion Temple and met the person in charge there, Zhi Qian and Zhi Shen left the sect to return to their territory, but they left feeling disappointed because their chances of cooperating with Zhang Fei were slim to none.
Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were disappointed that they couldn’t meet Zhang Fei; however, they did not give up and planned to visit the Moonlit Passion Temple again until they could meet him.

When they arrived at the Fei Clan, Feng Lianhe, who had been ordered to go to the Immortal Soul Palace in the Samsara Domain, was already waiting for them. However, he informed them that Hun Lingwu’s schedule was still busy, and he asked them to come to him a month later.

Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang were naturally disappointed by the news because they wanted to save their grandson as soon as possible, but they couldn’t do anything but wait, and they would continue to try to meet Zhang Fei while waiting for the time to come.
Meanwhile, Lan Yuerong was already in a bedroom with a woman of her age, and she told her about her problem with Zhang Fei. "Can you help me destroy that bastard, Su Heiyan?"

"Unfortunately, I can’t help you, Yuerong." Lan Yuerong looked disappointed, but Su Heiyan quickly spoke again. "However, I know someone who can help you destroy him, but that person won’t help you for free, and you’ll have to make a small sacrifice in return."
Lan Yuerong raised an eyebrow when she saw Su Heiyan’s strange smile. "What kind of sacrifice do you mean?"

"The sacrifice is you." Lan Yuerong hurriedly stood up from her seat after Su Heiyan said that, making her laugh. "Haha! You misunderstood me, Yuerong. The sacrifice I meant wasn’t your life, but your body."
"My body?" Lan Yuerong frowned.

Su Heiyan walked behind Lan Yuerong, hugged her from behind, and grabbed her breasts. "The person I mean is a lust demon, but he is not an ordinary one. He is my master, and he is the demon god of the lust demon race. If you are willing to serve him, he will help you get rid of that man."

After hearing that, Xie Yan didn’t speak further and disappeared from the sight of the two ancient beasts.
She hurriedly returned to the Endless Domain to confirm the truth of Tian Kui’s words.
"Lan Yuerong is truly a foolish woman." Serpentera sighed softly.
Tian Kui nodded in agreement.
"Lan Yuerong was aware that our master had already taken control of her soul; however, her stupidity and arrogance caused her to forget this fact.
Unfortunately, it was too late for her to regret it, and she will die soon."
"Forget her and let’s go back to the sect."
"Yeah."
A while later, Xie Yan arrived at the Valley of Temptation and found Xie Yao had finished having fun with Lan Yuerong, who looked exhausted.
"Oh?
Why are you back so soon?
Where’s Zhang Fei?
Did you fail to catch him?"
"I—" Xie Yan stopped talking as soon as Lan Yuerong’s body emitted a light.
Xie Yao frowned at that, and he hurriedly pulled Su Heiyan away from Lan Yuerong.
"What happened to her?"
"Let’s wait." Xie Yan seriously observed Lan Yuerong’s body.
Soon, Lan Yuerong’s body floated into the air by itself, making her panic.
"Master, please save me; something happened in my body."
Xie Yan and Xie Yao frowned because Lan Yuerong’s soul suddenly came out of her body, but their expressions changed to shock when they saw the soul sword inside her soul.
"Master... save me...
I—" Lan Yuerong couldn’t continue her words, and her eyes became dull.
Meanwhile, Xie Yan and Xie Yao were utterly shocked after they witnessed the soul sword shatter Lan Yuerong’s soul, causing it to disappear completely.
After all, the soul was the most essential part of all living things, and Lan Yuerong instantly died as soon as her soul shattered.
"Fuck!
What happened to her?
Who implanted that soul sword in her soul?" Xie Yao exclaimed in shock.
"Zhang Fei." Xie Yao turned to Xie Yan, who immediately explained to him about her previous conversation with Tian Kui and Serpentera.
"I don’t know the identities of those two beasts, but their strength is on par with ours.
They were confident that they could withstand my lust abilities, so I didn’t dare attack them, and I immediately returned once they told me that Lan Yuerong was about to die.
At first, I didn’t believe them, but her death has proven the truth."
Xie Yao’s expression turned gloomy.
"The soul sword just now was clearly a soul technique, and a high-level one at that, which means Zhang Fei was an expert soul cultivator.
If my guess is correct, he had already implanted it into her soul from the start, but he hadn’t killed her because of the Zhi and Lan Clans."
"Zhang Fei’s abilities in the soul cultivation path are obviously very high, and his level is probably on par with Hun Lingwu." Xie Yan suddenly remembered something.
"Hey!
I thought Zhang Fei and Zhang Xiaolong were the same person."
"Zhang Fei...
Zhang Xiaolong..." Xie Yao muttered to himself.
"I’m sure it’s no coincidence that they have the same surname, so I think your guess is correct that they are indeed the same person.
Let’s go!
We have to go to the Slaughter Blood Domain right now."
"Let’s go."
"What brings you two to my domain today?" Shang Luohu questioned Xie Yao and Xie Yan, who had just appeared on her balcony.
"What about Zhang Xiaolong, Empress Shang?
Is he still in the Blood Sea?"
Shang Luohu looked at Xie Yao before shaking her head.
"Back then, you said that he would need one to three years to complete his evolution, but he managed to complete it in just three months, and he has left the Blood Sea since then."
"It seems our guess was correct." Xie Yao nodded to Xi Yan.
"Where is Zhang Xiaolong now?"
"The Blood Forest, to be precise; Zhang Xiaolong is in the underground area." Shang Luohuo looked curiously at their expressions.
"What exactly do you guys think about him?
What guess did you mean before?"
"Zhang Xiaolong isn’t his true identity, and his true identity is Zhang Fei, an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple." Xie Yan’s answer took Shang Luohu aback.
"A woman came to us and asked for our help in getting rid of him, and she told us about him and the sect.
I went to the Twin Flames Domain to investigate him, but two powerful guardian beasts stopped me, and they recognized him as their master.
They told me the woman would die today, and she really died as soon as I returned to our valley."
"Did Zhang Fei kill that woman under your nose?"
Both Xie Yan and Xie Yao nodded to Shang Luohu.
"Zhang Fei didn’t come directly to our valley, but he already implanted a soul sword in that woman’s soul, and it shattered her soul right before our eyes."
"I see." Shang Luohu was not the least bit surprised by that, especially after she met Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul in the underground a month ago.
"Regarding your story about the ten-tailed fox, I believe that Zhang Fei is his successor."

"How can you be so sure of that, Empress Shang?" Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh before telling them about her encounter with Hu Tianlang’s bloodlust soul in the underground, which shocked Xie Yao and Xie Yan.
"No wonder he can do such a thing; it turns out that he is indeed the successor of the ten-tailed fox."
"Have you discussed this matter with your husband, Empress Shang?"
Shang Luohu shook her head at Xie Yao.
"My husband was frightened by the appearance of the soul of the ten-tailed fox, and he entered seclusion from the day.
Moreover, I didn’t have any valid evidence regarding that matter at that time, so I haven’t said anything to him about my suspicions."
"I think you should not tell your husband about this matter, Empress Shang." Shang Luohu raised an eyebrow at Xie Yao.
"If Zhang Fei is truly the successor of the ten-tailed fox, Long Wuzhao and the others must already know about him, and they will do everything possible to protect him.
If your husband chooses to become his enemy, your asura demon race will face them all at once, including those higher-ups.
Your husband is powerful, and I fear him, but those people are much stronger.
Moreover, your race guardian likes him, so I’m sure it will not protect you; instead, it will protect him, which will threaten the safety of your race members."
Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh as she agreed with Xie Yao.
"You’re right; my husband will consider Zhang Fei an enemy if he finds out the truth.
By the way, he’s still there now, but we must not approach that place, or the soul of the ten-tailed fox will kill us."
"I know." Xie Yao nodded slightly.
"Since I’ve already gotten the answer to our guess, we’ll return to our domain now.
I have a hunch that Zhang Fei will be coming to us soon, so I’ll be waiting for him in my valley."
"Alright." After Xie Yao and Xie Yan disappeared, Shang Zhui appeared behind Shang Luohu.
"What do you think about this matter, Zhui?"
Shang Zhui let out a soft sigh.
"Empress, I agree with your wish to hide this matter from my Emperor.
I’m sure he will find out about this matter someday, but I’m sure it won’t be anytime soon, especially since he’s still focused on his seclusion."
"Let’s go to the Moonlit Passion Temple, Zhui."
Shang Zui was taken aback for a moment.
"What do you want to do in the sect, Empress?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1365: Agreement
paragraphs: "I won’t do anything to the sect." Shang Luohu paused. "You know, I’ve always hoped to free my daughter from Mo Shentian’s control, and I think Zhang Fei is the only one who can help me free her. If my guess is correct, the one in the underground is his clone, and his real body should be in that sect now, so I want to meet him."
Shang Zhui nodded in understanding. "I will accompany you to the sect, Empress."
"Huh? How could this domain turn into a dense forest like this?" Both Shang Zhui and Shang Luohu were shocked by the changes in the Twin Flames Domain.

"Zhang Fei had a big plan for this domain, and the changes were the starting point." They looked at Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, who had appeared just before them. "He informed me that you two would be coming here, so he asked me to meet you."
"How did Zhang Fei know we would be coming here?"

"Empress, Zhang Fei knew about Xie Yao and Xie Yan’s visit to our domain when he started his evolution, and he believed that they would come to you after he killed Lan Yuerong." Tian Shuixiang’s answer confused Shang Luohu further. "He knew you had already guessed his identity, especially after you met Hu Tianlang’s soul in the underground. He knew about the princess’s situation, and he guessed that you would come to him for her sake."
Shang Luohu massaged her forehead after she heard all that, and she felt that Zhang Fei had been spying on her and her Asura Demon Clan without her or her husband being aware.
"That kid is really scary." Shang Zhui shook his head as he spoke, but then he looked at Ye Zhiye. "Long time no see, Zhiye."
Ye Zhiye nodded at Shang Zhui. "Long time no see, father-in-law. I was truly delighted when my husband informed me that you approved of our relationship."

"Sigh." Shang Zhui sighed heavily. "I’ve wronged both of you, Zhiye. I should have considered your feelings more from the start, but I was too selfish and blinded by the long-standing enmity between our two demon clans, which caused you both to suffer for so long."
"No." Ye Zhiye shook her head in response. "Father-in-law, we did live on the run for so long, but we never suffered a bit, and we always lived happily."
Shang Zhui sighed once again. "I hope you two will be happy forever."
"We will, father-in-law."
"So, where is Zhang Fei now? Can I meet him?" Shang Luohu asked.

"Unfortunately, Zhang Fei is not in this domain right now, Empress." Shang Luohu was disappointed to hear that. "He took all his wives to another domain for seclusion three days ago, and he hasn’t confirmed when they will leave their seclusion. However, he asked me to tell you that he will meet you once he returns, so you just need to wait for him to contact you, and you can discuss the matter with him then."
Shang Luohu couldn’t help but sigh in her heart. "Since Zhang Fei has said that, your father and I will return to our domain now."
"Yes, Empress."
Shang Zhui floated in front of Tian Shuixiang and Ye Zhiye, grabbing their shoulders. "I hope you two will give me a grandchild soon, and your child will be the link between the two demon races."
"Haha." Tian Shuixiang laughed awkwardly as he hugged Ye Zhiye’s waist. "Father, fate still doesn’t want us to become parents, so you have to be patient to have a grandchild."
Shang Zhui nodded slightly. "Take care of yourselves, both of you."
"Yes, Father."
After Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui left, Ye Zhiye immediately asked her husband. "Do you think it would be fine if Zhang Fei revealed himself like that to them?"

"Zhang Fei almost never does anything reckless, and he must have his own plans for revealing his identity to the public." Tian Shuixiang flew Ye Zhiye back to the sect. "I don’t know whether his decision is right or wrong; we’ll find out in the future. For now, we just need to focus on our cultivation and help him with his other plans, and we’ll make a move to help him if he truly needs our help."
"Yeah."

Mo Zainan sat alone in a daze in her private room, propping her chin on the dressing table as she stared at her reflection in the mirror. "What exactly happened to me? Where did these strange images that have been popping into my mind for the past three days come from?"

"Mother." Mo Zainan turned to Mo Tianqi, who was walking toward her carrying a metal cup. Arriving in front of his mother, he handed it over to her. "I’ve noticed that you’ve been very restless these past few days, so I deliberately brought your favorite wine."

Mo Zainan received the metal cup and smelled the scent of the wine. She didn’t notice the faint smirk on Mo Tianqi’s face and downed the wine in one gulp. "This abyssal fruit wine is indeed the most delicious compared to the other wines."
"I’m glad you like it, Mother."
"Yeah." Mo Zainan returned the metal cup to her third son. "Have Yousha and Anqi returned from the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain?"

Mo Tianqi shook his head slightly. "As far as I know, Sha Huo is a difficult man, and he’s not easily seduced by women. My two sisters probably had difficulty approaching him, so they still haven’t returned to this day."

"That’s true." Mo Zainan felt something suddenly appear inside her body, forcing her to check it. She was confused after she couldn’t find anything inside her body. "Leave and cultivate, Tianqi. Otherwise, your father will be angry with you if you slack off like this."
"Yes, Mother." Mo Tianqi walked away as his smirk grew broader. ’My master will definitely be pleased after I report to him.’
After her third son left, Mo Zainan walked back to the bed while taking off her outer dress, and she lay down on her bed before falling asleep.
After he left Mo Zainan’s bedroom, Mo Tianqi carefully sneaked into Mo Zixiao’s room, where a young woman was sitting with a sad expression by the window.

The young woman has a pretty face, with pale skin, striking red eyes, a slender nose, thin lips, and a sharp chin. Her hair was long, straight, and a deep reddish-brown color. Her dark red dress, with the upper part quite revealing, perfectly embraces her tall, slender figure.
"Sister-in-law."
The woman looked at Mo Tianqi, but her gaze was blank as if she were a soulless doll. She was none other than Mo Zixiao’s wife, who was also the first princess of the Asura Demon Race, Shang Xueli.
Mo Tianqi approached Shang Xueli, leaned to her ear, and whispered a few things to her.
Shang Xueli stared at Mo Tianqi without a word leaving her mouth, but she allowed him to put some pills into her mouth, which she immediately swallowed.
Mo Tianqi took a strand of Shang Xueli’s hair and some parts of her body, such as nails, blood, skin, and some other things.
Mo Tianqi hurriedly walked out of the room, and Shang Xueli continued to stare at the door, even though he had already disappeared from her sight.
After getting an answer from Zhang Fei, Mo Tianqi left the Celestial Demon Domain to go to another domain, where he met with his clone and handed Shang Xueli’s body parts to him.
After everything was done, Mo Tianqi returned to his domain again because he was afraid that Mo Shentian would notice if he was gone for too long.

After finding suitable buildings in several other domains, Zhang Fei’s three clones immediately purchased them. Then, two of his three clones took Zhong Yan and several other women to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain to join the others.

Zhang Fei [1] decided to return to the Moonlit Passion Sect because Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening had been waiting for him since yesterday. He discussed with the two women the plan to move the Hidden Moon Sect from the Empyrean Main Domain to the Twin Flames Domain.
Zhang Fei [1] deliberately let Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening wait a day so they could explore his sect and the domain and learn about all the changes.

After they had considered everything carefully, and Zhang Fei [1] also offered them access to cultivate at the Celestial Yin Lake, Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening decided to move the Hidden Moon Sect from the Empyrean Main Domain to the Twin Flames Domain.
Their sect’s relocation could not be done anytime soon, especially since they still did not have a building for their sect in the Twin Flames Domain.

Zhang Fei [1] offered them to move their sect to the floating plateau, but Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening rejected his idea because their sect would become part of the Moonlit Passion Temple if they did.
Although they had cooperated with him, Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening did not want their sect to become part of his, preferring that it remain independent as it once was.

Zhang Fei [1] did not force Dongfang Yuechan and Lan Xuening; instead, he asked them to meet the members of the giant race under the leadership of Ju Tan because they could help the two women to prepare the buildings for their sect.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [1] left the Moonlit Passion Sect and went to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1366: Jiu Mozu Captured
paragraphs: Even though they had already decided to expel Lan Yuerong from both of their clans, the members of the Lan and Zhi Clans immediately realized that she was dead through her broken life stone.
Everyone was convinced that Zhang Fei killed Lan Yuerong, especially since some of them witnessed him duplicating her soul and implanting the soul sword into it.

Since they had expected from the start that Lan Yuerong would die at Zhang Fei’s hands, no one went to the Moonlit Passion Sect to search for her corpse. Moreover, they were certain that he wouldn’t keep her corpse and would destroy it, so they didn’t waste their time on it.
Despite this, the Zhi and Lan Clan still held a death ceremony for Lan Yuerong; they built a grave for her even though there was no corpse, and they replaced her corpse with her past valuables.
In the Nine Nether Demon Realm, Jiu Mozu was helpless and shackled to the wall of a dark, cold room. He stared at Jiu Moze, who stood before him, with contempt in his old eyes.

Jiu Mozu was a powerful demon god, but he wasn’t truly powerful, and he was far weaker than some of the other demon gods. The only thing that helped him become so powerful was his ability to borrow the power of his nine subordinates.
Jiu Moze was Jiu Mozu’s master, and he was just as powerful as his disciple. Most importantly, he knew his disciple’s weakness, and he had first captured his nine subordinates before capturing him.
"Why? Why are you doing this to me, Master?" Jiu Mozu asked in a gloomy tone, and he had never felt so helpless since he became a demon god.

"You’re just an idiot." Jiu Moze replied briefly and left the place, then informed Zhang Fei through his clone that he had successfully subdued Jiu Mozu and taken over his authority within the Nine Nether Demon Race.

"Damn it!" Jiu Mozu clenched his teeth in anger, but he was truly helpless with his cultivation sealed by Jiu Moze, and his master had also captured his nine subordinates. "What exactly happened to my master? Why did he suddenly betray me after returning from the Starfall Martial Domain? Could this have something to do with Zhang Fei?"
As per Zhang Fei’s order, Jiu Moze went to meet Jiu Mozu’s nine subordinates. Eight of them looked disheveled, except for Jiu Yaoming.
"Have you contacted our master, Ancestor?"
"Yes." Jiu Moze walked before the eight demons from eight different races. "Our master is still in seclusion, and he will come to our domain after he is finished with his seclusion."
"I see." Jiu Yaoming nodded in understanding. "What is our master’s next order, Ancestor?"
"Wait and rebuild our race under my control." Jiu Moze moved quickly and controlled the other eight demons. Thereafter, he freed them and gave them recovery pills. "Rest and wait for my next order."
"Yes." The eight demons immediately left the place.
Jiu Moze walked away. "Let’s go; we have to rearrange everything before our master comes to our domain."
"Yes." Jiu Yaoming followed directly behind Jiu Moze.
"Why are you smiling to yourself?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed in response to Qi Qingxiu’s question. "Jiu Mozu has fallen, and the Nine Nether Demon Race is under Jiu Moze’s control now."
"Huh?" All the women inside the lotus were shocked to hear that. "How—"

Zhang Fei [5] directly explained the situation to them. "Feng Yao helped me enslave Jiu Moze, and I ordered him to usurp Jiu Mozu’s authority in their race. After waiting for three days, that old demon finally succeeded, and I ordered him to control the nine demon races to prevent a major movement."

"Isn’t that amazing?" Nalan Wangzi spoke. "Four of the ten demon races have already sided with you, and you now control the Nine Nether Demon Race. This way, you only need to find a way to attract the other four demon races to your side, and we will fight the Celestial Demon Race if you succeed."

"Your thinking is too simple, Nalan Wangzi." Tianshi Shengjie spoke. "Mo Shentian isn’t the only one with great ambitions to control all the demon races, remember? Shang Zhanluo and several others also want to control the other demon races, so it won’t be easy for Zhang Fei to persuade them."

Tian Huangjin immediately joined in. "Moreover, the Celestial Demon Race still has an ancestor, who is far stronger than Mo Shentian, remember? If that ancient demon were to surface, I’m sure no one could stop him, except for Empress Huo. However, I doubt she will interfere in this matter, so we must proceed much more cautiously when dealing with that demon race, or we will be the ones to die at their hands."
"Yeah, you’re right." Nalan Wangzi nodded in agreement.
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Qi Qingxiu. "Doesn’t your demon race also still have one living ancestor?"

"Nalan Shizhe told you that?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Qi Qingxiu. "The previous demon god of my demon race is still alive, but her strength has continued to decline, and she is no longer as strong as she was in the past. Moreover, she has resigned herself to her fate, and she chose to live away from the hustle and bustle while waiting for her lifespan to end, so you can cross her out of your plans."
"Can’t you persuade her to come back? If—"

"I don’t even know where she is now, so I can’t persuade her." Qi Qingxiu released a helpless sigh. "Moreover, she has never changed her decision once in her life, so I’m sure she will never come back even if we succeed in finding her and persuading her."

chapters.title: Chapter 1367: Exit
paragraphs: "Husband, I think it’s time you got rid of some of them, especially your male slaves in the lower realms." Zhang Lingxue spoke as she emerged from the lake.
Liu Hua also came out of the lake. "You have several slaves in the lower realms, such as Pang Hong, Pang Gui, Mo Zifeng, Zheng Mohei, and Han Ling, right?"
"I left them in Earth, the Tian Realm, and the Xian Realm."

"Back then, you needed them because you weren’t as strong as you are now, but I think you don’t need them anymore; instead, they will be a burden on your soul if you control so many of them." Zhang Lingxue spoke.
Liu Qingyu immediately added. "Moreover, you also already have several slaves from this Paradise Realm, so I think it’s time you got rid of them."

"I agree with them, husband." Zhang Fei looked at Shang Yumei. "I know you still want to use them to protect the lower realms, but I believe they are no longer useful. Therefore, you should get rid of them and replace them with some cultivators from this realm, which will lessen the burden on your soul."
Murong Qianying joined in. "You can use one of them to protect the lower realms, one to protect the middle realms, and another one to protect the upper realms."
"Three people are enough to protect the entire Three Mortal Realms, husband." Hong Xinxin spoke from the lake.

"You guys are right. Even though my soul level is quite high, my slaves in the Three Mortal Realms are still a burden to my soul." Zhang Fei looked at Liu Hua. "Do you want to kill Pang Hong yourself, Hua’er? He controlled you in the past, and he used you to harm Qingyu and the others, so I think it would be better if you were the one to kill him."
Liu Hua thought for a while before agreeing. "Alright, I will kill Pang Hong myself."
"Husband." Zhang Fei looked at Helian Yueyi. "Please don’t kill my son, husband."

"Yueyi, I naturally understand your feelings, so I will not kill Huangfu Lian." Zhang Fei’s answer relieved Helian Yueyi. "Instead, I will do something else to him, and he will never cause chaos in the Nine Stars Realm again."
Helian Yueyi nodded in response. "As long as you don’t kill Lian’er, I have no problem with it."
"What about Huangfu Song and Huangfu Fanbo, husband?" Wei Xiaoya asked.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought about it first. "I’ll get rid of some of my male slaves, except for Huangfu Lian and those mythical beasts. This way, the burden on my soul will be significantly lessened, and I will look for more useful slaves than them in this realm."
"That is indeed the best choice, husband."

Liu Qingyu asked Zhang Fei another question. "What about Mei Xiang, Qiao Ran, and Qiao Fei? Among your female slaves, you never touch the three of them anymore, so I think you should do something about them."
"Among them, only Gu Jinling is still useful to you, especially since she and Gu Changsheng are still helping you create those Gu insects." Hong Xinxin spoke again.

"Mei Xiang, Qiao Ran, and Qiao Fei tried to kill me in the past, and I also needed their yin qi to increase my cultivation, so I enslaved them. Ever since I broke through to the Seven Divine Realms, they’ve been useless to me, so I never touched them again." Zhang Fei paused for a while. "Even though they were like that in the past, their yin qi has helped me a lot. Therefore, I will never get rid of them, and I will send them back to the Sky Jade Realm after I alter their memories so they can live normally again like before."
"Haha." Murong Mengying suddenly laughed. "We often think that you have become too evil, but you still have mercy, husband."
"Isn’t our husband evil, Sister Mengying?" Wang Yourou asked.
"Our husband is evil." Yuan Tianling agreed with Wang Yourou. "However, he only acts evil towards those who target us, right?"
The other women laughed upon hearing that, and then Zhou Shenxin asked Zhang Fei a question. "Are you also going to release Zhou Meiling, my father, and my two brothers, husband?"

Zhang Fei nodded at Zhou Shenxin. "Just like Huangfu Lian, they’re your family, so I won’t kill them. As for Zhou Xiaochuan and his other wives, I initially thought about getting rid of them, but I think I shouldn’t do that."
"Do whatever you want with them, husband."

Hong Xinxin suddenly remembered someone. "Husband, you sent Mo Xuanxing to me in the past, and I left her in the Red Sun Realm. She wants to help you, but you clearly have no interest in her, so you have to do something for her."

"Mo Xuanxing, huh?" Zhang Fei didn’t enslave her in the past, and he only imprisoned her in the Yin-Yang Space with several other women. However, he had already released all of his old prisoners, including her.

After their discussion, Zhang Fei’s three clones immediately went to the Three Mortal Realms. Zhang Fei [1] went to Earth and two other realms, Feltia [2] went to the Nine Stars Realm, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] went to the Grand Royal Realm.

Zhang Fei [1] sent Pang Hong to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, where Liu Hua killed the old man. After he killed all his male slaves there, he sent Mei Xiang, Qiao Ran, and Qiao Fei to the Sky Jade Realm. He left the three women there after altering some of their memories, ensuring they would not remember anything about their past experiences.

Feltia [2] did not kill Huangfu Lian, Huangfu Ziyuan, and the people of the Zhou Kingdom. He also did not kill the prince of the Dark Demon Kingdom, Ximen Hongwu. He altered their memories and left them in that realm, ensuring that they wouldn’t create chaos there.

In the Grand Royal Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] went straight to the Huangfu Kingdom, but he did not meet Huangfu Zhixian. After he altered the memories of the people of that kingdom, he went straight to the Sky Dragon Realm, where he freed three people from the assassin group.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] also went to the Red Sun Realm to meet Mo Xuanxing and talk to her, but he still had no intention of taking her with him. He offered her to forget all those memories, but she refused him and accepted his decision to leave her in the realm.

This way, Zhang Fei’s slaves from the Three Mortal Realms were left with only seven: Long Qiang and Long Jiuxiao from the dragon race, Huli Jinhu from the golden fox race, Wang Wugui and Wang Yitao from the black tortoise race, and Dai Hubai and Dai Yishu from the white tiger race. After all, they were mythical beasts, and they were still useful to him, so he kept them in his beast space.
Zhang Fei’s only remaining female slave was Gu Jinling, especially since he still needed her to create those Gu insects.
After everything was settled, Zhang Fei’s three clones returned to the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, starting dual cultivation and dual-soul cultivation with their respective wives.

After all his wives had a few days of fun, Zhang Fei began dual cultivation and dual-soul cultivation with them again. He wanted to open his new shop in the Paradise Realm soon, but he put that aside for now, fully focused on helping his wives.
A week later, the giant Yin-Yang Lotus finally stopped absorbing their soul power; the most relieved among them were Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin.
Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin hurriedly emerged from the lotus and dressed, and Zhang Fei [5] sent the two women back to the Moonlit Passion Temple along with all the female elders.

Since she had been absent from her domain for too long, Qi Qingxiu also decided to leave the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain. However, she asked Zhang Fei [5] to meet her at her palace once he completed his seclusion, to which he agreed.

After the two souls of the lotus told him that the lotus would not absorb their soul power for now, Zhang Fei [5] brought Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling to join his other two wives, Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing, at the lake.

Nalan Wangzi also went to the lake to join Zhang Fei and the others, but he was still focused on his other wives. She cultivated manually by the lake, taking advantage of the power of Yin Qi in that domain.

After she left the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, Qi Qingxiu didn’t immediately return to her domain; instead, she went to see Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran to inquire about what had happened in all the demon domains during her absence.
Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran explained many things to Qi Qingxiu, which relieved her that there had been no significant movement from Mo Shentian and the other demon gods.

Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran were shocked and delighted after Qi Qingxiu told them about the situation in the Nine Nether Demon Race, and the three of them began to devise some other plans while waiting for Zhang Fei to come out of his seclusion.

Another three weeks passed quickly; Zhang Fei decided to take everyone away from the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain, especially after the two souls of the lotus reminded him that there was a slight change in the domain that could impact their cultivation.
"You guys are finally back."
