"Oh?" Zhang Fei was taken aback after reading the description. "I didn’t expect that your technique was actually a soul technique."
Wu Mian smiled at that. "Don’t you already know that the soul of a living being is the most essential part of us?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "As long as we can suppress and control other people’s souls, we will always have the upper hand over them, and we can control them freely. I use a similar method to yours, but I can’t take over their bodies like you, and I can only make them obey me like this woman."

Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "To use my technique, you simply need to condense your soul power into a fine soul thread, and you must inject it into your target’s body, as I did with this woman just now. After that, you can take over your target’s body at any time, and your target will not remember the events that occurred while you were controlling their body."
"I see." Zhang Fei moved before Mo Yousha. "Will it be a problem if I inject my soul thread into this woman?"
"No." Wu Mian shook his head in response. "However, you won’t be able to take over her body while I’m controlling her, and vice versa."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before condensing his soul power into a soul thread, and he injected it into Mo Yousha’s body through her forehead. A strange symbol briefly appeared at that spot, similar to what Wu Mian had done earlier, before vanishing without a trace.
"You can use my technique instantly, huh?" Wu Mian muttered in a daze.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly. "My comprehension is much higher than that of other living beings, and I’ve learned many more complex techniques before, so it’s not that difficult for me to use your technique."

Wu Mian helplessly shook his head. "It took me a thousand years to create and perfect that technique, but you can use it right away, which makes me think I’m too stupid compared to you. Now that my business is complete, I will return to my domain. You can contact me again if you need my help."
"Thank you." Wu Mian simply nodded before disappearing, and Zhang Fei immediately ordered Mo Yousha to return to the Heavenly Fiend Demon Domain so that Mo Shentian would not suspect her.
Qi Qingxiu walked to Zhang Fei and questioned him. "Who are you going to give those demon items to?

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei naturally prioritized his main harem members over his clones’ harem members. "In my main harem, there are seven female demon beasts, but Yao Qilin and Fei Lian have already reached the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, so they are no longer needed. My choice now is between Zhang Lin, Ru Xue, Zhang Lingxue, and Feng Yichen."

Since Qi Qingxiu had not met all of Zhang Fei’s wives, she still did not know the demon identities of the four women, but he immediately explained it to her. "I know about the Dark Phoenix, but I have never heard of the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon Demon Beast, the Celestial Dragon Demon Beast, or the Phoenix Devourer Demon Beast. Since the last three beasts are the only ones in their respective races, I think you should help one of them first."
"I think so." Zhang Fei considered his choice among the three women. "Back then, I gave the Nine Petals Phantom Soul Lotus to Ru Xue, so I’ll choose between Zhang Lin and Zhang Lingxue."

"Their demon races are unique and powerful, but I think you should give those demon items to Zhang Lin first." Zhang Fei looked at Qi Qingxiu questioningly. "I don’t know why, but I feel that the Abyssal Leviathan Dragon Demon Beast should be stronger than the Phoenix Devourer Demon Beast. Moreover, you will never forget all your wives, and I believe you will help them all, so I think she is the best choice for now."

"Naturally, I will never forget them, and I will always help them reach greater heights." Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal to the training space after his fifth clone sent his little sister inside, and he hurriedly summoned Zhang Lin out from within.
"Eh?" Zhang Lin was surprised as she looked around the palace. "Is this your palace, Big Sis Qingxiu?"
Qi Qingxiu nodded at Zhang Lin with a smile. "I still didn’t expect you to be a unique demon beast, and you’re the only one of your kin."

"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed at that. "Back then, I was an ordinary human, just like my brother. However, he turned me into a demon beast by using Serpentera’s bloodline and body parts, and I have lived as one ever since."

"Use them, Lin’er." Zhang Lin received the five demon items from Zhang Fei with an expression full of joy. "As you think, these items will help you break through to the Seven Supreme Demon Rank, and you will evolve like me once you reach the Demon Monarch Rank."
"In that case, I will return to the pavilion now, and I will use these demon items there." After saying that, Zhang Lin hurriedly entered the training space again.

Zhang Fei naturally wouldn’t leave Zhang Lin unsupervised while she was going through the process, and his third clone immediately went there to watch over her while carrying out seclusion with his two wives, Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian.
Thereafter, Qi Qingxiu took Zhang Fei back to her room, where they began dual cultivating again. They weren’t just dual cultivating, but they were also dual-soul cultivating.

"Yingzhi." Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "I’ve found the palace, and it really is in the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Domain. However, my acquaintance couldn’t inspect the palace up close, so he doesn’t know whether your family is there or not. Additionally, Qian Yan currently resides there, and he is too powerful for me, so I do not dare to go there to investigate."
"Master." Xin Yanluo took Ju Yingzhi’s hand.

"Yeah." Ju Yingzhi sighed softly and spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Although you haven’t been able to find my family, I’m relieved that you’ve found the palace. I’m aware of our limitations, so I’ll wait patiently until we have the strength to go to that domain, and I’ll look for my family there then."
Zhang Fei [5] pulled Ju Yingzhi into his arms. "I will definitely help you find your family, and we will save them if they are still alive."
"Thank you."

"Zhang Fei."
Zhang Fei [5] released Ju Yingzhi from his embrace and looked at Morgana. "What’s wrong?"
"We need your help." Morgana pulled Oz the First in front of Zhang Fei [5] and explained the situation to him. "What do you think about that?"

Zhang Fei [5] seriously looked at Oz the First; he himself had long been curious about the chained soul in his body. "If you are confident and ready to open those chains, I think there is no problem with that. Compared to the Wailing Soul Forest, I think the Endless Domain will be the best choice for you to hide in if Mo Shentian notices your presence in this Paradise Realm."
"Do you have plans to go to the Endless Domain?" Morgana asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response. "I planned to go to that domain after my real body finished his isolation with Qi Qingxiu, but I can speed up my plans if your husband wants to open those chains."
"I see." Morgana turned to her husband. "Are you completely ready to open those chains?"

"I have no other choice, right?" Oz the First sighed. "Senior Qingxiu said that the dark shadow is a part of me, and someone deliberately sealed it for some reason. Even if I’m not ready, I must still be, and I will regain my true identity."

Zhang Fei [5] spoke to them directly. "Since Qingxiu already said that the black shadow won’t give you any trouble, you don’t need to hesitate to open the chains. However, I’m curious about Oz the Second, especially since he is a celestial demon like you."
"Do you think Oz the Second is also a celestial demon from this realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I know of the black shadow in your soul for some reason, but I don’t know anything about Oz the Second. Moreover, Feng Yao once said that there were no other Celestial Demons in the Three Mortal Realms, so I think he also came from this realm. However, I don’t understand how the two of you ended up in the Diyu Realm, but you arrived there much earlier than him."
Oz the First nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [5]. "How about you bring Oz the Second to Senior Qingxiu? Since she can detect the black shadow in my body, she probably knows something about him."
"I’ll do that after they finish their isolation." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered something. "Before I take you two to the Wailing Soul Forest, we will go to the Nine Nether Demon Domain first."
"Huh?" Both Oz the First and Morgana were shocked to hear that.
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed as he grabbed their shoulders. "The Nine Nether Demon God has fallen into my hands, and my slave manages the domain for me now."
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Nine Nether Demon Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
Upon their arrival at the domain, Zhang Fei [5] brought Morgana and Oz the First to Jiu Mozu’s palace.

"Master." Jiu Moze and Jiu Yaoming respectfully greeted Zhang Fei [5], but they were confused once they recognized Oz the First’s identity. "Master, why did you bring a Celestial Demon into this domain?"

"He is not Mo Shentian’s subordinate, and he is my friend from the Three Mortal Realms." Jiu Moze and Jiu Yaoming were surprised to hear that, but they themselves didn’t know the situation outside the Paradise Realm. Moreover, Zhang Fei [5] was their master, so they did not doubt his words. "Lead me to Jiu Mozu’s prison."
"Please follow me, Master." The three of them immediately followed Jiu Moze.

Jiu Mozu frowned as soon as Jiu Moze led them into the prison, and he immediately recognized Zhang Fei [5] because Jiu Yaoming had given him his image. "So, you are the one behind my master’s betrayal, huh?"

"Unfortunately, your guess is half right." Jiu Mozu did not believe Zhang Fei [5] because Jiu Moze looked obedient and respectful towards him. "I couldn’t do anything to him because he was much stronger than me, but I was lucky because Huo Yanling helped me defeat him."
"What?" Jiu Mozu screamed in shock.
"Shut up!" Zhang Fei [5] picked his ear while shaking his head. "I didn’t come here to talk to you, and your fate has been sealed since you fell into my hands."
"What are you going to do to me?" Jiu Mozu asked in fear as soon as Zhang Fei [5] pressed his palm against his chest, and the faint grin on his face frightened him even more. "I—Argh."
Jiu Mozu screamed in pain as Zhang Fei [5] used his devouring abilities to absorb his cultivation, soul power, and life force.

Although Jiu Mozu was already helpless, he was still incredibly powerful as a demon god, with his cultivation having reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. Therefore, Zhang Fei [5] had to weaken him first before he could proceed with his plans against him, and his devouring abilities were his best option to do so.
"Argh! Stop! Argh! You’re going to kill me." Jiu Mozu’s face quickly became deathly pale, and parts of his body began to wrinkle.

Morgana and Oz the First could only shake their heads, but they were already used to Zhang Fei [5]’s cruel actions toward his enemies, making them no longer surprised by his actions against the Jiu Mozu.
[You gained 500,000,000 demon essences from the Jiu Mozu.]
[You gained 500,000,000 Qi from the Jiu Mozu.]

[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]

’500,000,000 each is quite a lot, but the amount I need to break through to the Celestial Emperor Realm and the Demon Venerable Rank is much more than that.’ After Jiu Mozu weakened significantly, Zhang Fei [5] forcibly pulled his soul out of his body, and he was relieved to find that there was no darkness in his soul like in Jiu Moze’s.
Zhang Fei [5] replicated Jiu Mozu’s soul and merged it with his, and he returned his soul afterwards.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] used his memory manipulation ability on Jiu Mozu, altering some of his memories to make him loyal to him. This way, he has two demon gods under his control, and he will be better prepared to face the other demon gods, especially Mo Shentian.
"Release him."
"Yes, Master." Jiu Moze hurriedly released Jiu Mozu, and Zhang Fei [5] gave them some pills to strengthen themselves. "Thank you, Master."

"Hey! Do you have a special place that Mo Shentian can’t detect?" Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu exchanged glances for a moment before shaking their heads at Zhang Fei [5], disappointing him. "In that case, you two can leave and await my further orders."
"Yes, Master."
After they left, Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Soul Devouring Demon before bringing Morgana and Oz the First inside.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t bother with the remaining two daily quests, especially since his other clones could complete them. He didn’t bother contacting Nalan Shizhe, and he used the demon-piercing eye ability he mimicked from Jiu Yaoming to bring Oz the First and Morgana into the Wailing Soul Forest.

Unlike the first time he went to the forest, Zhang Fei [5] was able to bring the two demons to the heart of the forest quickly because he was already familiar with the area within, coupled with the help of the demon-piercing eye ability.
"Release the black shadow and take out the key."
Oz the First released the chained black shadow, and Morgana took out the black key. "Are you ready, husband?"
"Yes." After Oz the First prepared himself, Morgana immediately inserted the black key into the lock hole in front of those chains, causing them to break one by one.

Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Morgana’s shoulder and carried her away from Oz the First as a black aura began to envelop his body. He activated his soul domain, sword domain, and light domain. "Hmm? His aura is similar to Mo Shentian’s aura."
"Is that true?" Morgana’s gaze locked onto her husband.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Morgana. "This proves that Qi Qingxiu’s guess is correct, and your husband really has a relationship with Mo Shentian."
"What do you think will happen to my husband? Will his character change?" Morgana was truly afraid that Oz the First would change after he regained his true identity.
Zhang Fei [5] observed Oz the First. "I can’t say anything, and we’ll just have to wait until the process is complete to find out whether his character will change or not."
"Yeah."
*Bam*

Mo Shentian looked panicked. "How did the seal that my master placed on that person’s soul break? Could it be that he managed to find the key to open the seal? I should have killed him at that time! If he manages to return to this realm, he will hunt me to kill me."

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] used his memory manipulation ability on Jiu Mozu, altering some of his memories to make him loyal to him.
This way, he has two demon gods under his control, and he will be better prepared to face the other demon gods, especially Mo Shentian.
"Release him."
"Yes, Master." Jiu Moze hurriedly released Jiu Mozu, and Zhang Fei [5] gave them some pills to strengthen themselves.
"Thank you, Master."
"Hey!
Do you have a special place that Mo Shentian can’t detect?" Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu exchanged glances for a moment before shaking their heads at Zhang Fei [5], disappointing him.
"In that case, you two can leave and await my further orders."
"Yes, Master."
After they left, Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Soul Devouring Demon before bringing Morgana and Oz the First inside.
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t bother with the remaining two daily quests, especially since his other clones could complete them.
He didn’t bother contacting Nalan Shizhe, and he used the demon-piercing eye ability he mimicked from Jiu Yaoming to bring Oz the First and Morgana into the Wailing Soul Forest.

Unlike the first time he went to the forest, Zhang Fei [5] was able to bring the two demons to the heart of the forest quickly because he was already familiar with the area within, coupled with the help of the demon-piercing eye ability.
"Release the black shadow and take out the key."
Oz the First released the chained black shadow, and Morgana took out the black key.
"Are you ready, husband?"
"Yes." After Oz the First prepared himself, Morgana immediately inserted the black key into the lock hole in front of those chains, causing them to break one by one.
Zhang Fei [5] grabbed Morgana’s shoulder and carried her away from Oz the First as a black aura began to envelop his body.
He activated his soul domain, sword domain, and light domain.
"Hmm?
His aura is similar to Mo Shentian’s aura."
"Is that true?" Morgana’s gaze locked onto her husband.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Morgana.
"This proves that Qi Qingxiu’s guess is correct, and your husband really has a relationship with Mo Shentian."
"What do you think will happen to my husband?
Will his character change?" Morgana was truly afraid that Oz the First would change after he regained his true identity.
Zhang Fei [5] observed Oz the First.
"I can’t say anything, and we’ll just have to wait until the process is complete to find out whether his character will change or not."
"Yeah."
*Bam*
Mo Shentian looked panicked.
"How did the seal that my master placed on that person’s soul break?
Could it be that he managed to find the key to open the seal?
I should have killed him at that time!
If he manages to return to this realm, he will hunt me to kill me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1375: Oz The First’s True Identity
paragraphs: "Master." An old male demon, who was meditating, immediately opened his eyes and looked at Mo Shentian. "Master, we’re in big trouble! The seal you placed on Mo Taishen’s soul has been broken."

The old male demon frowned upon hearing that. "Back then, Long Wuzhao and his two brothers intercepted me just as I was about to descend to the Three Mortal Realms, and I felt overwhelmed by the need to fight them all at once. Therefore, I was forced to send Mo Taishen there randomly, and I also threw the key through a different tunnel. I believed that he and the key would never be able to meet each other, but I didn’t expect the seal to finally be broken."
"What should we do, Master? If Mo Taishen returns to this realm, he will definitely hunt me down to kill me." Mo Shentian spoke in panic.

"Why are you so afraid of Mo Taishen?" The old male demon responded with a shake of his head. "When I sealed his soul, his cultivation had not yet broken through to the Seven Divine Realms, and his demon rank had not yet reached the emperor Rank. Moreover, the flow of time in the Three Mortal Realms was much slower than in this Paradise Realm, remember? I’m sure his cultivation and demon rank should still be far below yours, so you don’t need to be afraid of him at all."

Mo Shentian released a heavy sigh. "Master, I am not afraid of Mo Taishen, but I am afraid if my predecessor finds out about our actions against him in the past. I am indeed the current demon god of our race, but that old man is much stronger than me, and he will be furious if he finds out anything."

"You’re right." The old male demon nodded in agreement. "If we hadn’t gotten rid of Mo Taishen back then, Mo Shangren would have chosen him as his successor because he cared much more about him than you. Fortunately, we managed to cover everything up well; otherwise, we would have died at his hands long ago, and he was forced to choose you as his successor because there was no one else who could match your talent in our demon race."

Mo Shentian had never felt such deep fear in his life. "So, what should we do now? Can you track Taishen’s whereabouts? Whatever the cost, we have to kill him before he becomes too strong and attracts Mo Shangren’s attention, or we will both die at the hands of my predecessor."

"Unfortunately, I can’t descend to the Three Mortal Realms, so I can’t trace Mo Taishen’s whereabouts." Mo Shentian naturally understood the old male demon’s reasons. "Since you can’t descend to that realm either, you must send low-rank demons with cultivation at the peak of the Seven Divine Realms there and order them to search for Mo Tianshen’s whereabouts in all the demon realms there."
"Alright! I’ll arrange everything now." Mo Shentian hurriedly left the place.

The old male demon looked at the exit, frowned deeply, and thought about something. "How could the key fall into Mo Taishen’s hands? Back then, I wanted to kill him, but Mo Shangren would have noticed my action, so I was forced to seal his soul. I sent him and the key to the Three Mortal Realms through two different tunnels, and those realms were too vast. The chances of him finding their key should have been slim to none, but he managed to find it and open the seal."
The old male demon decided to leave his place to search for Mo Taishen’s whereabouts, even though he doubted that he would be able to return to the Paradise Realm.
After they waited for some time, Zhang Fei [5] and Morgana saw the black aura that had previously enveloped Oz the First’s body disappear completely, but they didn’t see any changes in him.
Morgana hurriedly approached her husband. "Husband."

"Sorry to worry you, wife." Morgana was truly relieved to hear that, and she immediately embraced Oz the First. He looked at Zhang Fei [5] and spoke to him. "My true identity is Mo Taishen, and I am Mo Shentian’s little brother."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] and Morgana were equally shocked to hear that.
Morgana looked up at her husband. "Are you really Mo Shentian’s little brother, husband?"

"Yes." Mo Taishen nodded to his wife. "Long ago, the previous celestial demon god, Mo Shangren, chose me as his successor. However, Mo Shentian couldn’t accept it because he was stronger than me at that time, and he felt that he was more worthy of becoming the next demon god than me. Therefore, he and his master, Mo Zhejun, worked together to get rid of me. That old demon sealed my soul and identity, and he sent me to the Three Mortal Realms. At that time, I fell into the Diyu Realm, and you already know the rest of the story."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked him. "If Mo Zhejun and Mo Shentian deliberately sealed you to get rid of you, why did they leave the key to open the seal with you?"

"You’re wrong about that." Mo Taishen responded with a shake of his head. "The black key wasn’t with me from the start, and I discovered it after I became the demon emperor of the Diyu Realm. When I found the key, the chained black shadow suddenly emerged from within my body, and I felt a connection between the two. However, I didn’t dare to open the seal for fear of changing my character, so I gave the key to Tharnon."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Since your true identity is like this, and they sealed it to get rid of you from this realm, I’m afraid they’ve already noticed your return. If you return to my sect, you will give me a lot of trouble, so you have to hide in another domain to avoid them. Although this forest is protected by many formations and natural traps, I think you shouldn’t hide here, and the Endless Domain will be much better for you."
"Yes." Mo Taishen immediately agreed.
Morgana looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "What exactly is your purpose for going to the Endless Domain?"

"Wang Yin." Morgana was surprised to hear that name from Zhang Fei [5]. "I received information from someone that Yuan Xiajie sent her and several other women to that domain, and I already know their location, so I will go there to pick her up."

"Are you sure Wang Yin will return to you?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Morgana. "Have you forgotten that Yuan Xiajie tampered with her memories before? She made her infatuated with you, even though she originally had no feelings for you. Therefore, I think she may have erased her memories of you this time, and she probably won’t remember you anymore."

Zhang Fei [5] released a soft sigh. "Regardless of the outcome, I will meet Wang Yin first. If Yuan Xiajie does something like that to her, I will hunt her down in the future, and I will make her regret her decision for the rest of her life."
"I have no doubt that you are capable of doing that." Mo Taishen nodded in agreement with Morgana. "Let’s go to the Endless Domain now, and you can take us to see Wang Yin first."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] approached Mo Taishen and touched his chest. "Since many demons in the Endless Domain hate your celestial demon race, I will change your appearance so that they will not recognize your true identity."
Mo Taishen nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Thank you."
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Endless Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

As soon as they arrived at the Endless Domain, they were immediately trapped in a powerful illusion. However, it wasn’t a big deal for Zhang Fei [5], and the illusion disappeared instantly once he used his illusion negation ability. He used the demon-piercing eye ability, especially since the domain also had many traps.
"So, where is Wang Yin now?" Morgana asked.
"I will take you two there." Zhang Fei [5] enveloped them with his aura and used the nine cloud steps.
In a few minutes, they arrived not far from a rocky mountain, but they saw nothing there.
"Are you sure Wang Yin is here?" Mo Taishen tried to scan the area around the mountain with his senses.

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "You can’t see the entrance, but I can see it clearly, and Wang Yin is inside this mountain with several other women. However, I detect something unusual about their location, and the flow of Qi towards that place is really fast, making the concentration of Qi there really high."
"Is it due to the influence of some kind of qi-gathering formation array?"
"I think so." Zhang Fei [5] guided the two to the entrance, shielded by a concealment formation that prevented others from discovering it.

Since the area inside the mountain was dark, Zhang Fei [5] used his light element to illuminate their surroundings, allowing them to see the circular staircase leading down. However, they couldn’t see the bottom, especially since the area was too dark.

"Be careful." Zhang Fei [5] examined the inside of the mountain through the map. "There are many traps leading down there; I think Yuan Xiajie deliberately set them up just in case others manage to discover this place."

chapters.title: Chapter 1376: Meeting Yuan Xiajie Again
paragraphs: With the help of the map and the demon-piercing eye ability, Zhang Fei [5] was able to lead Morgana and Mo Taishen through the formations and traps within the mountain much more easily. They finally reached the bottom of the area, where Wang Yin, Bian Zhizhu, Nong Qinhua, and two other women were seriously cultivating.

Based on the system, Zhang Fei [5] discovered that their names were Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua, and their cultivation was at the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm. The former was the Phantom Nightmare Demon, and the latter was the Frozen Enchantress Demon.

Zhang Fei [5] discovered that the cultivation of Wang Yin, Bian Zhizhu, and Nong Qinhua had also reached the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm. He was not surprised by the cultivation speed of the last two women, especially since their cultivation had already reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm when they last met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm.

However, Wang Yin’s cultivation surprised Zhang Fei [5] because her cultivation was still at the 1-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm when they last met, but she had already reached that realm. Additionally, her race was no longer an ordinary undead demon but an undead demon monarch, which means her demon rank had broken through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks.
’Wang Yin is an undead demon, and Yuan Xiajie used an ancient method to improve her cultivation.’ Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly as Feng Yao spoke into his mind.
’Why does Yuan Xiajie only choose female demons or demon beasts?’ Zhang Fei [5] wondered.

’Demon beasts are physically stronger than ordinary beasts and humans, remember?’ Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Feng Yao. ’Undead demons are almost invincible as long as their bodies aren’t destroyed, so Yuan Xiajie chose Wang Yin because of that. Nong Qinhua is a Yin demon, and she possesses an exceptionally high level of Yin Qi. She probably chose Bian Zhizhu not because she is a Soul-Weaver Spider Demon but because of her second identity as Bian Luosha, the Nether Spider Queen. I don’t know her reason for choosing the Phantom Nightmare Demon and the Frost Enchantress Demon, but the abilities of both their demon races are quite impressive.’

From the system, Zhang Fei [5] could see that the abilities of the two demon were interesting, especially the latter. ’Hey, Feng Yao! Can you please help me stop Yuan Xiajie? I don’t want her to kidnap Wang Yin again, but I can’t defeat her with my current strength. Moreover, Bian Zhizhu or Bian Luosha, has made Liu Qingyu and her three daughters suffer because of Chu Hong’s death, so I want to kill her.’

’Sigh.’ Feng Yao sighed in Zhang Fei [5]’s mind. ’I understand your desire to help your four wives take revenge against her, but I think killing her will only be a loss for you; instead, you can control her and use her to your advantage.’

Zhang Fei [5] reread the information about the abilities of Bian Zhizhu and Bian Luosha that Mei had saved since they first met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. ’Her abilities to summon spiderlings, create a web domain, and detect enemies are indeed beneficial. I can place her in the forest to monitor the situation there, and she can detect enemies trying to break into my domain.’
’See? Bian Luosha’s identity as the Nether Spider Queen is beneficial to you, right? If you can use her, then why do you have to kill her?’
’Yeah.’ Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. ’So, are you going to help me release them from Yuan Xiajie’s control?’
’Sure.’
Zhang Fei [5] was satisfied to hear Feng Yao agree, and he looked at the two people behind him. "Let’s meet them."
"What if that woman suddenly appears, Zhang Fei?" Morgana asked after she remembered when Yuan Xiajie kidnapped Wang Yin back then.
"Don’t worry about her." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and brought them down to the bottom, but a barrier stopped him from approaching Wang Yin and the others. "Such a powerful barrier."
*Swoosh*

A small crimson flame shot out from Zhang Fei [5]’s body and broke the barrier instantly, making him overjoyed. Morgana and Mo Taishen exchanged glances after seeing that, but Yuan Xiajie suddenly appeared in front of the five women.

Yuan Xiajie didn’t say anything and fiercely glared at Zhang Fei [5], but she was also shocked when she felt that his cultivation had reached such a high level. ’How is it possible that he has reached this level? Moreover, how did he find this place?’
"We finally meet again, Yuan Xiajie." Zhang Fei [5] calmly spoke. "Back then, I was afraid of you, but I won’t be afraid of you anymore."
Yuan Xiajie frowned and released her aura, but it disappeared by itself, shocking her again. "How—"
"Release them." Yuan Xiajie instinctively took a step back as soon as Feng Yao appeared between her and Zhang Fei [5]. "I won’t repeat myself."

"I’ve heard about the destruction of your Yuan Clan, and I suspect their killer was the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhuo." Yuan Xiajie looked at Feng Yao in disbelief. "Someone told me they died in their sleep, so I’m sure he was their killer. I understand your desire for revenge, but you will never win against him. Even Puyang Shenmi and the cultivators in her generation couldn’t defeat him, let alone a weak little girl like you."
"How—"

"I won’t explain it to you in more detail." Feng Yao pointed to the five female demons behind Yuan Xiajie. "Free them now, or I’ll make you regret it. Don’t think you can escape from me; I can find you wherever you hide."

Yuan Xiajie clenched her fists tightly as she still remembered the horror she felt when Feng Yao first appeared before her several years ago, and she was fully aware that she was no match for her. However, she needed these five women for her plans, so she was reluctant to let them go.
Feng Yao summoned the eternal flame, causing Yuan Xiajie to break out in a cold sweat. "Don’t test my patience. If you don’t want to die, you must free them now."
Yuan Xiajie gritted her teeth, as she didn’t want to die. Although she was reluctant to free the five women, she had no choice but to do so, and she hurriedly freed them from her control. "Done."
"Leave." Yuan Xiajie glared hatefully at Zhang Fei [5], but she said nothing to him and disappeared from the place, fearing that Feng Yao would actually kill her. "It’s all up to you now."
"Thank you." After Feng Yao turned into a flame and re-entered his body, Zhang Fei [5] approached Wang Yin, who was starting to open her eyes. "Wake up?"
"Eh?" Wang Yin stared at Zhang Fei [5] with her eyes blinking repeatedly. "Who are you? What are you doing here?"
Bian Zhizhu and Nong Qinhua couldn’t recognize Zhang Fei [5] either, and both of them stared at him in confusion.

Since they had never met Zhang Fei [5] before, Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua didn’t think much of him, but they were confused by their situation, especially since Yuan Xiajie had previously controlled them.

’That bitch altered her memories again.’ Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly suppressed his anger and helped Wang Yin up. "Yin’er, I came here specifically to look for you, and I’m happy because I managed to find you after you disappeared for several years. You may not remember me now, but you are my woman."
"Huh?" Wang Yin was shocked to hear that. "How could I be your woman? You have to be joking with me, right? I remember for sure that I have never met you before."
"Zhang Fei [5] is really your man."
Wang Yin looked at Morgana. "Who are you? Do we know each other?"
"The two of us are old friends." Morgana’s answer confused Wang Yin further. "A woman kidnapped you several years ago, and she deliberately erased your memories of us."

"I’ll show you everything, Yin’er." Zhang Fei [5] touched Wang Yin’s forehead and shared many of his memories with her, from their first meeting in the Nine Hells Darkland Domain to Yuan Xiajie kidnapping her in the Abyssal Realm. "You can see everything first, and you’ll know that I didn’t lie to you about our relationship."

Curious, Wang Yin hurriedly closed her eyes and looked at all of Hang Fei [5]’s memories. The first to appear were memories of their first meeting at the soul pond, which was located in the Nine Hells Darkland Domain. After that, they didn’t see each other for several months, and their second meeting was when he came to her realm, the Demon Purgatory Realm.

In the second memory, Wang Yin saw herself bringing Zhang Fei [5] to one of the areas in her palace, where Nalan Yushu helped Ling Xiannu take over the corpse of a female demon who was born on the night when the Yin reached its peak.

Thereafter, Wang Yin saw many other memories, especially when Zhang Fei [5] and his other wives lived in her palace. However, those memories stopped after he obtained the Blood Flame, especially since she went on an adventure afterward.

Wang Yin tried to recall her memories of everything that happened after they parted that day, but she couldn’t remember anything. She blushed when she saw Zhang Fei’s [5] next memory, which was about their first dual cultivation. ’Did we really do that in the past?’

’Wang Yin is an undead demon, and Yuan Xiajie used an ancient method to improve her cultivation.’ Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly as Feng Yao spoke into his mind.
’Why does Yuan Xiajie only choose female demons or demon beasts?’ Zhang Fei [5] wondered.

’Demon beasts are physically stronger than ordinary beasts and humans, remember?’ Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Feng Yao. ’Undead demons are almost invincible as long as their bodies aren’t destroyed, so Yuan Xiajie chose Wang Yin because of that.
Nong Qinhua is a Yin demon, and she possesses an exceptionally high level of Yin Qi.
She probably chose Bian Zhizhu not because she is a Soul-Weaver Spider Demon but because of her second identity as Bian Luosha, the Nether Spider Queen.
I don’t know her reason for choosing the Phantom Nightmare Demon and the Frost Enchantress Demon, but the abilities of both their demon races are quite impressive.’
From the system, Zhang Fei [5] could see that the abilities of the two demon were interesting, especially the latter. ’Hey, Feng Yao!
Can you please help me stop Yuan Xiajie?
I don’t want her to kidnap Wang Yin again, but I can’t defeat her with my current strength.
Moreover, Bian Zhizhu or Bian Luosha, has made Liu Qingyu and her three daughters suffer because of Chu Hong’s death, so I want to kill her.’

’Sigh.’ Feng Yao sighed in Zhang Fei [5]’s mind. ’I understand your desire to help your four wives take revenge against her, but I think killing her will only be a loss for you; instead, you can control her and use her to your advantage.’

Zhang Fei [5] reread the information about the abilities of Bian Zhizhu and Bian Luosha that Mei had saved since they first met in the Sovereign Heaven Realm. ’Her abilities to summon spiderlings, create a web domain, and detect enemies are indeed beneficial.
I can place her in the forest to monitor the situation there, and she can detect enemies trying to break into my domain.’
’See?
Bian Luosha’s identity as the Nether Spider Queen is beneficial to you, right?
If you can use her, then why do you have to kill her?’

"Don’t worry about her." Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and brought them down to the bottom, but a barrier stopped him from approaching Wang Yin and the others.
"Such a powerful barrier."
*Swoosh*

Morgana and Mo Taishen exchanged glances after seeing that, but Yuan Xiajie suddenly appeared in front of the five women.

Yuan Xiajie didn’t say anything and fiercely glared at Zhang Fei [5], but she was also shocked when she felt that his cultivation had reached such a high level. ’How is it possible that he has reached this level?
Moreover, how did he find this place?’
"We finally meet again, Yuan Xiajie." Zhang Fei [5] calmly spoke.

Yuan Xiajie frowned and released her aura, but it disappeared by itself, shocking her again.
"How—"

"I won’t repeat myself."
"I’ve heard about the destruction of your Yuan Clan, and I suspect their killer was the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhuo." Yuan Xiajie looked at Feng Yao in disbelief.

I understand your desire for revenge, but you will never win against him.
Even Puyang Shenmi and the cultivators in her generation couldn’t defeat him, let alone a weak little girl like you."
"How—"
"I won’t explain it to you in more detail." Feng Yao pointed to the five female demons behind Yuan Xiajie.
"Free them now, or I’ll make you regret it.
Don’t think you can escape from me; I can find you wherever you hide."

However, she needed these five women for her plans, so she was reluctant to let them go.
Feng Yao summoned the eternal flame, causing Yuan Xiajie to break out in a cold sweat.
"Don’t test my patience.
If you don’t want to die, you must free them now."
Yuan Xiajie gritted her teeth, as she didn’t want to die.
Although she was reluctant to free the five women, she had no choice but to do so, and she hurriedly freed them from her control.
"Done."
"Leave." Yuan Xiajie glared hatefully at Zhang Fei [5], but she said nothing to him and disappeared from the place, fearing that Feng Yao would actually kill her.
"It’s all up to you now."

"Wake up?"

"Who are you?
What are you doing here?"
Bian Zhizhu and Nong Qinhua couldn’t recognize Zhang Fei [5] either, and both of them stared at him in confusion.

Since they had never met Zhang Fei [5] before, Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua didn’t think much of him, but they were confused by their situation, especially since Yuan Xiajie had previously controlled them.
’That bitch altered her memories again.’ Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly suppressed his anger and helped Wang Yin up.
"Yin’er, I came here specifically to look for you, and I’m happy because I managed to find you after you disappeared for several years.
You may not remember me now, but you are my woman."
"Huh?" Wang Yin was shocked to hear that.
"How could I be your woman?
You have to be joking with me, right?
I remember for sure that I have never met you before."
"Zhang Fei [5] is really your man."
Wang Yin looked at Morgana.
"Who are you?
Do we know each other?"
"The two of us are old friends." Morgana’s answer confused Wang Yin further.
"A woman kidnapped you several years ago, and she deliberately erased your memories of us."

Curious, Wang Yin hurriedly closed her eyes and looked at all of Hang Fei [5]’s memories.
The first to appear were memories of their first meeting at the soul pond, which was located in the Nine Hells Darkland Domain.
After that, they didn’t see each other for several months, and their second meeting was when he came to her realm, the Demon Purgatory Realm.

In the second memory, Wang Yin saw herself bringing Zhang Fei [5] to one of the areas in her palace, where Nalan Yushu helped Ling Xiannu take over the corpse of a female demon who was born on the night when the Yin reached its peak.
Thereafter, Wang Yin saw many other memories, especially when Zhang Fei [5] and his other wives lived in her palace.
However, those memories stopped after he obtained the Blood Flame, especially since she went on an adventure afterward.
Wang Yin tried to recall her memories of everything that happened after they parted that day, but she couldn’t remember anything.
She blushed when she saw Zhang Fei’s [5] next memory, which was about their first dual cultivation. ’Did we really do that in the past?’

Wang Yin saw Zhang Fei [5] trying to destroy the barrier while calling her name, but it repeatedly knocked him back. He saw a black smoke emerge from her body, and it turned into Yuan Xiajie, who ordered her to take the banner and place it in a special container before the memories stopped.

After watching all that, Wang Yin looked at Zhang Fei [5] again. Even though their relationship was clear from his memories, she didn’t feel anything toward him because she couldn’t remember anything about it.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to touch Wang Yin’s face, but she stepped back, leaving his hand hanging in midair. "I don’t doubt your memories, but I can’t remember everything. For me, you are a stranger now, so I hope you can understand me."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] pulled his hand back. "Don’t worry, I understand your situation. However, I hope you are willing to give me a chance to help you remember everything, so I hope you are willing to leave this place and live with me."
Wang Yin thought as she continued to stare at Zhang Fei [5], and all the memories she saw before convinced her that he would never harm her. "Okay, I’ll stay with you."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Bian Zhizhu and Nong Qinhua. "Do you two remember me?"
"No." Both women shook their heads at Zhang Fei [5].
"Have we met before?" Nong Qinhua asked.

"We’ve met before, but before I answer your question, I want to know about your current memories first." Nong Qinhua told Zhang Fei [5] a few things, but she didn’t mention anything about the Three Mortal Realms. Instead, she told him that she was a native of one of the domains in the Paradise Realm, and her master brought her there to cultivate. "I didn’t expect that Yuan Xiajie also altered many of your memories, Qinhua. If you want to learn about yourself through my memories, I can share them with you."

"Please share them with me." Zhang Fei [5] touched Nong Qinhua and shared his memories with her, prompting her to close her eyes and watch them. Since the memories of their meeting weren’t many, she opened her eyes again a few minutes later. "Who really is Yuan Xiajie? Why did she erase and change so many of my memories?"

Zhang Fei [5] told Nong Qinhua some things about Yuan Xiajie that he knew, causing her to frown. "I don’t know her that well myself, so I don’t know what her purpose was in doing all that to you. If you want to return to that realm, I can send you there."

My sect is a universal one, and all races, including some demons, live there now. If you stay there, I’m sure that woman won’t dare to disturb me, so you’ll be safe from her."
"Alright, I will stay in your sect." Nong Qinhua unhesitatingly agreed.
"That’s good."
"What about me?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at Bian Zhizhu, and a glimmer of his killing intent flashed across his eyes, but he quickly suppressed it. "Have we met before?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei touched Bian Zhizhu’s forehead and shared some of his memories with her, but he did not divulge his memories when he tortured her. "We only met once, so I don’t have many memories of you."

Bian Zhizhu looked at Zhang Fei [5]’s memories for a while before asking, "Can I stay in your sect too? I no longer have any memories of that realm, so I don’t want to go back there, and I’ll start a new life in this realm."

"You can stay in my sect, but you have to help me with some things," Bian Zhizhu agreed with Zhang Fei [5], who then looked at the last two female demons. "I’ve never met you two before, but I suspect that you also came from the Three Mortal Realms. If you guys want to return to that realm, I can send you there right now, and you can try to find out your true identities there."
"Is that realm much better than this realm?" Dong Binghua asked.
"This Paradise Realm is much better because there is no celestial qi in the Three Mortal Realms."

"In that case, I’ll join your sect too." Yan Huanying immediately decided upon hearing that. If that’s true, I don’t have any family in this realm, so I want to join your sect."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "If you want that, you can join my sect. Moreover, I want to make my sect a paradise for all races, but the number of demons there is still small."
"Thank you." Yan Huanying smiled.
Dong Binghua immediately spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Since the four of them have joined you, I will join you too, and I will start my new life in your sect."

"Since you want to join my sect, and I’m a little familiar with your demon abilities, I hope you’re willing to help me with some things." Dong Binghua nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [5], who immediately opened a gate leading to the Twin Flames Domain. "You can enter now, and the guardian beasts of my sect will guide you there."

They hurriedly stood up and disappeared into the gate, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately closed it before looking at Morgana and Mo Taishen. "I don’t know if Yuan Xiajie will dare to come here again after Feng Yao threatened her, but I think this place is the best place for you two to hide, especially with the qi formation here."

Mo Taishen first surveyed the area before answering her. "Since Feng Yao has threatened that woman like that, I’m sure she won’t dare come here again, so I think we can stay here and focus on our cultivation."
"Yes." Morgana nodded in agreement. "Zhang Fei, we will stay here, and we won’t leave our seclusion for a long time."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and gave Morgana half of his teleportation device. "I’ll install the other half in my domain, so you two can escape immediately if anything unexpected happens."

"Thank you." After Zhang Fei [5] left the place, Mo Taishen and Morgana immediately sat in the middle. "I hope we can become stronger faster, and I will accompany you to take revenge on Mo Shentian and his master in the future."
Mo Taishen embraced Morgana and briefly kissed her. "After I successfully avenge their past actions against me, we will focus on our family, and we will have many children in the future."

paragraphs: Xie Yan and Xie Yao were utterly shocked as soon as Zhang Fei [5] arrived in front of them, mainly because of the effects of his soul link and demon rank.

Xie Yao and Xie Yan exchanged glances while thinking the same thing in their minds. ’How could his strength have already become equal to ours? Additionally, he evolved into a lust demon monarch about two months ago, but his demon rank has already broken through to the demon overlord rank, which is absolutely impossible.’
Xie Yan smiled faintly before moving in front of Zhang Fei [5], but he swiftly teleported away from her, shocking her and Xie Yao again.

"Sorry, but I don’t like being close to cheap women like you." Xie Yan did not feel offended by Zhang Fei [5]’s words; Instead, her lips curled up into a flirty, seductive smile. He felt a slight change in himself as if he was hypnotized by her, but the system immediately dispelled the effect of her abilities. "Don’t bother using your abilities on me."
"Huh?" Xie Yan stared at Zhang Fei [5], blinking repeatedly.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "Even if you’re a lust demon god, your abilities will never work against me, so stop your useless actions."
*Clap... Clap...*

"Hahaha." Xie Yao clapped as he laughed heartily. "The successor to the ten-tailed fox is truly amazing! I don’t know how you increased your strength or how your demon rank broke through so quickly, but I truly admire you. So, what is your purpose in coming to my valley?"

"Shouldn’t I be the one asking you that question? What is your purpose in looking for me?" Zhang Fei [5] teleported onto an empty rock beside Xie Yao and sat there. "I’ve heard your conversation with Shang Laohu about my identity as the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and we both have the ability to play with other people’s memories, so I know you got information about it from beast or natural races."
"Hahaha." Xie Yao laughed again. "You are right; I did get information regarding prophecies about you from those two races, but you were mistaken about my abilities because I—"

"Absolute Memory Authority." Xie Yao smiled and nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Your ability allows you to read other people’s memories without having to touch them, and they will never realize that you are tampering with their memories, which means you have absolute control over their memories. However, some cultivators have strong mental defenses, preventing you from reading their memories."

"That’s right." Xie Yao immediately admitted. "There are no perfect techniques in this universe, and all techniques have their weaknesses. When your demon rank reaches the demon god rank, you will also automatically gain that ability. Lust demons are demon fighters, but our way of fighting is different from other demons, such as the Asura Demon race. We mostly rely on our lust, memory, and dream abilities to fight our enemies."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] immediately diverted their conversation. "So, what is your purpose in looking for me?"

"Cooperation." Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at Xie Yao. "Yan’er and I just want to live in peace, but our fighting skills are not as good as other demon races, so we will never be able to change the situation in this realm. However, you are different from us, and you have many abilities that we don’t have, especially your abilities besides your lust demon abilities. Additionally, you are the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and you are destined to be the strongest living creature in this universe, so I want to cooperate with you."

"What can you offer me?" Zhang Fei [5] activated his soul domain, sword domain, and several others. "I don’t dare say that I will become the strongest in this universe, especially since such a thing is still far from my reach. For now, I am building my strength, but I will never accept useless people, so I want to know what you can do for me."
Xie Yan hurriedly returned to Xie Yao’s side and sat beside him. "What do you want from us?"
"Give me some offers, and I’ll consider them." Zhang Fei [5] casually replied.

Xie Yan turned to Xie Yao, who shook his head at her. "Since you’re a lust demon like us, and you possess many powerful abilities, I can’t offer you anything. Instead, you can tell us your conditions for us to join you."

Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his chin in thought. "Honestly, I have many subordinates who are more useful than you two, even though they are still not as strong as you guys. However, adding more allies would be much better than adding more enemies, right?"
"Haha." Xie Yao laughed in response. "So, what do you need from us?"

"I need people to infiltrate Qian Yan’s domain." Xie Yao and Xie Yan froze when they heard that. "I didn’t think about looking for trouble with the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, but I need to find some people in his domain."
"Who are they?" Xie Yan asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 1379: Meeting Shang Luohu
paragraphs: After he left the Temptation Valley, Zhang Fei [5] disguised himself as an asura demon and went to the Slaughter Blood Domain.
"Those two lust demon gods also came here, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] ignored them and went to one of the cities in the Slaughter Blood Domain, where he immediately contacted Shang Zhui for a meeting.
Zhang Fei [5] asked Shang Zhui to bring Shang Luohu with him, especially since he wanted to talk to her.
From his map, Zhang Fei [5] could see that Xie Yao and Xie Yan went to see Shang Luohu, but she immediately went with Shang Zhui to see him and left the two lust demon gods in her palace.
A few minutes later, Shang Luohu and Shang Zhu had arrived at the city. "Do you really have a solution to free my daughter?"
"That’s for sure." Zhang Fei [5] took out some of Shang Xueli’s body parts and pieces of her dress. "Look at them."
Shang Luohu took them from Zhang Fei [5]’s hand, and she could recognize her hair and dress. "How did you get them? Did you infiltrate the Celestial Domain?"

"It doesn’t matter how I got them; what matters is that I have a way to save your daughter." Shang Luohu stared at Zhang Fei [5], still curious about how he managed to get his daughter’s hair and dress. "If you want to save her, I can help you with that in the future. However, my assistance comes at a cost, and I expect your people to become my subordinates."
"I—" Shang Luohu didn’t continue speaking because he knew that it was definitely impossible; there was no way her husband would submit to anyone, including Zhang Fei [5].

"I understand that the decision lies with your husband, but you should be able to persuade him for the sake of your daughter’s safety, correct?" Zhang Fei [5] took the things back from Shang Luohu. "You don’t need to give me an answer now, and what’s important is that you already know that I can do something to save your daughter from Mo Shentian. For now, he has ordered Mo Zixiao to impregnate Shang Xueli as soon as possible, and it will be too late if she becomes pregnant with his son. At that time, I will no longer have a way to save your daughter, so you better think carefully about my offer."
Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh. "Why do you want us to be your subordinates?"

"I want you to be my subordinates not because I want to control you, but because I want to ensure that your demon race doesn’t do anything bad in this realm." Shang Luohu frowned after hearing Zhang Fei [5]’s statement. "It’s up to you whether you believe me or not, but I don’t have as much ambition as Mo Shentian or your husband. Instead, I want all the races of this universe to coexist together in peace, and I will live in peace if that can be realized."
"You—"

Zhang Fei [5] waved his hand to stop Shang Luohu. "I know that peace between all races cannot be achieved easily, but at least I have achieved it within my sect. Even though the scale is still small, my sect is proof that all races can live in one place in peace."
"Show us."
"Sure." Zhang Fei [5] took out a memory extractor and displayed an image of his sect from his memories, allowing Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui to see everything for themselves.

Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui immediately watched all the images that emerged from the memory extractor, where they saw humans, beasts, natural races, and demons living side by side, which amazed them. They couldn’t recognize most of them, but they recognized some of them, such as Tianshi Shengjie, Tian Huangjin, and the demons from the other three races.

Moreover, the winged race has always been hostile to the demon races, but three of them lived together in one place with so many demons, and they didn’t appear hostile toward each other; instead, they seemed to blend together seamlessly.

"Do you guys believe me now?" Zhang Fei [5] asked them. "We don’t need to discuss Nalan Shizhe because she is my mother-in-law, so she is definitely on my side. However, Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu are different from her, and they have already decided to join me. Apart from them, Long Xukong, Long Wuzhao, and Tian Yizu are also already on my side. I also have the support of several powerful human cultivators, so I think everything you see is enough to prove my words."

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t tell them anything about his relationship with Qi Qingxiu to prevent the worst from happening, especially since Qiongqi and several demon gods were still targeting him. As for the Nine Nether Demon Race, members of that race were his hidden weapons, and he would only reveal that they had become his slaves at the right time.

"Since you already know my identity as the successor of the ten-tailed fox, you don’t need to doubt that I can make it happen on a larger scale, right? Even so, I won’t rush things, and you can find a way to convince your husband first." Zhang Fei [5] turned off the memory extractor and put it away. "My business here is finished; I will leave now, as I have other matters to attend to."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Shang Luohu asked Shang Zhui a question. "What do you think of his offer, Zhui?"
"I think his offer is interesting and excellent, but it won’t be easy for us to convince my emperor."

Shang Luohu was also tempted by Zhang Fei [5]’s offer, but she couldn’t decide because Shang Zhanluo led their race, and he was the only one who could make decisions for their race. Unfortunately, her husband had enormous ambitions, and he wanted to unite all the demon races under their race, so she wasn’t sure that her husband would be willing to accept his offer. "Even if my husband is willing to accept his offer, he won’t be completely loyal to his decision. He might betray him in the future, and our demon race will be destroyed if that happens."

"That’s right." Shang Zhui nodded in agreement. "Even though our demon race is a race born of battle and blood, my emperor will never hesitate to use any means necessary to achieve his ambitions. He doesn’t fight Mo Shentian because he is stronger, and he still has his predecessor behind him. My emperor may accept Zhang Fei [5]’s offer at first, but he will think of a way to take over his force. If that happens, we will face Empress Huo’s wrath, and our demon race will be destroyed in her hands."
Shang Luohu let out a helpless sigh after hearing all that. "Do you really think Zhang Fei [5] can free my daughter from Mo Shentian?"

"I don’t know," Shan Zhui replied with a shake of his head. "However, Zhang Fei [5] should have infiltrated the Celestial Domain before; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to obtain my princess’s hair and dress. However, I don’t know how he did it because Mo Shentian installed a special formation in his domain, and he would immediately know if someone infiltrated there."

Shang Luohu nodded his head slightly. "I think the same as you, but Zhang Fei [5] is definitely very unique, and he is the only living being who has three identities. Perhaps, he has something to infiltrate there without Mo Shentian knowing, just like he infiltrated our domain."
"Perhaps your guess is correct, Empress."
"Sigh." Shang Luo released a soft sigh. "Let’s go back and meet the two lust demon gods, and I will think about this matter while waiting for my husband to come out of his seclusion."
"Yes."
Soon, they arrived at the palace, where Xie Yao immediately asked Shang Luohu a question. "What does Zhang Fei [5] offer you?"
"Did Zhang Fei [5] also offer you something?" Shang Luohu asked back.

"Yes." Xie Yao told them about his previous meeting with Zhang Fei [5], which shocked them. "I haven’t decided whether to accept his offer or not because Qin Yan is too powerful for me. Yan’er and I will definitely die if he attacks us."

"That’s for sure." Since they already told him about Zhang Fei [5]’s offer, Shang Luohu also told them about his offer to her. "I want to save my daughter, and his offer is very interesting, but I can’t decide on it. If I decide on my own, my husband will definitely be furious, so I have to wait for him to finish with his seclusion."

Xie Yao understood the situation in the Asura Demon Race. "With your husband’s character, I’m not sure he will agree to accept Zhang Fei [5]’s offer, and it’s possible he will convey it to Mo Shentian. If that happens, they will attack his sect, and the problem will escalate."

"Yes." Shang Luohu nodded in agreement. "The problem is the presence of Empress Huo Yanling behind Zhang Fei [5], and our demon race won’t be able to face her wrath if my husband does that. That’s why I’m still hesitant to discuss his offer with him, but I have no other choice because we can’t save our daughter on our own."
"I see." Xie Yao then gave her an idea. "What if you use another way to get his help?"

Shang Luohu frowned at that. "You mean I should use my sister to seduce him?"

"That’s right." Xie Yao explained some things to Shang Luohu about Zhang Fei [5], making her and Shang Zhui frown. "Trust me, I know more about lust demons than you. Even though he’s different, he’s still a lust demon, and he will be interested in your sister-in-law, especially if he finds out that she is Shang Zhanluo’s sister."

"Your idea can’t be used." Shang Luohu rejected Xie Yao directly. "My husband loves his sister and giving her to Zhang Fei [5] will only provoke his anger. If that happens, things will become complicated, so I won’t do that."
"Up to you." Xie Yao hugged his partner’s waist. "I’m just giving you an idea, and the decision is yours. I’ll return to my domain now, and I’ll think about Zhang Fei [5]’s offer."
After Xie Yan took Xie Yao away, Shang Luohu asked Shang Zhui, "What do you think of his idea?"

"We shouldn’t take any risks that would complicate the situation, Empress. My emperor clearly loves Shang Wenjie, and he will be furious if you use her." Shang Luohu agreed with Shang Zhui. "Besides, Zhang Fei [5] won’t necessarily accept her, especially with his ambitions of such magnitude."

Shang Luohu knew that, but she was eager to rescue her daughter from Mo Shentian’s hands, and Zhang Fei [5] had a way to save her, something neither she nor her husband could do. "What do you say if we try it first, Zhui? Perhaps, he will accept my sister-in-law, but we have to talk to her first before we meet him."

"Are you really thinking of taking such a risk, empress?" Shang Luohu tilted her head to Shang Zhui. "I know you want to save the princess from Mo Shentian’s hands, but you will only bring trouble to Zhang Fei [5] if my emperor finds out about this matter. You may be able to hide the issue now, but you won’t be able to hide this matter forever, and he will definitely find out that his sister disappeared."
Shang Luohu let out a soft sigh. "Go back first, Zhui."
"Yes, Empress."
After that, Shang Luohu stood alone, thinking about everything.

The Celestial Demon Capital was the main center of power for the Celestial Demon Race. It was their largest city, and Mo Shentian’s Palace was located in this city.

In the city, Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to see many demons from different races selling various items. At first, he thought there were only the Celestial Demon Race members in the city, but his guess was wrong because of the presence of various demon races there.

Zhang Fei [5] decided to look for an inn in the city, and he contacted Mo Tianqi afterwards. However, his slave could not meet him directly because he was with his two brothers, Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi.

Zhang Fei [5] asked Mo Tianqi to meet him after he returned. He sat by the window, opened his map, and checked the palace. He found Mo Zainan was sitting alone in her room and thinking about him, which was thanks to the effect of the device and the pill he gave to her third son.
"Looks like my plan for her worked well." Zhang Fei [5] muttered with satisfaction. "Now I just have to plan my next plan! Hopefully Dong Xuanyin will succeed in buying time for Mo Shentian."
[Aren’t you going to infiltrate the palace yourself, Master?]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "There’s no need to rush, Mei. I don’t know the situation inside, so I will wait for Mo Tianqi first."
Dong Xuanyin had already emerged from her pond, meeting Mo Shentian and Mo Zhejun. "What are you two doing in my private place?"

Mo Zhejun frowned after he sensed something from Dong Xuanyin. ’This female demon is stronger than she looks! Even the four perils don’t dare mess with her! How could she be this strong? How strong is she really?’
"Xuanyin, I need your help." Mo Shentian explained some things to Dong Xuanyin, which she naturally already knew from Zhang Fei [5]. "Help me find my younger brother."

Dong Xuanyin shook her head. "Give me a reason why I should help you with that! As far as I remember, you never had any siblings, but you suddenly came here saying that you do, which makes me doubt your story."
"Miss, this matter is private, so we can’t tell you about it." Mo Zhejun spoke.
’Heh!’ Dong Xuanyin inwardly snorted. "Since you said this matter is private, and I don’t like to pry into other people’s private matters, then you two can leave."
"Wait." Mo Shentian stopped Dong Xuanyin just as she was about to leave, moving in front of her.

"Why are you blocking my way? Isn’t your problem a personal matter? Your master said so himself." Dong Xuanyin glanced at Mo Zhejun. "I don’t like interfering in other people’s personal affairs, so please let me go now."
Mo Zhejun frowned, and he used his ability on Dong Xuanyin, but the effect only lasted for a short while. ’Impossible! How can my abilities not work on her?’ "You-Guah!"
"Master!" Mo Shentian ran toward Mo Zhejun, who had fallen. He helped his master up and asked Dong Xuanyin. "Why did you attack us?"
"Why don’t you ask your master?" Dong Xuanyin glared at Mo Zhejun. "Just because he’s a demon god, he thinks he’s mastered everything, so he thinks I’m weaker than him and acts as he pleases."
Mo Zhejun said nothing, as he was still in shock at Dong Xuanyin’s power. ’She is truly powerful; she is more than a demon god.’
Mo Shentian, on the other hand, sighed helplessly. "Please forgive my master, Xuanyin."

Mo Shentian then told Don Xuanyin the truth, making her furrow her brows. "You two were the ones who got rid of Mo Tianshen, so why do you two want him back? Did you two want to kill him? Since this is a personal matter, I will not interfere in this issue."

chapters.title: Chapter 1381: Mo Shentian’s Decision
paragraphs: "Please help us, Xuanyin. We must find Mo Tianshen as soon as possible; there is no time to waste, and you are our hope." Mo Shentian begged Dong Xuanyin.

Dong Xuanyin didn’t answer Mo Shentian immediately and continued to glare at Mo Zhejun, thinking about what to do with the two demons. She contacted Zhang Fei [5] to ask his opinion about them, but he left everything to her.
Dong Xuanyin thought of several solutions about the matter, and she answered Mo Shentian directly. "I can help you on one condition."
"Tell me your condition." Mo Shentian was slightly relieved after hearing that.
"Leave your master here." Mo Zhejun and Mo Shentian were shocked by Dong Xuanyin’s request. "Heh! No matter what you say or what you do, you always face all your consequences."
"You—Gargh." Mo Zhejun tried to struggle to break free from Dong Xuanyin’s confinement to no avail. "You bitch! Let me go!"
"Heh!" Dong Xuanyin sneered at Mo Zhejun, stuffed his mouth with something, and spoke to Mo Shentian. "Do you want to see Mo Tianshen or not?"
Mo Shentian first looked at Mo Zhejun before nodding to Dong Xuanyin. "Please tell me where Mo Tianshen is."
"Wait a minute." Dong Xuanyin first sent Mo Zhejun to her private place, and she touched Mo Shentian’s forehead, using the ability of her middle eyes after that.
In an instant, some images of the place inside the mountain appeared in Dong Xuanyin’s mind. Her eyes flickered as she noticed the location, which was the Endless Domain.

’Sure enough! That kid surely brought the male demon to this realm!’ Dong Xuanyin pulled her hand, ended her ability, and spoke to Mo Shentian. "Mo Tianshen is in the Three Mortal Realms, but I don’t know which realm he is in. For now, I can only give you a hint that he is in a mountain full of formation arrays, and he is improving his cultivation to return to this realm."
"Are you sure about that?" Mo Shentian doubtfully asked.

Dong Xuanyin shrugged her shoulders indifferently. "It’s up to you. You asked me to track down Mo Tianshen’s whereabouts, and I’ve done so. Since I’ve done my duty, I’ll take my leave now. For your master, I’ll return him after I torture him for trying to attack me."
"Wait." Dong Xuanyin frowned at Mo Shentian. "Don’t kill my master; he will have to help me later."
"Sure." Dong Xuanyin disappeared and returned to her private place, informing Zhang Fei [5] that Mo Shentian would return to his domain.

Mo Shentian didn’t leave immediately, and he thought of a way to find Mo Tianshen in the Three Mortal Realms. He wasn’t sure whether the men he had prepared would succeed in carrying out their task because the realm was simply too vast. "I have to find a way to get there myself."
Mo Shentian looked at Dong Xuanyin’s pond for a while before leaving the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.
Dong Xuanyin looked at Mo Zhejun as she thought about something, but a crimson flame suddenly appeared in front of them, transforming into Feng Yao.
Mo Zhejun was terrified after he recognized Feng Yao’s identity because of the symbol on her dress. ’Shit! This female demon trapped us! She collaborates with Empress Huo.’
"Why are you here?" Dong Xuanyin asked Feng Yao with surprise.

"Hehehe! Do you really not know why I came here?" Feng Yao walked over to Mo Zhejun and pressed her palm to his chest. "I left my consciousness in his soul, so I know all of his plans, including his plans against this male demon."
Dong Xuanyin released a soft sigh. "Do you think your actions are good for his development?"

"You don’t know him, so you underestimate him too much. Even without my help, he can do everything himself, and I only help him with trivial matters." Dong Xuanyin did not refute her words because she did not know anything about Zhang Fei [5]. Feng Yao did something to Mo Zhejun, making his eyes turn blank for a few moments. "Don’t free him until Mo Shentian is gone."
"Hmm?" Dong Xuanyin raised her eyebrows. "Will Mo Shentian descend to the Three Mortal Realms? Will Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups let him do it?"

"Yes." Feng Yao stood up and faced Dong Xuanyin. "Mo Shentian will descend to the Three Mortal Realms, and the higher-ups will allow him to do so. However, he will never reach that realm; instead, he will be trapped in an endless cycle."
Dong Xuanyin didn’t understand how Feng Yao could be so certain about all of this. "How will Zhang Fei [5] trap Mo Shentian in an endless cycle?"
"Just wait for the results." Feng Yao turned into a crimson flame again and left Dong Xuanyin’s place.
Dong Xuanyin released a soft sigh, contemplating Feng Yao’s words just now. "Forget it! I will find out sooner or later."
After he returned to his domain, Mo Shentian asked his wife and three sons to gather at the palace. He informed them about his plans to descend into the Three Mortal Realms, which surprised them.
"Are you sure Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups will let you descend to the Three Mortal Realms, husband?" Mo Zainan asked her husband with a serious tone.

Mo Shentian knew that Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups would not allow him to descend into the Three Mortal Realms, but he had no other choice. Even if he had to fight with them, he had to descend there to find Mo Tianshen as soon as possible to prevent big trouble from happening in the Celestial Demon Race. "No matter what happens, I must still descend there. While I’m gone, you must take my place in ruling everything within our race, and Mo Zixiao will help you with that."
"What really happened, Father? Why did you insist on descending to the Three Mortal Realms?" Mo Zixiao asked.

"You don’t need to know what my goal is, and the most important thing is that you just need to protect our demon race while I’m gone." Mo Shentian’s reply made Mo Zainan and their three sons even more confused about his decision. "If anything happens while I’m gone, you guys can contact my predecessor to resolve any issues that arise."
"When will you descend to the Three Mortal Realms, husband?" Mo Zainan asked again.

"Today! I’ll bring some people with me." Mo Shentian got down from his throne, looking at Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi. "I want Shang Xueli and Nalan Wangzi to be pregnant when I return. Do you two understand?"
"Yes, Father, we understand." Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi answered in unison.
Mo Shentian immediately left the throne room, followed by Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi. Mo Zainan could just watch her husband leave with many questions in her mind.
Mo Tianqi smiled to himself before speaking to her mother. "Mother, do you want to drink the abyssal fruit wine again?"
"Hmm?" Mo Zainan looked at her third son before nodding at him. "Take some to my room."
"Alright! I’ll get a jug and send it to your room." Mo Tianqi left with a faint smile on his face.
Mo Zainan thought about something before sighing softly, and she hurriedly went to her room, waiting for her third son to bring the abyssal fruit wine for her.

Mo Zainan sat in front of the dressing table and thought about the male figure that kept appearing in her mind. "Who is that man who keeps appearing? From his figure, I’ve clearly never met him, but somehow I feel close to him."
*Swoosh*
"Mother." Mo Tianqi brought a jug of abyssal fruit wine and handed it to Mo Zainan. "Drink it, mother."

Without any suspicion, Mo Zainan immediately drank the wine, causing the smile on Mo Tianqi’s face to widen. ’Hehehe! My master will be here soon, and he will claim you directly. That stupid father of mine won’t be able to prevent you from falling to my master, and our demon race will be under his control. Now all that remains is his predecessor, and our demon race will belong to my master completely.’
Mo Tianqi immediately left his mother’s room, leaving Mo Zainan to enjoy the wine himself.

Mo Zainan felt something strange appear in her mind, and she thought more and more about the figure of the man in her mind, which was the figure of Zhang Fei [5]. She felt a strong desire to meet him, and her feelings grew stronger every time she drank the wine.
’What’s happening to me? Why am I thinking about another man? His figure is also becoming clearer.’ Mo Zainan wondered herself as she continued drinking the wine.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled to himself after getting news from Mo Tianqi about Mo Zainan, and he looked at his map to check on Mo Shentian, who was gathering his subordinates to search for Mo Tianshen in the Three Mortal Realms.
’Hey!’ Zhang Fei [5] was startled when Feng Yao called out to him in his mind. ’Everything is ready now! Long Wuzhao has already agreed to let Mo Shentian descend to the Three Mortal Realms.’
"How did you convince Long Wuzhao and the others?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.
’I used a simple trick! The most important thing is not to waste the opportunities in front of you.’
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "Let’s wait until Mo Shentian leaves this domain before I carry out my plan."
’Just arrange it as you like.’
