Mo Shentian didn’t leave immediately, and he thought of a way to find Mo Tianshen in the Three Mortal Realms.
He wasn’t sure whether the men he had prepared would succeed in carrying out their task because the realm was simply too vast.
"I have to find a way to get there myself."
Mo Shentian looked at Dong Xuanyin’s pond for a while before leaving the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.
Dong Xuanyin looked at Mo Zhejun as she thought about something, but a crimson flame suddenly appeared in front of them, transforming into Feng Yao.
Mo Zhejun was terrified after he recognized Feng Yao’s identity because of the symbol on her dress. ’Shit!
This female demon trapped us!
She collaborates with Empress Huo.’
"Why are you here?" Dong Xuanyin asked Feng Yao with surprise.
"Hehehe!
Do you really not know why I came here?" Feng Yao walked over to Mo Zhejun and pressed her palm to his chest.
"I left my consciousness in his soul, so I know all of his plans, including his plans against this male demon."
Dong Xuanyin released a soft sigh.
"Do you think your actions are good for his development?"
"You don’t know him, so you underestimate him too much.
Even without my help, he can do everything himself, and I only help him with trivial matters." Dong Xuanyin did not refute her words because she did not know anything about Zhang Fei [5].
Feng Yao did something to Mo Zhejun, making his eyes turn blank for a few moments.
"Don’t free him until Mo Shentian is gone."
"Hmm?" Dong Xuanyin raised her eyebrows.
"Will Mo Shentian descend to the Three Mortal Realms?
Will Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups let him do it?"
"Yes." Feng Yao stood up and faced Dong Xuanyin.
"Mo Shentian will descend to the Three Mortal Realms, and the higher-ups will allow him to do so.
However, he will never reach that realm; instead, he will be trapped in an endless cycle."
Dong Xuanyin didn’t understand how Feng Yao could be so certain about all of this.
"How will Zhang Fei [5] trap Mo Shentian in an endless cycle?"
"Just wait for the results." Feng Yao turned into a crimson flame again and left Dong Xuanyin’s place.
Dong Xuanyin released a soft sigh, contemplating Feng Yao’s words just now.
"Forget it!
I will find out sooner or later."
After he returned to his domain, Mo Shentian asked his wife and three sons to gather at the palace.
He informed them about his plans to descend into the Three Mortal Realms, which surprised them.
"Are you sure Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups will let you descend to the Three Mortal Realms, husband?" Mo Zainan asked her husband with a serious tone.
Mo Shentian knew that Long Wuzhao and those higher-ups would not allow him to descend into the Three Mortal Realms, but he had no other choice.
Even if he had to fight with them, he had to descend there to find Mo Tianshen as soon as possible to prevent big trouble from happening in the Celestial Demon Race.
"No matter what happens, I must still descend there.
While I’m gone, you must take my place in ruling everything within our race, and Mo Zixiao will help you with that."
"What really happened, Father?
Why did you insist on descending to the Three Mortal Realms?" Mo Zixiao asked.

"You don’t need to know what my goal is, and the most important thing is that you just need to protect our demon race while I’m gone." Mo Shentian’s reply made Mo Zainan and their three sons even more confused about his decision.
"If anything happens while I’m gone, you guys can contact my predecessor to resolve any issues that arise."
"When will you descend to the Three Mortal Realms, husband?" Mo Zainan asked again.
"Today!
I’ll bring some people with me." Mo Shentian got down from his throne, looking at Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi.
"I want Shang Xueli and Nalan Wangzi to be pregnant when I return.
Do you two understand?"
"Yes, Father, we understand." Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi answered in unison.
Mo Shentian immediately left the throne room, followed by Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi.
Mo Zainan could just watch her husband leave with many questions in her mind.
Mo Tianqi smiled to himself before speaking to her mother.
"Mother, do you want to drink the abyssal fruit wine again?"
"Hmm?" Mo Zainan looked at her third son before nodding at him.
"Take some to my room."
"Alright!
I’ll get a jug and send it to your room." Mo Tianqi left with a faint smile on his face.
Mo Zainan thought about something before sighing softly, and she hurriedly went to her room, waiting for her third son to bring the abyssal fruit wine for her.
Mo Zainan sat in front of the dressing table and thought about the male figure that kept appearing in her mind.
"Who is that man who keeps appearing?
From his figure, I’ve clearly never met him, but somehow I feel close to him."
*Swoosh*
"Mother." Mo Tianqi brought a jug of abyssal fruit wine and handed it to Mo Zainan.
"Drink it, mother."
Without any suspicion, Mo Zainan immediately drank the wine, causing the smile on Mo Tianqi’s face to widen. ’Hehehe!
My master will be here soon, and he will claim you directly.
That stupid father of mine won’t be able to prevent you from falling to my master, and our demon race will be under his control.
Now all that remains is his predecessor, and our demon race will belong to my master completely.’
Mo Tianqi immediately left his mother’s room, leaving Mo Zainan to enjoy the wine himself.
Mo Zainan felt something strange appear in her mind, and she thought more and more about the figure of the man in her mind, which was the figure of Zhang Fei [5].
She felt a strong desire to meet him, and her feelings grew stronger every time she drank the wine.
’What’s happening to me?
Why am I thinking about another man?
His figure is also becoming clearer.’ Mo Zainan wondered herself as she continued drinking the wine.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled to himself after getting news from Mo Tianqi about Mo Zainan, and he looked at his map to check on Mo Shentian, who was gathering his subordinates to search for Mo Tianshen in the Three Mortal Realms.
’Hey!’ Zhang Fei [5] was startled when Feng Yao called out to him in his mind. ’Everything is ready now!
Long Wuzhao has already agreed to let Mo Shentian descend to the Three Mortal Realms.’
"How did you convince Long Wuzhao and the others?" Zhang Fei [5] curiously asked.
’I used a simple trick!
The most important thing is not to waste the opportunities in front of you.’
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement.
"Let’s wait until Mo Shentian leaves this domain before I carry out my plan."
’Just arrange it as you like.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1382: Hun Lingwu
paragraphs: "Are you sure this won’t be a problem, Brother Wuzhao?" Tianshi Bailong asked in a worried tone.

Long Wuzhao thought for a moment before answering. "I don’t think Empress Huo will make any rash decisions, and she’s already thought it through. For now, we just need to follow Mo Shentian’s movements, and we’ll take action immediately if anything goes wrong."

"That kid made a quick move." Long Xukong shook his head as he spoke. "He has already obtained the support of the four demon races, and he has also obtained the Nine Nether Demon Race as his slaves. He now acts against the Celestial Demon Race, so his influence will become even greater and stronger."
"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed at Long Xukong’s words. "The problem is that Tian Qiye will hear about Zhang Fei’s actions soon, and she will look for trouble with him."
Long Xukong nodded in agreement. "Are we going to make a move while Tian Qiye is looking for trouble with Zhang Fei?"
"Hmm?" Long Wuzhao shook his head in response. "We don’t need to move; Zhang Fei has Empress Huo by his side, and she’s more than enough to protect him from her."
"I hope you’re right."
"I need to talk to those old folks." Long Wuzhao disappeared from the sight of the two senior dragons.
"Are you sure this won’t cause us any trouble, Golden Dragon?" Feng Jinhuang asked him.
"Hmm?" Long Wuzhao looked at him and asked a question. "What trouble do you think Mo Shentian’s departure to the Three Mortal Realms will cause, Phoenix Emperor?"

Feng Jinhuang shook his head in response. "I don’t know what problems will arise if Mo Shentian disrupts the situation in the Three Mortal Realms, but what is certain is that the Celestial Demon God’s abilities are too extraordinary, and he could cause devastating chaos."

"You’re absolutely right about that." Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "However, Empress Huo won’t allow Mo Shentian to descend to the Three Mortal Realms without thorough preparation, and she must have already prepared a plan to prevent him from reaching there anytime soon. Perhaps she has already prepared some plans for him, and we just need to follow them."

"Why do you trust her so much, Golden Emperor? What if your thoughts about her are wrong? What if she’s planning something that will have a negative impact on this universe?" Hui Chen asked with a frown.

"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed out loud. "Isn’t your question too far-fetched? How could someone who loves this universe, like Empress Huo, do something useless for it? We all know that she loves this universe very much, and she would never allow it to be destroyed, let alone if the one who destroyed it were a celestial demon."
"But—"

Long Wuzhao sighed softly. "Your worries are overblown, Hui Chen. I don’t know the exact details of Empress Huo’s plans yet, but I’m sure she has a special reason for letting Mo Shentian go to the Three Mortal Realms. For now, we just have to wait, and I’m sure we’ll witness something even more interesting."
"I hope you’re right, Golden Dragon Emperor." Wang Jinyang let out a heavy sigh.
"Don’t worry, everything will be fine." Long Wuzhao stood up from his seat. "In that case, I’ll be leaving now. I still have other matters that I can’t leave, and no one else can take care of them."
The other nine people sighed softly, disappearing from the place together.
Mo Shentian and his five men arrived at a passageway leading to the Three Mortal Realms. They looked around for something but found nothing. They first made sure no one was following them.
After confirming that no one was following them, Mo Shentian immediately led his men into the passageway, flying at full speed to arrive at the Three Mortal Realms faster than expected.
"Let’s go; we’ve arrived at the Three Mortal Realms faster than we thought."
"Yes."

However, Mo Shentian felt something was strange because the Dragon Emperor was not following them, and the higher-ups were also nowhere to be seen. ’Could this be a trap? Why don’t they follow me? They should have known about my plan, and they should have stopped us.’
Not long after Mo Shentian left, Feng Yao appeared in the area. She smiled mysteriously as she looked in the direction they left.

Beside Feng Yao, Huo Ling appeared and shook her head, thinking that her master was being too helpful to Zhang Fei. "Are you going to do that? If you do that, Mo Shentian will definitely be trapped in that tunnel for a long time, and he will never be able to leave without your permission."

"Hahaha," Feng Yao laughed, and she waved her hand. A light immediately shot out from her fingers, shooting toward that passage. "I know you don’t like it if I continue helping Zhang Fei, but he has no other way to get rid of Mo Shentian, and he still needs my help for now."

"Up to you, then." Huo Ling sighed helplessly. "Now that five Demon Races are on his side, the Celestial Demon Race will be the sixth on his side. This way, he already has the Demon Races under him, and he only needs to gather the remaining four."

Feng Yao nodded at Huo Ling. "The Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Asura Demon Race, the Torture Demon Race, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race. Among them, the most troublesome is the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, and Zhang Fei must find a way to deal with that demon race."
"Do you think Zhang Fei will find something to fight against the demon race?"

"I can’t be sure of that; I can only wait for now. I’ve helped him too much; he has to try on his own to defeat the Heavenly Demon race." Feng Yao turned to Huo Ling. "Let’s go back now, and we’ll see the next show."
Li Meixiang and Fei Lianhe had already brought their grandson to the Immortal Soul Palace in Samsara Domain to treat Hun Lingwu.
Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan looked anxious, waiting for Hun Lingwu to treat their son, Fei Juehchen.

"Who did this? The person who did this was truly barbaric and lost half of his soul by killing himself." Hun Lingwu looked at the Fei Clan members. "With my ability, I can’t restore his soul anymore; the only way is to beg that person to return his soul. If you don’t do that, then your grandson will always live like this for the rest of his life."
Fei Lianhe asked. "Is there anything you can do, Hun Lingwu? Please save my grandson; I will pay whatever you ask as long as my grandson can recover to normal."

"Please help me, Hun Lingwu. Our grandson has been like this for several months, and he never wakes up from his sleep because he will attack us as soon as he wakes up from his sleep." Li Meixiang also begged.
"Please help us, senior." Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan begged.

Hun Lingwu shook his head at them. "It’s useless for you to beg me; I have no way to cure your grandson. The only person who can cure him is the one who used the soul technique on him, so you have to beg him. So, who is the person who used the soul technique?"
"He—"
"His name is Zhang Fei, an elder of the Moonlit Passion Temple." Mu Hanyan ignored her parents-in-law.

"Hmm?" Hun Lingwu was surprised to hear that. "Since when did that sect have Soul Cultivators of such a high level? As far as I remember, they were just a bunch of dual cultivators, and the strongest among them was only Qing Qiu’er. As far as I remember, there were no soul cultivators that high. Why do they suddenly have a soul cultivator?"

Mu Hanyan immediately answered Hun Lingwu. "Since the arrival of Zhang Fei, they have become a universal sect, and they have several reliable forces for all fields, such as alchemy, blacksmithing, and others."

"Hmm?" Hun Lingwu was even more surprised, prompting Mu Hanyan to explain to him about Zhang Fei in detail, including all the changes he brought to the Moonlight Passion Sect. "Oh? Why haven’t I heard about that man and the changes he brought to the sect?"

"Master, you were too busy with your seclusion, so you didn’t know about the changes in Moonlight Passion Temple." Hun Lingwu turned to his disciple, Hun Tianyu. "I’ve tried to visit that sect when they were recruiting people in my hometown."
"Tell me." Hun Tianyu explained everything about Moonlight Passion Temple to Hun Lingwu, down to as much detail as possible, including all the halls.
Fei Tianluo explained to Hun Lingwu that the sect was under Empress Huo’s supervision and that Zhang Fei was also her fiancé, so he wouldn’t make the same mistake by attacking the sect.
"Is that kid really Empress Huo’s fiancé?" Hun Lingwu asked in disbelief.

Li Meixiang and Fei Lianhe nodded to Hun Lingwu. "At first, we didn’t believe it either, but Empress Huo came to us herself. That’s why we chose to believe the news, or we would be the ones who would be in trouble if we fought her."

"I see." Hun Lingwu nodded in understanding. "Bring your grandson back because I can’t cure him, and if you want him to be cured, you have to beg Zhang Fei. He is the one who did it, so he is the one who can cure him."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1383: With Mo Zainan
paragraphs: After the Fei Clan members left, Hun Lingwu asked his disciples. "Shall we go to the Moonlight Passion Sect?"

"I don’t think we should go there at this hour, master." Hun Lingwu turned to Hun Tianyu. "You don’t understand the current Empress Huo, master. Since she returned to this realm, there have been many problems. She instructed her subordinates to slaughter those who in the past tried to invade her domain, and they committed a massacre. Moreover, the Fei Clan members told you that Zhang Fei is her fiancé, so we should visit the Moonlight Passion Sect properly."
"You’re right." Hun Lingwu nodded. "In that case, we have to visit the sect tomorrow, and we will bring them gifts."
"Eh?" Hun Tianyu was taken aback. "Why are you eager to visit the sect, Master?"
Hun Lingwu released a soft sigh. "Fei Juechen’s condition makes me curious, and the only one who can answer it is Zhang Fei, so I have to go there to ask him directly."
"I see." Hun Tianyu nodded in understanding. "Alright, we’ll go there tomorrow morning, and we’d better find the most appropriate gift."
"Let’s go."
Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan, who were carrying their son, Fei Juechen, looked disappointed. Their only hope was Zhang Fei, especially after Hun Lingwu couldn’t treat their son.

Fei Lianhe and Li Meixiang also felt helpless about their grandson’s condition, but they had already decided to look for Zhang Fei tomorrow. "Tianluo and Hanyan, no matter what, we will do our best to recover Juechen."
"Yes, Father." Fei Tianluo and Mu Hanyan began to think of other ways if Zhang Fei was still unwilling to recover their son.

Mo Tianqi knelt before Zhang Fei [5], reporting to him about everything within the Celestial Demon Palace. "Master, my mother is asleep now, so you can act whenever you want."
"Has your mother’s cultivation reached the Celestial God Realm?" Mo Tianqi answered Zhang Fei [5] with a headshake. "So, only your father has reached that stage, huh?"
"Yes, Master. Actually, there is one more person who has reached that stage, and he is my father’s master, but he rarely interferes in all kinds of matters."
"Mo Zhejun, right?"
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5]’s question shocked Mo Tianqi. "How did you know about him, Master? Usually, he never leaves his place, so people rarely know about him."
Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes focused on the castle. "Then, what about the previous Demon God of your race?"
"Our previous Demon God is still alive today, and he often travels to other places without any explanation. He spends a lot of time in other domains, one of which is the human domain."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow after hearing that. "Why did your previous Demon God like to spend time in the human domain?"

Mo Tianqi shook his head vigorously, not knowing what the previous Demon God did in the human domain. "I don’t know anything about the previous Demon God, but I’ve heard that his character wasn’t as evil as my father’s, and he was much kinder than my father. In fact, our Demon Race began to change after leadership fell to my father, and he was overly ambitious to unite all the demon races, which conflicted with some other demon races."

"Give these pills to your two brothers, lest they become suspicious." Mo Tianqi received the pills from Zhang Fei [5] and listened to his explanation. "When everything is over, you will replace your father in leading the members of your race."
"Yes, Master." Mo Tianqi was overjoyed by that. "Shall we go to the palace, Master?"
"Let’s go."
With Mo Tianqi’s help, it was easy for Zhang Fei [5] to enter the Celestial Demon Palace.
Soon, they were in front of Mo Zainan’s room, and Mo Tianqi went to give the pills to Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi.
Zhang Fei [5] entered Mo Zainan’s room slowly, activating the soul link, soul domain, and lust domain. He approached her and stood by her bedside, observing her tired face and muttering something.
Zhang Fei [5] removed the qi covering his body, causing his passive lust aura to spread out instantly, filling the room with his lust aura.
[Master, this woman is quite beautiful and sexy. Aren’t you interested in her?]
Zhang Fei [5]’s lips twitched as he listened to Mei’s comment, but he acknowledged that Mo Zainan was indeed attractive.
Zhang Fei [5] approached Mo Zainan, sealed her cultivation, touched her body, and woke her up.

"Hmm?" Mo Zainan opened her eyes and looked at Zhang Fei [5] with blurry vision. She was stunned for a long time, thinking about the face she had seen for the past month. She felt familiar with that face, but she remembered for sure that she had never met him. "Who are you? What are you doing in my room?"
"I am the man in your dreams." Zhang Fei [5] lifted Mo Zainan up and sat her on the bed while rubbing her face. "I came because you kept thinking about me, and I came to answer your call."

Mo Zainan reached out her hand, grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s face, and rubbed it. She didn’t realize that she had already been affected by his free will manipulation ability and subconscious manipulation ability, and he had also activated some of his lust domain’s effects, especially the second and fifth effects. Mo Zainan looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a lustful gaze, primarily because his passive lust aura increasingly influenced her, along with the effects of his domain.

paragraphs: Mo Zainan wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei [5]’s neck. "Please forgive me; I’m comfortable with you, but I can’t cheat on my husband, or I’ll die."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at Mo Zainan thoughtfully. "I will use my soul technique on you."
Mo Zainan nodded at Zhang Fei [5]. "Use it now, and you will find my husband’s mark on my soul."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled Mo Zainan’s soul out of her body, and he noticed that the soul mark left by Mo Shentian was binding her entire soul. He had never seen a soul mark like that before, and he was thinking of a way to remove it, but the Demon God’s soul mark was entirely different from his own. If he forcefully removed the soul mark, then her soul would die and disappear forever. ’Mei, is there anything I can do about his soul? How can I remove the soul mark?’
[Master, there’s nothing you can do to remove Mo Shentian’s soul mark from Mo Zainan’s soul. If you want to remove it, you must kill him, or her soul will be gone forever if you remove it by force.]
’Do you think I can duplicate her soul? Will Mo Shentian’s soul mark affect the duplication of her soul?’

[Master, I can’t be sure about that, and it’s best if you try duplicating Mo Zainan’s soul first. If Mo Shentian’s soul mark doesn’t affect the duplication of her soul, then you can merge it with yours, and you will have complete control over her soul.]

’Let me try it first.’ Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] duplicated Mo Zainan’s soul, and the results were as he expected. Her duplicate soul lacked Mu Shentian’s soul mark, allowing him to fuse it with his own soul before returning it to her body.

"Huh?" Mo Zainan looked at Zhang Fei [5] and blinked repeatedly, and she squeezed the part of her chest where her heart was. "What exactly happened? Did you do something just now? Why can I feel you in my heart?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] explained to Mo Zainan what he had just done to her soul, which surprised her. "I can’t remove your husband’s soul mark from your soul, mainly because he used a unique technique. To remove it, I need a special method, but I don’t have one yet, so I was forced to merge your soul with mine. Once I find a way to remove his soul mark, I will separate our souls, and you will live as usual."
Mo Zainan squeezed her chest even more as she could feel Zhang Fei [5]’s presence in her heart, which she really liked. She hugged him tightly, gave him a deep kiss, and savored their kiss.

Zhang Fei [5] hugged Mo Zainan’s waist, returned her kiss, and kissed her passionately. He lay on the bed with her on top of him, and they enjoyed their kiss, which became more passionate and lustful. The longer they kissed, the more passionate they became, but they forced themselves to hold back so as not to trigger a mark in her soul.

After a while, Mo Zainan had stopped their kiss, and she laid her head on Zhang Fei [5]’s chest, unaware that his free will manipulation ability and subconscious manipulation ability influenced her. "I feel comfortable with you, and I want to leave this place with you. Unfortunately, I can’t leave with you yet, and I still have to stay here as long as my husband’s soul mark remains in my soul."

"Don’t worry, we still have a lot of time now. Your husband won’t be able to come back here, and he will continue to be trapped in that tunnel for a long time." Mo Zainan looked at Zhang Fei [5] questioningly. "Didn’t you already know that I tricked your husband into going there? I’ve prepared a trap that he won’t be able to get through; no matter how strong he is, he will never be able to get through it. That’s why he will spend a lot of time in that passage, and I will have plenty of time to unite the entire demon race."
"Why do you have the ambition to unite all the demon races?" Mo Zainan asked confusedly.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled and caressed Mo Zainan’s cheek. "Don’t you want to live safely? Don’t you want to have a quiet life? The only way to achieve peace and security is to unite all races, and I will monitor any changes in the situation. If any of them intend to disturb our peace and security, I will immediately act and eliminate them."

"All races?" Mo Zainan looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you really intend to unite all races? Isn’t that impossible? All races have their desires, and it’s impossible for them to be willing to unite with each other, especially the Winged Races with Demons."
Zhang Fei [5] waved his hand and created several qi screens, forcing Mo Zainan to get off his body and turn towards the screens. "Just take a look yourself."

"Yeah." Mo Zainan looked at those qi screens one by one, which amazed her. "Winged races, natural races, human races, beast races, and demon races. Aren’t those demon members of the Eternal Night, Soul-Devouring, and Seven Emotions Demon Races? Does that mean Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Qi Qingxiu are joining you?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Mo Zainan. "They have indeed joined me, and there is still one more member of the demon race whose identity I am keeping hidden. For now, he doesn’t want his identity leaked out, and I respect that so I didn’t show it to you. However, he is powerful, and he has above-average abilities."

Mo Zainan turned to Zhang Fei [5], but she sighed softly because it was clear that he didn’t want to say it. Even so, she had her guess about the demon’s identity, but she wasn’t too sure about it because he had never sided with anyone before, including her husband. "What exactly is your goal in uniting them? Do you want to be the leader of all races? Do you want to stand above us all?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] responded to Mo Zainan’s question with a chuckle. "I don’t like being a leader, you know? I prefer to live a leisurely life with my women, and I want them all to live in safety and security, so I have no other choice but to unite them. Actually, this kind of thing is too difficult and too heavy, but I have no other choice but to achieve it, and I hope that all races can live together in one place in the future."
"That’s true." Mo Zainan also thought that peace would never come without uniting all races, but uniting them was truly not easy, and it required a long and hard effort.

Moreover, not everyone has the ability to unite all races because each race has its own ego. For example, the winged race has always been hostile to all demon races, and the two races have always been hostile to each other.

On the qi screens, Mo Zainan could see some members of the winged and beast races living in the same place as the demons in a peaceful situation, which had never happened before. She recognized some of them, such as Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie, who had quite high statuses within their races. "Are those two your friends? How do you know them?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. "Actually, I knew them from when I was still living in the Three Mortal Realms, and they helped me with certain matters."

"Do you have a serious relationship with Tianshi Shengjie?" Zhang Fei [5] put on a playful smile, convincing Mo Zainan. "I didn’t expect you to have such a relationship with the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, and her race must fully support you because of your relationship with her."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] removed all the qi screens. "Actually, my relationship with her hasn’t gone that far yet, and she’s still stalling our relationship over and over again. Even so, our relationship is already close, and she will eventually fall into my arms."

Mo Zainan nodded in understanding before he remembered something, and he immediately told it to Zhang Fei [5]. "Hey! You have to be careful of my husband’s master because he is too strong, stronger than me. If he detects your presence here, he will definitely move immediately to capture you, so you have to be careful of him."
"Mo Zhejun, right?"
"Yes."

"Haha." Mo Zainan was confused seeing Zhang Fei [5] laugh out loud like that. "You don’t need to think about Mo Zhejun, okay? That old demon is indeed strong, but the person who captured him is much stronger than him, so he will never be able to hinder my plan to bring your demon race into my group."
"Huh? When did you capture Mo Zhejun?"
"Yesterday." Zhang Fei [5] explained to Mo Zainan about how Dong Xuanyin captured Mo Zhejun. "She’s powerful, so I’m sure he won’t be able to escape from her, and she’ll enjoy torturing him."

"I didn’t expect you to pull Dong Xuanyin over to your side." Mo Zainan released a soft sigh. "She is indeed powerful, much more powerful than my husband when he uses his demon god abilities. You’re lucky she’s on your side, and you’d be in big trouble if she were on your enemy’s side."

chapters.title: Chapter 1386: Saving Shang Xueli
paragraphs: "I’ll accompany you to sleep again."

Mo Zainan complied and let Zhang Fei [5] lift her to the middle of the bed, where she hugged him tightly, which was due to the effects of his free will manipulation ability and subconscious manipulation ability. "Will you succeed in uniting all the demon races?"

"I’m not sure about that yet." Zhang Fei [5] answered with a shake of his head, as he wasn’t confident in defeating the other Demon Gods, especially since they were so powerful and possessed such abilities. "The important thing now is that I have to try first, but I must do it slowly to prevent them from raising their guard. As long as I move carefully and with calculation, I am confident that I can subdue them one by one, and my next target will be Qian Yan."
Mo Zainan looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Qian Yan? The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Mo Zainan. "I have to do something to Qian Yan for the sake of one of my subordinates, but I have to do it carefully because his eye abilities are so terrifying. If he finds out my secret location, he’ll easily find me, and I’ll have a hard time hiding from him."
"For the sake of one of your subordinates."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Mo Zainan. "Ju Yingzhi is my subordinate, and we met in the Three Mortal Realms. Since then, she has been following me, so I must help her free her family from Qian Yan’s hands."

"You’re willing to do anything for your subordinates, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Mo Zainann, who sighed heavily and hugged him tighter. "You are different from my husband in many ways, you know? Not only does he take advantage of his subordinates, but even we members of his family cannot disobey his orders. We must comply with all his orders, or he will punish us. I sometimes feel exhausted by all of this, but his soul mark is connected to mine, leaving me no choice but to obey his orders."

Zhang Fei [5] rubbed Mo Zainan’s back. "You don’t need to be afraid of him anymore, you know? Regarding your husband, you don’t need to think about him for now, and he will be trapped in that tunnel for a long time. From now on, the Celestial Demon race is in your hands, and you have complete control over them. You only need to punish them if they dare to oppose you, and nobody will ever dare to do so again."
"Are you sure my husband won’t be able to get out of that tunnel?"

"One hundred percent." Zhang Fei [5] lifted Mo Zainan’s face to make her look directly at him. "For now, your main task is to coordinate all the members of the demon race, and you must make them obedient to you. If you need my help, I will help you to subdue them so they will completely submit to you."

Mo Zainan shook her head. "You don’t need to help me, and I will definitely subdue all the members of my race. Although I am not as popular as my husband, many members of our race assist me because they seldom see him, and I can rely on their support. Besides, my husband has brought most of the people on his side, so I won’t have any trouble controlling everyone."
"I believe you." Zhang Fei [5] kissed Mo Zainan some time. "Sleep now."
"Yeah." Mo Zainan laid her head on Zhang Fei [5]’s chest. "Will you be here when I wake up? Will we meet again if you leave here?"
"I still have some things to do, so we probably won’t see each other for a while. However, you just need to contact me when you miss me, and I will definitely come to you."
"Really?"
"I promise."
Mo Zainan smiled when she heard that, and she immediately closed her eyes.
After some time, Mo Zainan finally fell asleep, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately left her room to go to her other children’s room, where Mo Tianqi was already waiting for him.
When he arrived at the room, Zhang Fei [5] found Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi already sound asleep on the same bed, where Mo Tianqi and the fake Nalan Wangzi were already waiting for him.
"Master, your pills are truly efficacious, and they fell unconscious after they took them." Mo Tianqi said with excitement.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded and turned to the fake Nalan Wangzi. "Do you want to go back to being a man?"
"Eh?" Mo Tianqi turned to the fake Nalan Wangzi. "Is she your subordinate, Master?"
"She is my mother-in-law’s subordinate." Zhang Fei [5] casually answered.
The fake Nalan Wangzi shook her head at Zhang Fei [5]. "Young master, I will stay like this for now, and you can turn me back when all your plans have succeeded."

"Thank you for your sacrifice; I will definitely not forget your service." Zhang Fei [5] approached Mo Zixiao and Mo Taizi and used his memory manipulation ability on them. He also duplicated their souls before merging them with his. "Now that my business in this domain is complete, I will be taking Shang Xueli with me. If you need my help, please contact me directly, and I will come here to assist you."
Zhang Fei [5] approached Shang Xueli, who continued to stare at him blankly. He lifted her onto his shoulders, carried her away from the room, and took her into the training room.
The fake Nalan Wangzi hurriedly brought Mo Taizi to their room, and Mo Tianqi left Mo Zixiao’s room with a face full of excitement.

When he arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei [5] saw that Zhang Lin was already wrapped in a cocoon, and she was in the process of evolving to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks. "How long will the process take to end, Mei?"

[Master, I can’t say for sure when Zhang Lin’s process will be completed, but what is certain is that she will become much stronger after she breaks through to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks stage. For now, we can only wait for her to complete the process, and she will be more useful in increasing your Demon Rank. What will you do about Shang Xueli?]

Zhang Fei [5] lowered Shang Xueli from his shoulders before taking out the science capsule, and he placed her inside. She continued to stare at him without saying anything, and her gaze remained blank, making him sigh helplessly.

Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly and closed the lid of the science capsule. "Mei, do it now and restore Shang Xueli’s memories to the original state. I need her in normal condition, so you must fix her and return her to normal."
[Yes, Master] Mei immediately activated the science capsule and restored Shang Xueli’s memories, but the process was quite long because many of her memories were unclear, making it quite difficult.

Time continued to pass, and the science capsule continued to show activity to restore Shang Xueli’s memories. Zhang Fei [5] waited at the side with a serious expression, watched the process closely, and waited for the final result.
Time passed quickly; a day had passed in the training space, but the process was still not finished, making Zhang Fei [5] impatient to wait for the results of restoring Shang Xueli’s memories.
After another day passed, the science capsule finally stopped showing activity, and Mei opened the lid to allow Zhang Fei [5] to wake up Shang Xueli.
Zhang Fei [5] decided to channel his qi into Shang Xueli’s body, and he did so for a while until the female demon slowly opened her eyes.

Shang Xueli stared at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion, but she still recognized him, even though she didn’t know his true identity. "Who exactly are you? Why are you helping me? You should have left me as I was, and you wouldn’t have bothered saving me from their hands."

"I’m not doing it for free, but I also have another purpose in saving you." Zhang Fei [5] helped Shang Xueli out of the science capsule. "I’ve saved you, but I won’t let you return to the Asura Demon Race because I need you to pull members of your race into my group. For now, you can stay in this place safely and comfortably, and no one will bother you here, so you can relax freely."

Shang Xueli looked at Zhang Fei [5] in confusion, especially since she hadn’t returned to the Asura Demon Race for a long time after her marriage to Mo Zixiao. "What do you want to do with my race? Do you want to take over my race? If that’s what you want, there’s no point in saving me and locking me up because my race is all in my father’s hands, and I have no authority within my race."
"I know that." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Shang Xueli. "To tell you the truth, I don’t want to rule over your demon race, but I want to unite all the demon races into one."

"Hmm?" Shang Xueli was surprised to hear that. "All the demon gods have long thought about uniting the demon races, including my father. Unfortunately, my father didn’t have the ability to do so because the Celestial Demon Race was stronger than us, and Mo Shentian forced my father to hand me over to him in order to curb his ambitions."

"Demon God." Mo Tianshen kowtowed to the old male demon three times as a sign of respect.
"I will accept your final strength, and I will use it to defeat my brother.
I can’t promise you anything about changes to our Celestial Demon Race, but I will bring peace back to the demon race."
The old male demon nodded in understanding to Mo Tianshen, and he turned to Morgana.
"A demon from the Witch Demon Race, huh?
Since you are his wife, you must help him regain his status in our Celestial Demon Race, and you must help him bring peace back to our demon race."
"I will definitely help him, Demon God." Morgana answered the old male demon with a serious look.
"Good." The old male demon looked at Mo Tianshen again.
"It’s time for us to part ways, and this will be our last meeting, Little Tianshen.
I entrust our Celestial Demon Race to you, and I hope you can bring peace back to our demon race.
After today, you will inherit all my remaining demon powers, and it will make your path to Demon God Rank easier."
Mo Tianshen nodded to the old male demon.
"I will definitely do it, Demon God."
"Hahaha!
I can finally rest in peace." The old male demon laughed, and he transferred all his demon power to Mo Tianshen.
A moment later, the old male demon’s body turned transparent after he gave his remaining power to Mo Tianshen.
"Demon god."
"Farewell, Little Tianshen." The old male demon disappeared completely a moment later.
Mo Tianshen clenched his fists tightly and kowtowed there three times as a final sign of respect.
"Zhang Fei [5], I will not come out of seclusion until the time for our final battle, and I will be the one to face Mo Shentian when the time comes."
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the place.
Mo Tianshen turned to Morgana.
"For now, I must focus on absorbing my ancestor’s power, and I probably won’t wake up anytime soon."
"I see." Morgana hugged her husband.
"You can focus on absorbing your ancestor’s power, and I will always be faithfully waiting by your side."
"Thank you." Mo Tianshen kissed Morgana for a while before focusing on absorbing the power of the old male demon.
Morgana stared at her husband with a strange feeling.
At first, they both came from the mortal realm, but her husband had changed significantly, and he turned out to be a successor of the Celestial Demon Race, which made their situation quite peculiar.
Morgana let out a soft breath and closed her eyes, restarting their seclusion.
In the Celestial Demon Race throne room, Mo Zainan sat on the throne watching all the demons present before her, most of whom were her loyal supporters.

Behind Mo Zainan stood her three sons and two daughters, but she was oblivious to the change in attitude of her three sons and one of her daughters, all four of whom were completely loyal to Zhang Fei [5].
Mo Zainan decided to remove all of Mo Shentian’s subordinates and replace them with her own subordinates, which caused a huge commotion among the Celestial Demon Race.
Mo Zainan’s three sons and one daughter were not surprised by their mother’s decision, but the case was different with the youngest daughter, Mo Anqi.
Mo Anqi didn’t know yet that her mother, three siblings, and eldest sister were already under Zhang Fei [5]’s control, which made her confused by Mo Zainan’s sudden decision.
Mo Zainan ordered her subordinates to capture all of Mo Shentian’s subordinates, who would not submit to her.
Mo Anqi was perplexed about her mother’s orders, and she turned to her four siblings, but they acted nonchalantly and supported her mother’s orders, which confused her.
After everything was settled, Mo Zainan finally officially became the new leader of the Celestial Demon Race, and all of her subordinates took control of their palace and demon race.
Even so, her husband’s subordinates were still quite a lot in their demon race, and she ordered all her subordinates to capture them all.

Mo Zainan chose her confidants to replace her husband’s subordinates, and she asked one of them to activate their domain’s protective barrier so that other demon races could not invade their domain during the transition period.
Once everything was done, Mo Zainan left the throne room, followed by her two daughters.
Meanwhile, her three sons took over her role as leaders of their demon race, and they monitored the transition process taking place within it.
"Mother, what happened to you?
Why did you suddenly take this step?
What if father comes back later?
He will definitely be furious after finding out about your action, and he will undoubtedly lock you up in prison." Mo Anqi said worriedly.
Mo Zainan looked at her youngest daughter and smiled at her, making Mo Anqi even more confused by her attitude.
"You don’t need to be afraid of your father, okay?
Your father is trapped inside the tunnel to the Tri-Mortal Realm, and he won’t be back anytime soon.
When he returns, our demon race will already be under my control, and he won’t be able to take it back from me.
For hundreds of thousands of years, your father has never treated me well, and he has always regarded me as a tool to gain his status as our race’s demon god."
"But—"
"Don’t worry, okay?" Mo Zainan caressed her second daughter’s face.
"I’m not doing this just for myself, but to protect the five of you.
Your father never considered you his children, and he always treated you as his tools.
However, everything will end today, and he won’t have a place to return to even if he manages to escape the tunnel to the mortal realm.
From now on, the five of you can have your lives, and nothing can stop you from achieving your dreams.
If anyone dares to stand in your way, those people will face me directly, and I will eliminate them for the sake of all your happiness."
"Mother." Mo Anqi hugged Mo Zainan.
"Are you sure my father will be trapped in that tunnel for a long time?
Are you sure he won’t be able to get out of there and come back here?"
Mo Zainan hugged her youngest daughter back.
"Your father might be able to get out of that tunnel someday, but I’m sure he won’t be able to anytime soon.
By the time he does, our demon race will be under my complete control, and he won’t have a place to return to.
Even if he does, he won’t have anyone to help him, and I will fully protect the five of you, so you don’t have to worry about him.
For now, you only need to think about yourself and your future, and I hope you get a better husband than your father."
"Does that mean I can stop approaching Sha Huo, Mother?" Mo Anqi released her hug from Mo Zainan.
"I never liked that man, but my father insisted that Big Sister and I approach him."
Mo Zainan nodded with a smile.
"For me, the happiness of the five of you is the most important thing, and I won’t force you to approach someone you never loved.
I want you to live freely and find a man who suits your choices, and you can enjoy your life freely with him."
"Really?"
"Really."
Mo Anqi breathed a sigh of relief and patted her chest.
"I’m pleased with your decision, but I don’t have the right choice for a husband yet.
For now, I just want to focus on my strengths, and I’ll find the right man to be my husband once I’m truly ready."
"Haha." Mo Zainan softly laughed.
"Anqi, strength is important, but marriage is also important, do you understand?
If you find a man you like, you must bring him to me, and I will make sure that he is the right man to be your husband."
Mo Anqi pursed her lips.
"Mother, I actually don’t want to have a husband who is a demon from other demon races, but I hope to find a husband from other races, for example, the human race."
"Why don’t you like male demons?" Mo Zainan curiously asked.
"Even though I’m a demon myself, I don’t like demon men." Mo Anqi let out a soft sigh and explained her hopes to Mo Zainan.
"I want a husband from another race, whether it’s human, demihuman, or beast.
I know they hate our demon race because my father always causes trouble here and there, but I hope I can get a husband from one of those races."
Mo Zainan thought about Zhang Fei [5]’s words.
"How about you try joining the Moonlit Passion Temple?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1389: Hun Lingwu’s Visit
paragraphs: "The Moonlit Passion Temple? I think I’ve heard of that sect." Mo Anqi searched her memory for a moment. "Ahh! I remember that sect; it’s a dual cultivation sect, right? Why are you telling me to join a sect like that, Mother?"

"Look at these first." Mo Zainan created qi screens, showing the Moonlit Passion Temple to Mo Anqi. "Have you ever seen human races, winged races, natural races, beast races, and demon races gathered in one place?"
"No." Mo Anqi, with a serious expression, looked at the qi screens one by one. She found several people who were very familiar with her, especially Tianshi Shengjie and Tian Huangjin in the sect.
Mo Anqi also saw several demons that were familiar to her, especially those from the Soul-Devouring Race, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race, which made her disbelieve.

Moreover, the members of the three demon races mingled with the members of the other races without any problems, and the humans in the sect accepted them with pleasure, which made Mo Anqi even more incredulous about what she saw.

Mo Anqi found it hard to believe seeing all of this because all races hated the demon races, and they had always ostracized all demons from regional relations. Both the human race and the other races welcomed the presence of all the demons with open arms, and they seemed to have a good relationship with each other, including Tian Huangjin, who had always hated demons.
"Since when does the Moonlit Passion Temple accept all races into their sect, Mother?" Mo Anqi asked as she continued to look at the images appearing on the qi screens.

Mo Zainan shook her head at her second daughter because she herself didn’t know when the sect accepted all races as members, but she could clearly see that they had a positive relationship, even though their races were different. "I don’t know for sure since when the sect has accepted all races, but the fact shows that the demons have a good relationship with the human race, winged race, and various other races. If you are interested in joining the sect, then you can go to the Twin Flames Main Domain and visit the sect."
"Is it okay if I go to that sect and join? Will they accept me?" Mo Anqi asked doubtfully.

Mo Zainan turned off all the qi screens and stroked her daughter’s head. "Why should you doubt yourself? Why don’t you give it a try first? I’m sure they won’t attack you, and they’ll gladly accept you if you truly intend to join the sect with good intentions."
"Ehmn." Mo Anqi nodded at her mother before turning to her big sister. "Big sisters, are you also interested in joining that sect? How about the two of us going to that sect today?"
Mo Yousha nodded slightly to her little sister. "We can join that sect instead of spending our time in this domain."
"Yes." Mo Anqi immediately spoke to their mother. "Mother, my big sister and I will check out the sect first before we decide whether to join it or not, and we will go to that domain today."
Mo Zainan nodded to his youngest daughter. "Alright, you two can go to that domain now, and I’m sure you’ll like the sect."
"Yes." Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha immediately left their mother and went to the Twin Flames Main Domain.
Mo Zainan immediately contacted Zhang Fei [5] and informed him of her two daughters’ desire to join their sect, to which he right away replied, asking her to send them to his sect.
Thereafter, Mo Zainan returned to her bedroom, and she threw all of her husband’s things out of her room. "Hopefully, I have made the right decision by removing my husband from our demon race."

As per Zhang Fei [5]’s orders, Tian Kui and Serpentera allowed Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha to enter the Moonlit Passion Temple. The two female demons immediately went to look around the sect, especially every hall within it.
Zhang Fei [5] himself did not meet Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha; instead, he observed their movements from the mountaintop with his four wives.
"Are you sure the two of them won’t bring us trouble, husband?" You Feiling asked as she monitored Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha with her senses.
Qing Qiu’er also spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "One of the two demon women must have become your slave, right?"

"Hehehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled and explained to the four of them about Mo Yousha’s status, which was now no different from his slave, even though he didn’t enslave her directly. "Now there are five demon races on our side, and one demon race is under my complete control, so only four are left now. For now, I’m still waiting for Shang Louhu’s decision, but I’m not sure she will make it that quickly."

Qing Qiu’er nodded and spoke to Zhang Fei [5]. "Shang Luohu may be an empress, but she won’t be able to decide on her own. She must wait for her husband to emerge from seclusion before she can make a decision. However, I’m not sure Shang Zhanluo will agree to join you, and he might attack us if he finds out that the six demon races are already on your side."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with that. "I already expected that Shang Zhanluo wouldn’t agree with Shang Luohu joining us, and he might think of attacking us after knowing that some of the demon race were joining us. Therefore, I have to speed up the construction of this domain, especially the formations protecting this domain. If Asura Demon God finds out about my plan, there’s a possibility that he’ll persuade the remaining demon gods to attack us, so we have to prepare strong defenses to face all of their attacks."
"If Shang Zhanluo thinks about attacking us together with the other demon gods, then we will have a big problem dealing with them all at once." Qing Qiu’er spoke with a serious expression.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "For now, we can only wait for Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan to complete those formation arrays. Thereafter, we will install several formations suitable for this domain, and they will be the key to our defense against the attacks of the demon races. However, of all the demon races, the one I worry about the most is Qian Yan, especially with his terrifying eye ability."
"Do you have a solution to prevent Qian Yan’s eye abilities, husband?" Yan Jinwu asked Zhang Fei [5].

Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly as he shook his head. "Besides his eye abilities, Qian Yan also has a close relationship with the four perils, which makes me have to be careful in dealing with him. I’m not ready to face Taotie and the other three because they are immortal-ranked beasts, and they can easily suppress me. If they appear in this domain, I’m not confident I can defeat them."
"Why don’t you ask Feng Yao for help to deal with the four perils, husband?" Sima Huiqing asked.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to Sima Huiqing. "You don’t understand Feng Yao’s character, and she won’t be willing to help me deal with the four perils. That’s why I have to think of a way to deal with them myself, and I can’t act rashly. I was forced to delay saving Ju Yingzhi’s family because I didn’t want to deal with them now, or we would be in big trouble if we had to deal with them now."
"I see." Sima Huiqing nodded in understanding.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked outside. "Qiu’er, we have two guests, and they seem very dangerous to us. I want you to meet them now, and I’ll go to another domain to check something out."
"Who are those two people?"
"Hun Lingwu and his disciple."

After that, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling immediately disappeared from the mountaintop. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] brought Yan Jinwu and Sima Huiqing, but he first told the two ancient beasts to keep an eye on their two guests.
The presence of Tian Kui and Serpentera, the guardians of the Moonlit Passion Temple, shocked Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu.

’Crazy! How could they get two powerful beasts as their sect guardians?’ Hun Tianyu screamed in his heart. The presence of the two ancient beasts terrified him, and he hid behind his master, Hun Lingwu.
Hun Lingwu looked at the two ancient beasts seriously, trying to figure out their identities in his mind. He was sure he had heard of them before, but he couldn’t remember them at all.
"What are you doing in my sect, Senior Hun?" Qing Qiu’er asked Hun Lingwu.
Meanwhile, You Feiling didn’t say anything, but she glared at Hun Lingwu angrily because of the past conflict between them, and she couldn’t forget the incident that happened so many years ago.

"Cough." Hun Lingwu cleared his throat as he stared at You Feiling, who was glaring at him hatefully. He ignored her and answered Qing Qiu’er directly. "Sect Master Qing, I know that your sect has a new elder named Zhang Fei, and I came here to meet him."
Qing Qiu’er raised her eyebrows. "How did you know about Zhang Fei, Senior Hun?"
"Haha." Hun Lingwu laughed upon hearing that. "Many people have met Zhang Fei, and some of them have come to see me for treatment. Therefore, you shouldn’t be surprised if I know about him, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1390: Hun Lingwu - Hun Di
paragraphs: "Where did you hear about Zhang Fei?" You Feiling asked in a cold tone.
Qing Qiu’er shook her head at You Feiling. "He must have heard about Zhang Fei from the Fei Clan, who has asked for his help in healing Fei Juechen. Isn’t my guess correct, Senior Lingwu?"

Hun Lingwu nodded his head repeatedly in acknowledgment. "You’re absolutely right about that, Sect Master Qing. The people from the Fei Clan came to me yesterday with Fei Juechen, but I was unable to restore his condition because Zhang Fei had split his soul in two, and I couldn’t heal him with only half of his soul. That’s why I came here to see him, and I wanted to ask him how he managed to split that man’s soul in two, especially since I’ve never seen such a soul technique before."

"Unfortunately, Zhang Fei has been gone for several days, and he still hasn’t returned until today. I don’t know when he will return because he never told me about his destination, and he comes and goes like a ghost." Hun Lingwu didn’t believe Qing Qiu’er, and she spoke to him again. "If you don’t believe me, you can look inside my sect to look for him, but I assure you that you won’t be able to find him because he’s not here."
"Big Sis."

Qing Qiu’er stopped You Feiling and spoke to Hun Lingwu again. "You can enter my sect if you want to try to find Zhang Fei, but you’ll never find him because he’s not here, and I don’t know when he’ll return."

"Haha." Hun Lingwu laughed at that. "My purpose in coming here isn’t just to look for Zhang Fei, but I also want to take a look around your sect. I heard that your sect has changed and is no longer purely a dual cultivation sect; it has become a universal sect with many halls, one of which is the Soul Hall."

Qing Qiu’er nodded slightly. "The information you received is correct, and our sect has become a universal sect with many halls within it, one of which is the Soul Hall. Additionally, we also have several soul cultivators, and they are quite skilled in the field of souls. I will introduce you to our people, especially those soul cultivators."
"Alright." Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu immediately followed behind Qing Qiu’er.

You Feiling sighed helplessly, as she had never liked Hun Lingwu, but Qing Qiu’er still brought them into their sect. She followed behind them while staring at the old man with hatred, and she grumbled in her heart.
Tian Kui and Serpentera did not follow them into the sect, but they continued to monitor Hun Lingwu’s movements, which was in accordance with Zhang Fei’s orders.
Qing Qiu’er did not immediately take Hun Lingwu and his disciple to the soul hall; instead, she first showed them the other halls, which left them both surprised by the changes in the sect.

Hun Lingwu and his disciples were truly shocked when they arrived at the sword hall, especially after seeing Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng there. After all, these three men were renowned cultivators in the Paradise Realm, and they had never been affiliated with any sect, yet they were willing to join the Moonlit Passion Sect.
"You definitely know them, right?"
Hun Lingwu nodded to Qing Qiu’er. "How did you manage to recruit them, Sect Master Qing?"
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er shook her head in response. "We never tried to recruit them, but they decided to join us on their own, and we naturally welcomed them with open arms."

Thereafter, Qing Qiu’er led the two guests to the blacksmith hall, where Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu were shocked again when they saw people from the You and Liao Clans there. They also saw many talented people in the hall, even though their cultivation was still at the Celestial Lord Realm.

Qing Qiu’er led Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu to the alchemist hall, where they saw an alchemy god and three alchemy goddesses teaching the disciples about alchemy. ’Unbelievable! This sect has so many alchemists in the god and goddess ranks!’

Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu were unimpressed when Qing Qiu’er took them to the assassin hall, the speed hall, the body hall, and the puppetry hall. However, they were impressed when she took them to the medical hall, which was inhabited by people from various races.
"Why do you accept members of the demon races into your sect, Sect Master Qing?" Hun Lingwu asked while holding back his intention to kill the demons.

Qing Qiu’er turned to Hun Lingwu and explained to him, "After all, not all demons are evil, and many of them are far better than us humans. As long as they don’t cause trouble, I have no problem accepting them into my sect."
"I see."
Qing Qiu’er immediately took them to the domain hall and the book hall, where they met two of Zhang Fei’s wives there, Shangguan Yan and Shang Ziyuan.

Thereafter, Qing Qiu’er led them to the array hall, where they saw Duanmu Luolan, Fa Shen, and Liao Hanxue discussing some matters. Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu were shocked when they saw the second woman, and they naturally recognized the Liao Clan’s symbol on her dress.
Their last stop was the soul hall, where Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu saw soul cultivators discussing something.

chapters.title: Chapter 1391: Mo Anqi - Mo Yousha Joins
paragraphs: After surveying the entire Moonlit Passion Sect, Hun Lingwu decided to leave the sect, followed by his disciple. Everyone in the Soul Hall breathed a sigh of relief after they left, especially Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing.

However, Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing had a bad feeling about Hun Lingwu, and one of them asked Qing Qiu’er, "Sister Qiu’er, do you think he won’t cause trouble for our sect with your words like that? I’m afraid he’ll bring great trouble to my junior disciple, and he’ll face serious trouble if that old man decides to fight him."

"Would you believe that Zhang Fei asked me to say that, Qiuyue?" Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing were surprised at Qing Qiu’er’s question. "Hun Lingwu is strong, but he is not as strong as the demon gods, and he still has fatal weaknesses. Before he took his two wives away, he already left me a message about that lecherous old man, and he has no fear of him at all. He would rather not see him now because he still has other matters, but he will deal with him if he does cause trouble for our sect."

Jing Qiuyue nodded to Qing Qiu’er, but Yan Yinqing immediately questioned her, "It can’t be that junior brother asked you to say that, right? You’re deliberately making excuses to Hun Lingwu so he won’t bother us, right?"

"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that. "Why don’t you want to be his wife, Yinqing? I understand that Qiuyue doesn’t want to be his wife because she loves Qiao Liangren, and she has always loved him now, even though he is not willing to accept her."
Qiao Liangren smiled bitterly as Jing Qiuyue looked at him, but he really couldn’t accept another woman, especially after Yue Qinhua regained her past memories.

Yue Qinhua had repeatedly persuaded Qiao Liangren, especially since she loved him deeply. However, he rejected her idea because he didn’t have any feelings for his senior sister, and he always considered her as one.

Yan Yinqing shook her head vigorously again and again. "My junior brother does have the qualities to be my husband, but he already has too many wives, and I won’t be able to contain my jealousy towards them. Besides, I’m still young now compared to you, so I don’t need to rush to choose my husband, and I will probably choose one when I’m truly ready."

"I hope you find your husband soon so you don’t feel lonely anymore." Qing Qiu’er looked out. "It seems like those two young female demons have already made up their minds to join our sect, so I’ll go meet them now."
After saying that, Qing Qiu’er immediately left the Soul Hall, followed by You Feiling.
"Hey, Yinqing! Are you truly in love with our junior brother now?" Lin Moxian questioned Yan Yinqing.
Hun Di, Jing Qiuyue, and the others also looked at Yan Yinqing, waiting for her answer.

"No." Yan Yinqing immediately denied it firmly. "I do have an interest in our junior brother, but I’ve never truly fallen in love with him, let alone considered becoming his wife. When I find a man who can make me fall in love, I will definitely introduce him to all of you, so you don’t have to be curious like this."
’Big liar!’ All of them screamed in their hearts because it was clear that Yan Yinqing had fallen in love with Zhang Fei, but she was not willing to admit her feelings.
Yan Yinqing asked Lin Moxian. "When are you going to impregnate your wife? Are you still not ready to be a father?"
"Hahaha." Lin Moxian laughed at that. "You should ask my wife about that matter, Yinqing. I’ve wanted a child from her for a long time, but she was never ready to be pregnant with my child."
Yan Yinqing shook her head in response. "Forget it! Many disciples are waiting for us to practice soul cultivation."
"I will return to the Puppetry Hall right now."
"Are you two interested in joining my sect?"

Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha turned to Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling. "Is it okay if the two of us join your sect? We are both members of the Celestial Demon Race, and many people hate us because of our father’s attitude. Our presence here might cause trouble for you all, and other cultivators will consider attacking you if we join this sect."

"It’s not that we want to look down on other cultivators, but we’re not afraid to confront them. Furthermore, you’ve noticed that there are several demon races here, and none of them have dared to bother us so far." Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha nodded to Qing Qiu’er, who immediately continued. "If you join our sect, you two can’t act like princesses, and you’ll have the same status as other disciples. Is that okay with you two?"
"We understand the situation, and we have no problem mingling with all the other disciples." Mo Anqi turned to Mo Yousha. "What do you think about that, Big Sis? Shall we join this sect?"
Mo Yousha naturally had no problem with that because she was completely obedient to Zhang Fei. "Let’s join this sect, and we can inform our mother via voice transmission."
"Yeah." Mo Anqi directly spoke to Qing Qiu’er. "We will join your sect from today, Sect Master Qing."

"That’s good." Qing Qiu’er ordered an elder to give the two female demons disciple tokens, and she also asked him to give them several sets of uniforms so they would appear the same as the other disciples. "Are you two interested in dual cultivation? Or do you want to learn other things outside of dual cultivation?"

Mo Anqi was the first to answer. "I’m not interested in dual cultivation, and I’m more interested in array formations. There is an array hall in this sect, and I am keen to join that hall, Sect Master Qing."
"How about you?" Qing Qiu’er asked Mo Yousha.
Mo Yousha thought for a long time, considering her options before answering Qing Qiu’er’s question. "If it’s okay, I’d like to join the Sword Hall and the Assassin Hall, Sect Master Qing."
"I see." Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "If that’s your wish, you can join all three halls, and the administrators of all three halls will accept you as members."
"Yes." After they got their sect identities and uniforms, You Feiling immediately took Mo Yousha and Mo Anqi to the residence for demons.

"With their presence, four demon races have joined our sect, and we still have to wait for the other two. As for the remaining demon races, I need to wait for news from Zhang Fei regarding them." Qing Qiu’er turned to the newly arrived Tian Huangjin and Tianshi Shengjie. "What do you two think of those two demon women?"
"I have no problem with their presence." Tianshi Shengjie replied casually.
Tian Huangjin also replied. "As long as they don’t cause trouble in the sect, I have no problem with their presence either."
"Does that mean my brother-in-law has succeeded in subduing the Celestial Demon Race?" Nalan Wangzi immediately asked as soon as she arrived there.

"Yes." Qing Qiu’er nodded in response. "For now, the Celestial Demon Race is already under Zhang Fei’s control, but Mo Shentian is still roaming freely out there. Even so, he’ll be trapped in the passageway to the Three Mortal Realms for a long time, and he’ll be late when he returns. For now, he’s still thinking of a way to subdue the remaining four demon races, but that task is definitely not easy, especially subduing the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God. Qian Yan has ties to the four perils, and they will attack us if he’s not careful."

Nalan Wangzi nodded in understanding. "The four perils are immortal-rank beasts, and my brother-in-law is a mythical beast. Even if he doesn’t use his beast form, those four beasts will definitely be able to suppress him with their superior beast ranks. He won’t act foolishly by provoking them because that would only harm himself, and he must find the right opportunity to subdue Qian Yan."

"You’re right." Qing Qiu’er nodded in agreement. "However, you forget that Qian Yan has extraordinary middle eye abilities, so he must be extremely careful when facing him. If he is careless and makes a mistake that reveals himself, the demon god will definitely attack us, and we will have difficulty facing him with his terrifying eye abilities."
"That’s true." Nalan Wangzi asked again. "What is his next plan while subduing the Celestial Demon Race?"

"Nothing." Qing Qiu’er replied with a shake of her head. "For now, Zhang Fei is still waiting for Shang Luohu’s decision, but she will not be able to decide quickly. After all, the decisions of the Asura Demon Race are not in her hands; all decisions are in the hands of Shang Zhanluo. He is in seclusion now, and we don’t know when he will come out of it, so we can only wait for now. Is there any news from your father about Tian Qiye’s movements, Huangjin?"

"Actually, I came to see you today to discuss that matter." Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow at Tian Huangjin. "My father asked me to return to our domain because Tian Qiye will soon be coming out of seclusion, and she will be inquiring about everyone’s whereabouts, including mine and Tian Huotian’s. Therefore, we must return to our domain, or the situation will become serious if she has already exited her seclusion."

Is there any news from your father about Tian Qiye’s movements, Huangjin?"
"Actually, I came to see you today to discuss that matter." Qing Qiu’er raised an eyebrow at Tian Huangjin.
"My father asked me to return to our domain because Tian Qiye will soon be coming out of seclusion, and she will be inquiring about everyone’s whereabouts, including mine and Tian Huotian’s.
Therefore, we must return to our domain, or the situation will become serious if she has already exited her seclusion."

chapters.title: Chapter 1392: Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror
paragraphs: After their discussion, Tian Huangjin and Tian Huotian left the Moonlit Passion Temple, but Tian Zhiling did not join them.

After the two left, Qing Qiu’er returned to the mountaintop. Meanwhile, Nalan Wangzi and Tianshi Shengjie returned to the residence behind the mountain, waiting for Zhang Fei or his four clones to return.
Hun Lingwu and his disciple had arrived at the Immortal Soul Palace in the Samsara Domain. "Are you still thinking about the two women at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Master?"

"Haha." Hun Lingwu patted his shoulder. "They are truly attractive, and their faces are also charming, so I must do something to get them both. If I can get them, I can use their bodies and souls as my cultivation furnace. They will help me to break through to a higher stage, the Celestial God Realm."

Hun Tianyu released a helpless sigh and spoke to his master. "Master, have you forgotten what the people from the Fei Clan said? They said that Zhang Fei is Empress Huo’s fiancé, and our sect will be in big trouble if you have to deal with her. Since she returned, some of her subordinates have slaughtered many people from various clans, and she will send them after us if we do anything to her fiancé. Those two women are indeed beautiful, and I am attracted to them, but the sacrifice we have to make is not worth getting them."
"Hmm?" Hun Lingwu narrowed his eyes while thinking. "What can we do to get those two women without alerting Empress Huo?"

"Nothing." Hun Tianyu replied with a shake of his head. "Since Zhang Fei is Empress Huo’s fiancé, she certainly won’t let him out of her sight, and she’s probably already sent her subordinates to protect him. If we act rashly against them, we’ll be the ones regretting it later, so you should think things through carefully before acting."

Hun Lingwu nodded in agreement with his disciple, but he had already decided that Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing were his next targets, and he would never change his mind. He was seriously considering how to obtain both women, no matter what the cost, including facing Empress Huo.

Hun Tianyu could only sigh inwardly because his master was clearly not listening to him and was still focused on finding ways to obtain Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing. "Master, you should act carefully regarding those two women, lest your actions destroy the sect. I still have something to do, so I will go back to my room now, and you need to call me if you need my help."

"Yes." After his disciple left, Hun Lingwu took out a strange mirror with dragon and phoenix carvings on both sides. He pulled a strand of his memories and placed it there, which displayed the figures of Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing. He stared at both women with a lustful gaze, with his saliva dripping from his mouth, as he truly wanted to use their bodies and souls as his cultivation furnace. "What can I do to obtain the bodies and souls of these two women? Is Zhang Fei really that strong? Why is Qing Qiu’er so confident that I can’t defeat him? Is it because he has Empress Huo’s backing?"
Hun Lingwu grinned faintly, and he took out some kind of liquid before pouring it into the strange mirror, which slowly affected Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing.

"Hahaha," Hun Lingwu laughed with satisfaction after doing that. "Fortunately, I discovered this Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror a long time ago, and it always helps me get the women I want. For now, I just need to be patient, and those two women will come to me on their own to offer their bodies to me. At that time, I can use their bodies and souls to increase my cultivation, and my dream of reaching the Celestial God Realm will be closer to reality."
After he put the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror back into his storage ring, Hun Lingwu hurriedly went to his room, where a young woman was sitting on the bed, naked.
The young woman’s gaze was languid because Hun Lingwu had used a soul technique on her to completely control her consciousness, making her obey his every whim.
Hun Lingwu stripped off his clothes, exposing his aged body. He pulled the young woman onto his lap and began dual cultivation with her, which elicited a slightly pained expression.

Zhang Fei [5] brought the two women to Radiant Starfall Domain, where Zhong Yan was preparing the building that he had purchased some time ago for his new shop. "When can we start opening our shop in this domain, Yan’er?"

"We have to finish some repairs on this building, and we can open our shop in another week, husband." Zhong Yan then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Have you checked the other buildings you own in the different domains? When will they be finished with the repairs so we can open shops in all of them?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Zhong Yan about the buildings he had purchased in several other domains. Just like their building in that domain, the others also needed repairs, and the longest one would take about two weeks to complete. "I believe we can open our shop in this domain more quickly than in the others, especially considering that the repairs in the other domain will take two weeks to complete."

"I see." Zhong Yan nodded in understanding. "For now, I haven’t faced any major problems in this domain, but the situation might change once we open our shop. The old shop owners in this domain might become hostile towards us once our shop opens, so I need your help to take care of them."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response. "You don’t need to worry about the old shop owners; I’ll take care of them all by myself. Additionally, I’ll leave some evil beasts here to help you when our shop opens, so they can protect this shop when I’m not here."

"I think two evil beasts are enough to help me, and you should also protect my other sisters in other domains." Zhang Yan then asked another question. "When will your true body finish dual cultivation with Qi Qingxiu?"

Zhang Fei [5] laughed wryly at the question. "Qi Qingxiu has been alone for a long time, and she has never experienced sexual pleasure. I don’t know when she will be truly satisfied with dual cultivation with my real body, so I will satisfy her first."

"You can go back to our domain first and let me take care of our shop in this domain. We will open in a week, and you must be present at that time to manage any clans that may try to cause trouble for us." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement to Zhong Yan, and he immediately took Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu to other domains. "I have to speed up the renovation of this shop."
After inspecting all the shops in other domains, Zhang Fei [5] brought Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu back to Moonlit Passion Temple, especially since it was already midnight.
When the three of them arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Zhang Fei [5]’s two senior sisters were already waiting for him there.
"Junior brother."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing. "What happened, Senior Sisters?"
Sima Huiqing and Yan Jinwu knew that something was wrong with Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing, and they left them to talk to Zhang Fei [5] so that the two women wouldn’t feel awkward with them.
"I feel something is wrong with me." Yan Yinqing answered.
Jing Qiuyue nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Just like Yan Yinqing, I also feel something strange about me."

"How do you two feel?" Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing told Zhang Fei [5] that something was pulling them, but they couldn’t explain the feelings they were experiencing clearly. "When did you two start to feel those feelings?"
"A few hours after Hun Lingwu left this sect."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow at their answer. "Did that old man ever touch either of you before?"
"No."
Jing Qiuyue then said. "Our Master has already tried examining both of us, including our souls. He couldn’t find anything strange in our souls, which left us confused about our condition."
"Release your souls, Senior Sisters."
Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing followed Zhang Fei [5]’s words by releasing their souls so he could examine their souls. However, he also couldn’t see any strangeness in their souls, which confused him.

Zhang Fei [5] thought seriously about the matter of the two women, and he was sure that Hun Lingwu had done something to their souls. However, he could not find anything in their souls, which made him think hard about their situation.

[Master, I’m sure that old man must have used his soul cultivation technique on your two senior sisters. That’s why they felt so strange in their souls, but I couldn’t find anything strange in theirs either.]

’I also think the same as you, and this must be the work of that damn old man.’ Zhang Fei [5] returned the souls of the two women to their bodies and then spoke to them. "Senior sisters, I can’t find any abnormalities in the souls of the two of you, so I’m at a loss to cure you. To prevent any unwanted incidents, you two should enter the training space so that the old man cannot harm either of you."
