After he sent the two women into the training space, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the Moonlit Passion Temple and went to the Samsara Domain.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Samsara Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Generating new quests.]
[Quest: Steal the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when the quest notification appeared. "Where can I find that item? What kind of Artifact is that?"

[Based on the data in the system, the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror is a forbidden dual cultivation artifact, Master. The strongest sect in this domain is the Immortal Soul Palace, so the mirror artifact is probably there. If my guess is correct, it should be in Hun Lingwu’s hands, and he used it on your two senior sisters.]
"Show me the item description, Mei."
[Wait a minute, Master.]

[The Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror is a forbidden dual cultivation artifact that causes individuals of the opposite gender to become uncontrollably drawn to its owner; it will lead the opposite sex to slowly fall for the owner. When used during dual cultivation, the mirror releases a soft soul-harmonizing aura, synchronizing their breathing, qi circulation, and heartbeats.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned after reading the item description. "So, it’s true, huh? That artifact must have been in that old man’s hands, and he used it on my senior sisters."
Zhang Fei [5] activated his invisibility and infiltrated the Immortal Soul Palace. To his surprise, there were not many formations protecting the sect, allowing him to infiltrate easily.

With the help of the system map, Zhang Fei [5] was able to find Hun Lingwu’s room easily. He frowned when he saw the old man dual cultivating with a young woman, but he could see that she was not in her consciousness, and she was being controlled by the old man.

Zhang Fei [5] clenched his teeth after seeing that. He would rather not deal with Hun Lingwu for now, but he had no other choice because he had to free Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing from the old man’s influence, or they would really fall into his arms like that woman.

Zhang Fei [5] infiltrated Hun Lingwu’s room and looked for the whereabouts of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror, but he couldn’t find it anywhere. He looked at the storage ring on the old man’s finger, and he was sure that he had hidden the mirror inside.

Zhang Fei [5] smirked faintly. ’Actually, I didn’t want to do anything with you for now, but you’ve gone too far by using your artifact on my two senior sisters, so I’ll teach you a lesson you’ll never forget for the rest of your life.’
Zhang Fei [5] activated the soul link and borrowed the power of the remaining evil beasts in his beast space, making his power increase several times and surpassing Hun Lingwu.
After that, Zhang Fei [5] approached them and touched Hun Lingwu’s body, using his lust manipulation on him.
Hun Lingwu’s eyes trembled after he inhaled the pink gas that came from Zhang Fei [5]’s body, and he became completely aroused by the effects of the pink gas.

Hun Lingwu opened his eyes, but they became extremely red, and there was only lust in them. He wanted to pounce on the woman, but Zhang Fei [5] restricted his movements and seized his storage ring, making him release a lustful roar.

Zhang Fei [5] pulled the young woman from Hun Lingwu’s lap, but he sighed with pity because her condition was similar to that of a doll. He used illusion manipulation on the old man, making him fantasize that he was fucking a woman.

’Haha.’ Zhang Fei [5] laughed with satisfaction seeing Hun Lingwu act like he was in heat, and he continued to fuck the woman in his illusion like a horny wolf. ’Are you able to hijack his storage ring, Mei?’
[Unfortunately, I can’t do that, Master.]

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh, but he was shocked when a crimson flame came out from his body and transformed into Feng Yao. She took out Hun Lingwu’s storage ring, opened it, and took out the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.
Feng Yao promptly erased Hun Lingwu’s mark from the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror, enabling Zhang Fei [5] to use it. "This is the mirror."
Zhang Fei [5] accepted the mirror happily and dripped his blood onto the artifact, allowing him to become the new owner of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.
[Quest: Steal the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Special gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
Feng Yao looked at the young woman. "Huo Ling will bring this woman to me."
"Do you know this woman?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
Feng Yao shook her head in response. "I don’t know her personally, but I know her great-grandparents. Therefore, I will bring her back to my domain to heal her, and I will restore her condition."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
Soon, Huo Ling arrived in the room, but she didn’t say anything, and she took the young woman away.
Feng Yao spoke directly to Zhang Fei [5]. "Use your other demon abilities on this old man."

"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] used his demon touch on Hun Lingwu, causing him to fall unconscious from multiple orgasms. He used memory manipulation on the old man, altering his memories of the young woman and the artifact. He also used his body modification ability on the old man, reducing his genital size significantly to prevent him from harming other women. "Hahaha! He would probably die standing if he realized his condition."

Feng Yao didn’t say anything about it, put Hun Lingwu’s storage ring on his finger, and re-entered Zhang Fei [5]’s body. ’Don’t do anything else to him, let alone kill him; I still need him in the future.’
Zhang Fei [5] left the Immortal Soul Palace and returned to the Moonlit Passion Sect before entering the training space.
When he arrived at the pavilion, Zhang Fei [5] saw three women chatting with each other. "Oh? You guys are going to get along quickly, huh?"
"Junior brother, you managed to rescue her, and you have made the right decision to save her from the Celestial Demon Race." Yan Yinqing said.
Jing Qiuyue also said. "Junior brother, we’ve heard her story, so you have to free her and let her return to her family."

"Didn’t I save her from the Celestial Demon Race?" Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly sat down in front of them. "However, I can’t free her for now because I still need her to convince her father to join us, and I will release her after Shang Zhanluo makes his decision."
"But—"

"It’s okay." Shang Xueli stopped Jing Qiuyue. "Even though my life is like this now, I’m in a better state than if I became a puppet in the Celestial Demon Race. I don’t regret this, and I will wait for your junior brother to successfully convince my father to join him."
Yan Yinqing asked him. "Did you manage to find anything from that old man, Junior Brother?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] took out the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror. "That old man used this mirror on you two, so you felt attracted to him. He was thinking of using you as cultivation furnaces because I found a woman in his room, and she wasn’t in good condition. Fortunately, I managed to snatch this mirror, but I don’t know how to remove its effects from your bodies yet."
Yan Yinqing took the mirror and looked at it seriously. "What kind of artifact is this, Junior Brother?"

Zhang Fei [5] explained the effects of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror to the three women, which caused them to frown. "I will analyze this artifact for a few days to find a way to remove its effects from your two bodies, so you won’t feel like this anymore."
"Hmm?" Jing Qiuyue looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Why do I feel that my attraction has shifted to you?"
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at his senior sister with repeated winks. "Do you really feel that way, Senior Sister?"
"Yes." Jing Qiuyue nodded.
Yan Yinqing just realized this and spoke to him. "I feel that too, Junior Brother. I no longer think about that old man, but I now think about you."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] began to contemplate why the feelings of the two women shifted toward him after he snatched the mirror from Hun Lingwu. "Perhaps your feelings shifted toward me because I am now the owner of this mirror. Feng Yao helped me erase the old man’s mark, and I marked this mirror with my blood so I am its owner now. If you two feel that way, it means the effect applies to the owner."
"Can you remove the effects of this artifact from us, Junior Brother?" Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing asked in unison.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I can’t do it now, and I will analyze this artifact first. Once I find the solution, I will remove its influence from you two."

He wanted to pounce on the woman, but Zhang Fei [5] restricted his movements and seized his storage ring, making him release a lustful roar.
Zhang Fei [5] pulled the young woman from Hun Lingwu’s lap, but he sighed with pity because her condition was similar to that of a doll.
He used illusion manipulation on the old man, making him fantasize that he was fucking a woman.

’Haha.’ Zhang Fei [5] laughed with satisfaction seeing Hun Lingwu act like he was in heat, and he continued to fuck the woman in his illusion like a horny wolf. ’Are you able to hijack his storage ring, Mei?’
[Unfortunately, I can’t do that, Master.]
Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh, but he was shocked when a crimson flame came out from his body and transformed into Feng Yao.
She took out Hun Lingwu’s storage ring, opened it, and took out the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.
Feng Yao promptly erased Hun Lingwu’s mark from the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror, enabling Zhang Fei [5] to use it.
"This is the mirror."
Zhang Fei [5] accepted the mirror happily and dripped his blood onto the artifact, allowing him to become the new owner of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.

"That old man used this mirror on you two, so you felt attracted to him.

Fortunately, I managed to snatch this mirror, but I don’t know how to remove its effects from your bodies yet."
Yan Yinqing took the mirror and looked at it seriously.
"What kind of artifact is this, Junior Brother?"
Zhang Fei [5] explained the effects of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror to the three women, which caused them to frown.
"I will analyze this artifact for a few days to find a way to remove its effects from your two bodies, so you won’t feel like this anymore."
"Hmm?" Jing Qiuyue looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"Why do I feel that my attraction has shifted to you?"
"Eh?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at his senior sister with repeated winks.
"Do you really feel that way, Senior Sister?"
"Yes." Jing Qiuyue nodded.
Yan Yinqing just realized this and spoke to him.
"I feel that too, Junior Brother.
I no longer think about that old man, but I now think about you."

"Perhaps your feelings shifted toward me because I am now the owner of this mirror.
Feng Yao helped me erase the old man’s mark, and I marked this mirror with my blood so I am its owner now.
If you two feel that way, it means the effect applies to the owner."
"Can you remove the effects of this artifact from us, Junior Brother?" Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing asked in unison.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head.
"I can’t do it now, and I will analyze this artifact first.
Once I find the solution, I will remove its influence from you two."

chapters.title: Chapter 1394: Jun Qingling
paragraphs: Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing looked at Zhang Fei [5], who was sitting in another area while observing the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.
"What will happen to us if our junior brother can’t remove the mirror’s effect, senior sister?" Yan Yinqing asked, looking at Zhang Fei [5].

Jing Qiuyue could only sigh and shake her head at Yan Yinqing’s question. "I don’t know what will happen to us, but I’m grateful that we won’t fall into the arms of that perverted old man. Even though I don’t have feelings for our junior brother, I think it would be better if we fell into his arms than falling into the old man’s arms."
"Haish." Yan Yinqing wore a tangled look. "I don’t want to fall into anyone’s arms, be it our junior brother or that old man."

"Do we both have any other choice? We were too careless, and we didn’t expect that old man to possess such a cultivation technique. He could use our shadows to influence us to this extent, and we couldn’t do anything to dispel the effect." Yan Yinqing’s expression worsened after Jing Qiuyue made that statement. "I have never loved our junior brother, and I only love Qiao Liangren. If the situation forces me to choose, I will choose him rather than fall into the hands of that damned old man."

Yan Yinqing slouched at the table, and her eyes kept looking at Zhang Fei [5]. "Our junior brother is indeed handsome, and his cultivation has already surpassed all of us, including our master. Unfortunately, he has too many wives, and I can’t accept that kind of man, so it’s difficult for me to accept him."

"You two should calm down; I’m sure Zhang Fei [5] can find the best solution for both of you. You only need to give him time to find the solution, and you two don’t need to be his women." Jing Qiuyue and Yan Yinqing turned to Shang Xueli. "Isn’t my situation proof of that? My parents couldn’t save me from Mo Shentian, even though my father was a demon god. However, your junior brother was able to save me from that endless hell, and he also restored my consciousness, so I believe he can free you two from the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror’s influence."

Jing Qiuyue nodded to her. "Our junior brother has never disappointed us so far, and I believe he will find a solution to stop the mirror’s influence on us. That way, both of us don’t need to be his women, and our relationship will remain as before."

"You have so much faith in our junior brother, huh?" Yan Yinqing sighed softly. "He has indeed done many impressive things, and his cultivation has surpassed all of ours. However, he is not omnipotent, and there are many things he cannot do. I wish he could free us from the mirror’s influence, but I doubt he will find a way to do that."

Jing Qiuyue shook her head. "If he can’t remove the mirror’s influence from us, then we’ll just have to become his woman, right? Even though I don’t love him now, I might change after becoming one, so I didn’t think too much about it."

"Hmm?" Yan Yinqing squinted her eyes as she felt suspicious of her senior sister. "Why do I believe you’ve changed now, Senior Sister? Why do I believe you’re actually interested in our junior brother? Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten Qiao Liangren, and you are indeed interested in our junior brother."

"You’re wrong about that." Jing Qiuyue denied her guess with a shake of her head. "My feelings for Qiao Liangren have never changed, but I have to accept the fact that he never loved me, and he only loves Yue Qinhua. Even though I don’t have feelings for our junior brother, I can learn to love him, and I might fall in love with him later."

"Haha." Shang Xueli laughed at that. "Sometimes, life doesn’t go according to our plans, and fate leads us to other choices. In the past, I loved my lover very much, but Mo Shentian killed him, and he forced me to marry Mo Zixiao. Although I am no longer pure, I am grateful because I am finally free from him, and all this was possible thanks to Zhang Fei [5]."
"What will you do after our junior brother frees you, Xueli?" Yan Yinqing curiously asked.
Jing Qiuyue also asked her. "Do you have any plans after our junior brother frees you?"

"Hmm?" Shang Xueli fell into thought. "For now, I don’t have any plans yet, and I just want to be reunited with my parents. For the future, I still have to see what lies ahead, and I will decide then. By the way, are the two Zhang Fei his clones? Where is his real body now?"

Yan Yinqing nodded to her. "Our junior brother has five clones, and these two are among them. One of his clones is in your Asura Demon Domain doing something, and his other two clones are off taking care of things in other domains."

"His real body is with Qi Qingxiu, and he is accompanying the Seven Emotions Demon God." Shang Xueli’s jaw dropped when Jing Qiuyue mentioned this. "You might not know about this, but our junior brother is a lust demon."

Shang Xueli suddenly turned to Zhang Fei [5], especially since he did not have the characteristics of a demon. She had seen Zhang Xiaolong [3] in his half-beast form, and she thought that he was a fox beast, but it turned out that he was also a demon.

"Our junior brother is a unique individual because he is a human, a fox beast, and a lust demon." Shang Xueli returned her gaze to Yan Yinqing, who immediately shared Zhang Fei [5]’s two other forms with her. "Just see them for yourself."

Shang Xueli nodded and closed her eyes, but her expression turned to astonishment when she saw Zhang Fei [5]’s complete fox form, and she really liked his pure white fur. Soon, she opened her eyes again and looked at the two women. "How can he have three identities in one body? I’ve never seen a living creature like him, and he’s probably the only person who has multiple identities."

Both Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue shook their heads at her, especially since they didn’t know about it. "We were as surprised as you when we learned about his three forms, but we were already used to them. He wasn’t as lustful as he is now, and he became extremely lustful after he turned into a lust demon."

"I see." Shang Xueli nodded in understanding and looked at Zhang Fei [5] again, who was still seriously thinking about how to free Yan Yinqing and Jing Qiuyue from the influence of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror. ’Perhaps, he really does have the ability to unite all races, and he might be the only person who succeeds in doing so.’
Thereafter, the three women talked about other things, especially Zhang Fei [5]’s goals for the future after he successfully united all races.
"Who is this woman, Yao’er? Why is she in such a condition?"

Feng Yao immediately explained the young woman’s condition to Feng Jiu, and she ordered Huo Ling to go to another domain to find out about the woman’s family. "She fell into the hands of a heretical soul cultivator, and he caused her to be like this. However, her condition is not a significant problem for me, and I can easily restore it."
"Who is the heretical soul cultivator you are referring to?" Feng Jiu asked again.

"His name is Hun Lingwu, and he is the leader of the Immortal Soul Palace in the Samsara Domain." Feng Yao touched the woman’s forehead. "Actually, many of my subordinates were victims of that heretic, but I forbade them from killing him because he still has an important role to play in the future."
Feng Jiu looked at her daughter curiously, but she knew that Feng Yao wouldn’t tell her anything, so she chose not to ask her anything.
After some time, Feng Yao pulled her hand back from the young woman’s forehead, and she tried to wake her up.
"Mhmm..." The young woman slowly opened her eyes and looked at Feng Yao. "Where am I? Were you the one who saved me from that old man?"

"Yes." Feng Yao helped the young woman sit up. "You’re safe now, and that old man won’t be able to remember you anymore. You’re in my domain, the Blazing Nirvana Domain. The woman beside me is my mother, Feng Jiu."
"Eh?" The woman was surprised to hear that. "Are... are you Empress Huo Yanling?"
"I am the reincarnation of Huo Yanling." The young woman wanted to get off the bed, but Feng Yao stopped her. "I saved you because you are the granddaughter of Jun Wuyou and Lian Meiyun."

The young woman was truly grateful that Feng Yao had saved her. "I owe you my life, Empress Huo. My name is Jun Qingling, and Hun Lingwu kidnapped me when I was separated from my grandparents several years ago."
"I see." Feng Yao rubbed the mark on the young woman’s forehead. "I can recognize you because you have this birthmark, and the main members of the Jun Clan are the only ones who have it."
"Master." Huo Ling appeared in the room. "I’ve brought the members of the Jun Clan here, and they’re waiting for you in the main hall."

chapters.title: Chapter 1395: The Jun Clan
paragraphs: "Grandpa! Grandma! Father! Mother!"
The four guests in the main hall were shocked when they saw Jun Qingling, and three of them rushed to her, hugging her tightly while crying.
Jun Wuyou was also happy about the return of his granddaughter, but he knew that was not the time for that. He raised his hand to Feng Yao. "I assume you are Empress Huo, right?"

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed at that. "Jun Wuyou, I haven’t seen you for a long time, but I didn’t expect you to have become so dull. You even lost your granddaughter under your nose, and she had to suffer for so long because of your carelessness. Fortunately, my friend infiltrated the residence of your granddaughter’s kidnapper, and I immediately recognized your family mark."

Jun Wuyou sighed guiltily as he looked at Jun Qingling in the arms of his wife and children. "Thank you; you saved Qingling from her kidnapper, Empress Huo. I was too careless at that time, which made the kidnapper succeed in targeting her. I’ve been looking for her kidnapper for a long time, but I never managed to find that person."

"The kidnapper is Hun Lingwu." Feng Yao’s answer shocked Jun Wuyou and his family, but her next words shocked them even more. "For years, he used your granddaughter as a cultivation furnace, and I discovered her by accident. I decided to save her after I recognized her birthmark, and I brought her here to recover her condition."
Jun Wuyou felt sad after hearing all that, and his granddaughter had to suffer for several years because of his carelessness.

Lian Meiyun was also sad to hear about her granddaughter’s situation over the past few years, and she let go of her from her embrace. "Empress Huo, was it really Hun Lingwu who kidnapped Qingling? Why did he do that? Didn’t he—"

"You guys always thought he was a good guy, right?" Lian Meiyun and Jun Wuyou nodded at Feng Yao. "That old man has never been a kind person, and he used dozens of women for his cultivation furnace. Many of my subordinates are his former victims, but I can’t kill him because I still need him for something. I also forbid you from taking any action against him, as someone else will deal with him once I no longer need him."
"But—"

"Do you guys want to defy my orders?" Feng Yao asked with a smile, but the people from the Jun Clan gulped hard, and their bodies trembled with fear. "I will turn Hun Lingwu over to you when I am done using him, and you are free to punish him then."
Jun Wuyou and Lian Meiyun exchanged glances before sighing in resignation. "Alright, we will follow your orders, Empress Huo."
"Good." Feng Yao spoke to them again. "I want your Jun Clan to join the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Huh?" The four people were shocked by that statement, and Jun Qingling’s father asked Feng Yao a question. "Isn’t the Moonlit Passion Temple a dual cultivation sect, Empress Huo?"
"Two members of my Gu clan have joined the Moonlit Passion Temple, so we can’t be mistaken in saying it’s a dual cultivation sect," Jun Qingling’s mother said to Feng Yao.

"You two are right about the old Moonlit Passion Temple, Gu Lanyin and Jun Wutian." Feng Yao immediately conjured a qi screen displaying the sect. "See? The sect has changed now, and it’s no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal sect. For now, they still lack members, so I want you to join the sect. Furthermore, there are already several big names joining them, including the Liao Clan from the Sky Pillar Domain."
"Eh?" They were shocked once again after Feng Yao mentioned the Liao Clan from the Sky Pillar Domain.
"Is the Liao Clan really joining the Moonlit Passion Temple, Empress Huo?" Lian Meiyun asked.

Feng Yao displayed the situation in the array hall of the Moonlit Passion Temple on the qi screen, where they saw Duanmu Luolan and Liao Hanxue discussing some formation arrays. "You guys should be able to recognize the Liao Clan’s young miss, right?"
"Yes."
Feng Yao displayed several other halls of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and the people of the Jun Clan could recognize the identities of the people who appeared there.
"Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng." Jun Wuyou muttered.
Lian Meiyun stared at the qi screen in a daze. "The Liao Clan, the You Clan, the Qiao Clan, and the Zhang Clan."
"Since when did those four clans join the Moonlit Passion Temple?" Gu Lanyin muttered in a daze.
Jun Wutian said quietly. "The Moonlit Passion Temple has changed now."
"The person who brought change to the sect was my son-in-law, Zhang Fei." The four looked at Feng Jiu before they looked at Feng Yao, who just smiled at them.

Feng Yao removed the qi screen and spoke to them. "The Moonlit Passion Temple has changed, and it will become the best sect in the future. Therefore, I want your three clans to join the sect, and you will gain more benefits by joining them."
"What do you think about that, husband?" Lian Meiyun asked Jun Wuyou.
Jun Wuyou immediately spoke to Feng Yao. "Our clan owes you a great debt, so we will join the Moonlit Passion Temple as you wish, Empress Huo."

"Good." Feng Yao tossed several bottles of pills to Jun Wuyao. "Zhang Fei concocted these pills for his sect members, and I’m giving them to you because you’ll soon be joining the sect. Use them well, and they will be beneficial to you in the future."

Jun Wuyou opened one of the pill bottles, and he was stunned by the pills inside. Seeing his reaction, Lian Meiyun, Gu Lanyin, and Jun Wutian tried to look into the bottle, but they were also stunned after seeing the five superior-grade pills inside.
Jun Qingling wiped her eyes and looked into the bottle, but she didn’t show the same reaction as them. She asked Feng Yao directly. "Are these pills concocted by your husband, Empress Huo?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded in response. "Zhang Fei is a god-rank alchemist, so you shouldn’t be surprised if he can concoct so many superior-grade pills. He’s also mastered some skills in other fields, such as array formations and blacksmithing. In those fields, he’s also reached the peak rank, and he’s now trying to expand the Moonlit Passion Temple, so he needs the help of many people. As long as you help him sincerely, he will also help you become even better."

Jun Wuyou closed the pill bottle and stored it with the others. He cupped his hands at Feng Yao. "In that case, we’ll return to our clan first, and I’ll also inform my in-laws about this matter. After we discuss it, we’ll go straight to the sect, and we’ll join your husband."
"You guys can go back now." After the Jun Clan members left, Feng Yao turned to Feng Jiu. "You are so eager for me to accept Zhang Fei as my husband, mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 1398: Jian Kuang’s Disciple
paragraphs: Jun Wuyou and his entourage were even more shocked upon their arrival at the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially since the sect had changed so much. The previously unused area below the mountain has been transformed into several halls, and roads have been built connecting them.
Additionally, the number of disciples had increased dramatically, but they didn’t know that it was the merger of two sects brought together by Zhang Fei.

They were truly shocked by the presence of Tian Kui and Serpentera, especially since they claimed to be the sect’s main guardians. No other sect has two guardians as strong as both of them, and their cultivation levels are among the highest in the Paradise Realm.

Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling met their guests. "Patriarch Jun! Patriarch Lian! Patriarch Gu! Welcome to the Moonlit Passion Temple! Elder Zhang already told me that you would be coming today, so I prepared myself to welcome your arrival."
"Can we meet Zhang Fei, Sect Master Qing?"

Qing Qiu’er shook her head at Jun Wuyou. "Unfortunately, Elder Zhang has entered seclusion again, so you can’t meet him. I don’t know when he will come out, and he might come out in a few days or a few months."
"Is she your granddaughter who was kidnapped by Hun Lingwu, Patriarch Jun?" You Feiling asked, glancing at Jun Qingling.
Jun Wuyou nodded at her. "If Zhang Fei and Empress Huo hadn’t rescued her, we would never have known that she fell into Hun Lingwu’s hands, and we would never have been able to gather again."

"She’s lucky," Qing Qiu’er said. "If Hun Lingwu hadn’t tried to do something to our two female disciples, Zhang Fei wouldn’t have entered the Immortal Soul Palace, and he wouldn’t have discovered that your granddaughter had become his cultivation furnace."

Jun Wuyou let out a heavy sigh. "Sect Master Qing, let’s not discuss the past anymore, and the most important thing is that my granddaughter has returned safely. Although she is no longer intact, at least she is still alive. For now, we may not have the ability to take revenge on that old bastard, but we will settle accounts with him in the future, and we will kill him when the time comes."

"Alright." Since Jun Qingling intended to join them, Qing Qiu’er asked You Feiling to bring her to take care of everything, and she led the people from the three clans to look around the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Even though they had already seen the new Moonlit Passion Temple when they met Feng Yao, the drastic changes in the sect still shocked them, mainly because the sect was no longer a dual cultivation sect, but they had become a universal sect. Moreover, the sect had other halls, starting with the sword hall, the assassin hall, the alchemy hall, and various others, which made them the most complete sect in the entire Paradise Realm.

While Qing Qiu’er was bringing people from the three clans to look around the sect, You Feiling had already brought Jun Qingling to the registration hall to take care of her registration. "You can choose the hall you are interested in yourself."

"Haha." Jun Qingling laughed wryly. "Vice Sect Master You, Hun Lingwu kidnapped me when I was young, and he’s been controlling me all this time, so I don’t have any expertise in any field. I’m at a loss as to which cultivation path to follow, so I’m at a loss as to which hall is most suitable for me."
"I see." You Feiling nodded in understanding. "How about you try practicing in all of those halls first? That way, you’ll find the one that’s most suitable for you, and you can join one of them."
"I think that’s a good idea." Jun Qingling nodded to her. "Vice Sect Master You, what do you think if I become a dual cultivator like you?"

You Feiling raised an eyebrow and looked at her in surprise. "Are you considering becoming a dual cultivator like me? Have you discussed it with your family? I’m sure your grandfather wouldn’t approve of you becoming a dual cultivator, and your parents wouldn’t agree to it either."

"Sigh." Jun Qingling sighed heavily. "What can I do now, Vice Sect Master You? I’m no longer a clean woman, and that old bastard has used my body repeatedly to improve his cultivation. Although I don’t like the path of dual cultivation, I think it’s the best way for me to catch up, and I can increase my strength more quickly through it. Once my strength improves, I will take revenge on that old bastard, and I want to kill him with my hands."

You Feiling nodded in understanding. "The path of dual cultivation can help you become stronger faster than normal cultivators, but you still have to hone your skills in other areas. If you don’t have skills in other areas, you’ll never be able to kill that old bastard. For now, there are two best paths you can choose: the path of dual cultivation and the path of the sword. The path of dual cultivation will help you improve your cultivation faster, and the path of the sword will give you more abilities if you want to take revenge on him. Have you ever studied swordsmanship before?"

"My grandfather and my father were skilled swordsmen, so I also studied swordsmanship, but I haven’t studied it to the fullest because that bastard kidnapped me." You Feiling knew that the Jun Clan was a clan of swordsmen, so she wasn’t surprised by Jun Qingling’s answer. "Who is the best swordsman in this sect, Vice Sect Master You?"
You Feiling smiled at that. "Our sect has three God Rank swordsmen: the sword maniac, Jian Kuang. Han Ling, and Zhang Fei."

"Eh?" Jun Qingling looked at her with repeated blinks. "Is Zhang Fei really a God Rank swordsman? I heard from Empress Huo that he was a God Rank alchemist, but she didn’t say anything else about him."

You Feiling told Jun Qingling about Zhang Fei’s abilities in other fields, which made her jaw drop. "He is the most perfect cultivator because he has expertise in other fields, but his main expertise is in dual cultivation, and he is an excellent dual cultivator."
"Eh?" Jun Qingling was shocked again. "Isn’t he Empress Huo’s husband? How could he be a dual cultivator?"

"Zhang Fei and Feng Yao’s relationship is a bit unique, but he is indeed a dual cultivator, and he has many other wives besides her." You Feiling pointed to the residence behind the mountain. "All of them live together in that residence, and their relationship is truly harmonious, like one big family. She herself knows about all her wives, and she never makes a big deal about it."
Jun Qingling nodded to her repeatedly, and an elder brought her uniforms along with the sect’s disciple identification. "Please take me to the sword hall, Vice Sect Master You."
"Let’s go."
A short while later, they arrived at the sword hall, where Jun Qingling saw Jian Kuang and Han Ling training the sect’s disciples.
Jian Kuang turned towards them, and he watched Jun Qingling seriously. He immediately moved towards them and asked her. "Are you a member of the Jun Clan?"
"Yes, Senior." Jun Qingling nodded to him. "It’s just that my abilities are inferior to those of my brothers and sisters, especially since I was kidnapped by an evil person several years ago."

"Hmm?" Jian Kuang turned to You Feiling, who immediately explained Jun Qingling’s situation to him. "That old man is indeed a bastard, and he has ruined the lives of many young girls over the years. However, no one dares to move to stop him because his soul cultivation technique is very special, and he can do things that no other soul cultivator can do. Since you’ve been freed from his control, you can return to a normal life, and you can restart your path of cultivation. If you’re interested in the way of the sword, I’ll teach you swordsmanship myself. Are you willing to be my disciples?"

Jun Qingling was overjoyed because training under a sword master like Jian Kuang would be very beneficial for her, and she was confident that she would be able to take revenge on Hun Lingwu more quickly.

"No need." Jian Kuang stopped her as she was about to kneel to him. "I don’t like formalities, so you don’t need to kneel to me. After all, I am indebted to your late great-grandfather for helping me so much before I became who I am today, and I accepted you as my disciple to repay him."
Jun Qingling cupped her hands and bowed slightly to him. "Thank you, master."

"Good." Jian Kuang touched her forehead and imparted a sword technique to her. "For now, I want you to read the entire technique, and you can come back to me here once you’ve understood everything in it."
"Yes, Master."
After that, You Feiling led Jun Qingling away from the sword hall, and she brought her to the disciples’ quarters.
Su Shentian approached Jian Kuang and asked him, "You accepted that girl as your disciple not because of her late great-grandfather, but for another reason, right?"

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed at that. "In my entire life, I never thought I would accept a disciple, let alone a female disciple. Although her talent is still raw, that little girl has a long future in the way of the sword, so I decided to take her as my first disciple."

Have you ever studied swordsmanship before?"

"My grandfather and my father were skilled swordsmen, so I also studied swordsmanship, but I haven’t studied it to the fullest because that bastard kidnapped me." You Feiling knew that the Jun Clan was a clan of swordsmen, so she wasn’t surprised by Jun Qingling’s answer.
"Who is the best swordsman in this sect, Vice Sect Master You?"
You Feiling smiled at that.
"Our sect has three God Rank swordsmen: the sword maniac, Jian Kuang.
Han Ling, and Zhang Fei."
"Eh?" Jun Qingling looked at her with repeated blinks.
"Is Zhang Fei really a God Rank swordsman?
I heard from Empress Huo that he was a God Rank alchemist, but she didn’t say anything else about him."
You Feiling told Jun Qingling about Zhang Fei’s abilities in other fields, which made her jaw drop.
"He is the most perfect cultivator because he has expertise in other fields, but his main expertise is in dual cultivation, and he is an excellent dual cultivator."
"Eh?" Jun Qingling was shocked again.
"Isn’t he Empress Huo’s husband?
How could he be a dual cultivator?"
"Zhang Fei and Feng Yao’s relationship is a bit unique, but he is indeed a dual cultivator, and he has many other wives besides her." You Feiling pointed to the residence behind the mountain.
"All of them live together in that residence, and their relationship is truly harmonious, like one big family.
She herself knows about all her wives, and she never makes a big deal about it."
Jun Qingling nodded to her repeatedly, and an elder brought her uniforms along with the sect’s disciple identification.
"Please take me to the sword hall, Vice Sect Master You."
"Let’s go."
A short while later, they arrived at the sword hall, where Jun Qingling saw Jian Kuang and Han Ling training the sect’s disciples.
Jian Kuang turned towards them, and he watched Jun Qingling seriously.
He immediately moved towards them and asked her.
"Are you a member of the Jun Clan?"
"Yes, Senior." Jun Qingling nodded to him.
"It’s just that my abilities are inferior to those of my brothers and sisters, especially since I was kidnapped by an evil person several years ago."
"Hmm?" Jian Kuang turned to You Feiling, who immediately explained Jun Qingling’s situation to him.
"That old man is indeed a bastard, and he has ruined the lives of many young girls over the years.
However, no one dares to move to stop him because his soul cultivation technique is very special, and he can do things that no other soul cultivator can do.
Since you’ve been freed from his control, you can return to a normal life, and you can restart your path of cultivation.
If you’re interested in the way of the sword, I’ll teach you swordsmanship myself.
Are you willing to be my disciples?"

Jun Qingling was overjoyed because training under a sword master like Jian Kuang would be very beneficial for her, and she was confident that she would be able to take revenge on Hun Lingwu more quickly.
"No need." Jian Kuang stopped her as she was about to kneel to him.
"I don’t like formalities, so you don’t need to kneel to me.
After all, I am indebted to your late great-grandfather for helping me so much before I became who I am today, and I accepted you as my disciple to repay him."
Jun Qingling cupped her hands and bowed slightly to him.
"Thank you, master."
"Good." Jian Kuang touched her forehead and imparted a sword technique to her.
"For now, I want you to read the entire technique, and you can come back to me here once you’ve understood everything in it."
"Yes, Master."
After that, You Feiling led Jun Qingling away from the sword hall, and she brought her to the disciples’ quarters.
Su Shentian approached Jian Kuang and asked him, "You accepted that girl as your disciple not because of her late great-grandfather, but for another reason, right?"
"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed at that.
"In my entire life, I never thought I would accept a disciple, let alone a female disciple.
Although her talent is still raw, that little girl has a long future in the way of the sword, so I decided to take her as my first disciple."

paragraphs: "What’s so special about that little girl?"

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed and turned away. "Old Su, you don’t need to be curious about that girl’s abilities, and you’ll hear her story in the future. You might think I’m bluffing, but I’m telling you the truth."
Su Shentian looked in the direction Jun Qingling had left. ’Little girl, my friend has never praised anyone so highly, so I hope I can witness your swordsmanship skills in the future.’
After that, Su Shentian disappeared from the sword hall before leaving the Moonlit Passion Sect.
After he had many talks with the people from the Fei Clan about Zhang Fei, Hun Lingwu and his disciple immediately returned to the Immortal Soul Palace.

Hun Lingwu considered going to the Moonlight Passion Sect, but he was worried about Zhang Fei’s relationship with Feng Yao. He wasn’t afraid of him, but he was terrified of her and feared that she would send her subordinates to destroy him. ’I have to find another way to capture that damn brat and take the mirror back from him, but I have to be careful not to attract the attention of that cruel empress, or I will be in big trouble if she finds out about my plans against her fiancé.’

"Master." Hun Lingwu turned to Hun Tianyu. "You must be careful if you want to act against Zhang Fei, or you will face Empress Huo, which will be a big problem for us. In my opinion, you should forget about the two women from the sect because he is clearly protecting them, and he might do something else to you. If you lose control of this sect, it will be even more difficult for you to get your next target."
"Leave."
"Alright." Hun Tianyu immediately left his master, sighing in his heart. ’I hope you won’t make the wrong decision regarding this incident, Master.’

After his disciple left, Hun Lingwu took off his clothes again. How could he shrink my cock to this small size? How could I use those women as my cultivation furnace if I’m in this condition?"
Hun Lingwu put his clothes back on and hurried out of the Immortal Soul Palace to seek help. "No matter what, I must take that mirror back from that damned brat."

After they had looked around the entire area of the Moonlit Passion Sect, the people from the three clans immediately left. They informed Qing Qiu’er that they would send some younger members from their clans to join her sect, which showed their goodwill for it.
After they left, Qing Qiu’er returned to the top of the mountain, where You Feiling was waiting for her. "What about Jun Qingling?"

"Jian Kuang took Jun Qingling as his direct disciple." Qing Qiu’er was really surprised by the sword maniac’s decision because he never wanted to take a disciple before, and You Feiling told her some other things. "Big sis, that little girl also wants to become a dual cultivator like us, but I’m afraid her family won’t agree with her wishes."
Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding. "That little girl wants revenge on Hun Lingwu, right?"
"Yes."

"I see." Qing Qiu’er sighed softly. "Being a dual cultivator wouldn’t be enough if she wanted revenge on the old man, but she would have to work hard in some other areas, but I don’t know her talents in other fields. As far as I know, the members of the Jun Clan are swordmasters, but she has long fallen into his control."

You Feiling nodded in agreement and asked again, "Do you think Zhang Fei is willing to take her as his partner? Although she has long been the old man’s cultivation furnace, she’s not a bad girl. In fact, she’s quite attractive as a woman, and he might be willing to accept her as a partner."

"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that. "Jun Qingling is indeed an attractive woman, but Zhang Fei might not be interested in her. If he were interested in her, I don’t think he would hand her over to Feng Yao and would take her straight back to our sect. If you want to help her, you can give his yang qi to her, which she can use to improve her cultivation."
"I’ve already given her a few bottles of his yang qi." Qing Qiu’er looked at You Feiling with a playful smile. "Why are you looking at me like that, Big Sis?"
Qing Qiu’er reached out and rubbed You Feiling’s cheek. "Are you trying to help that little girl because of your hatred for that old man? Do you intend to use her to take revenge on him?"

"Sigh." You Feiling shook her head at her. "I won’t use her to take revenge on that damned old man, and I can take my revenge on him. I just feel sorry for her, and I want to help her so she can be better."

Qing Qiu’er nodded in understanding and pulled her hand back. "That damned old man has used so many young women as his cultivation furnaces, and he will eventually get his comeuppance. For now, we do not need to deal with him, and we should only focus on developing this sect. I’m sure Zhang Fei has already taught him a lesson, and he probably won’t be able to commit his heinous acts like before again."
"What do you think Zhang Fei did to that damn old man?"

"Haha." You Feiling laughed at that. "If I think about it, Zhang Fei is indeed that kind of person, Big Sis. If he really did that to that old bastard, I’m sure he’ll regret it for the rest of his life because he’ll never be able to touch other women again."
Qing Qiu’er nodded in agreement. "Zhang Fei appears to be busy in his training space, so we should cultivate alone, or we will be overtaken by him."
"Yes."
"Hey, are you still thinking about our junior brother’s words last night? Do you truly want to become his woman?" Yan Yinqing curiously asked.
Jing Qiuyue let out a soft sigh, glancing at Qiao Liangren and Yue Qinhua. "Do you think I’m wrong if I do that? Do you think I’m being unfair to our junior brother?"

"Hmm?" Yan Yinqing thought for a while. "Our junior brother has so many women by his side, so I think your actions aren’t unfair to him but rather unfair to yourself. Are you sure you want to be his woman? If you truly wanted to be with him, you would have to share him with many other women, which you might find difficult to accept.

"You’re right." Jing Qiuyue lowered her head, feeling conflicted. "To be honest, I have never had feelings for our junior brothers, and those feelings will probably never arise in my heart. To me, Qiao Liangren is everything, and I’m not sure I can remove her from my heart."

Yan Yinqing hugged Jing Qiuyue. "I can’t say anything about your feelings because I’ve never experienced anything like this, but I hope you consider everything carefully before making a decision, or you’ll regret it if you make the wrong choice. Our junior brother does have many women by his side, but I can see that he loves them all. You may eventually develop feelings for him, but I doubt it because your love for Qiao Liangren is too strong, so you should think it over carefully."
"I know."

Zhang Fei [5] and Shang Xueli had already finished dual soul cultivation, and both of them were completely satisfied with the results, even though the improvements to their souls were not yet very significant.

Shang Xueli said to him. "Although we’ve only been cultivating our souls for a short time, I feel my soul power has increased quite significantly, and I think it’s because of the help from your soul power. If I continue to cultivate my soul with you, my soul power will probably increase significantly after a few more sessions."

"I also feel the results are quite significant, even though we only did soul cultivation for a short time." Zhang Fei [5] returned his soul into his body, followed by Shang Xuenyi. He took out the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror and observed it. "Hun Lingwu is an idiot! This mirror has great benefits for cultivating their souls, but he only uses its external effect to influence women, and he didn’t utilize its main effect. Unfortunately, I have so many women by my side, and I can only use this mirror when I’m dual cultivating with one of them, so it will take me a long time to do it with all of them."
Shang Xueli nodded in understanding. "Are you going back out now?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] saved the mirror in the system’s inventory. "I have to take care of some things outside, so I’ll be heading out now, and you can enjoy yourself in this pavilion."
"Alright." Shang Xueli sighed softly after Zhang Fei [5] left, and she hugged her knees. "Mother, I really miss you, and I want to see you again."

chapters.title: Chapter 1400: The Moon Flame’s Fragment
paragraphs: [Daily quest I: Absorb 10,000,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1000 purple jewels.]
[Daily Quest II: Absorb 10,000,000 demon essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade demon cores.]
[Daily Quest III: Absorb 10,000,000 beast essence.]
[Reward: 1000 advanced-grade beast cores.]
[Daily Quest IV: Killing 1000 beasts/demon beasts in the Celestial Lord or above.]
[Reward: Celestial daily pack x1]
The notifications appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [5] left the training space, but he immediately entered his soul world to help Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang recover their soul power.

Zhang Fei [5] was amazed by the changes in his soul world because Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang had worked so hard to help him improve it, but he quickly ignored it and went to see Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang, where he helped them recover their soul power.

Yin Ling, the spirit of the Moon Flame, hovered by their side. She was satisfied that her master’s soul was getting stronger every day, especially after Zhang Fei [5] helped her improve her soul power for half a year.
If Zhang Fei [5] continued to help Yin Yue, Yin Ling was confident that her master’s soul would become truly powerful, and she could reshape her body soon.

After thinking about it for a while, Yin Ling went to the location of the Moon Flame and took a fragment of it. She brought it back to their place and shot the fragment into Zhang Fei [5]’s body, which allowed him to gain the power of the fire.
[The host obtained the Moon Flame. Fire count: 8.]
[The host’s fire strength has increased by 800%.]

Zhang Fei [5] was taken aback for a moment by the appearance of the notification, but then he smiled happily because his collection of Ten Heavenly Flames was only two short, the Sun Flame and the Chaos Flame.

Zhang Fei [5] knew the location of the Sun Flame, but he still had to help Tian Taiyang reshape his body, especially since he could bring him to the Zenith Solar Sanctum without having to wait for the portal to open for a thousand years.

As for the Chaos Flame, Zhang Fei [5] had no information on its whereabouts, but he was certain Feng Yao knew something about it and its location. He was confident she could take him there, but he needed the Sun Flame before he could retrieve the Chaos Flame.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately ignored that, and he completely focused on helping Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang to recover their souls.

Yin Ling floated beside them, observing Zhang Fei [5]. No one knew what was going through her mind because it was impossible to guess her thoughts. She smiled faintly, thinking about something, and her smile widened as she made up her mind about him.
Meanwhile, Hun Lingwu had just arrived at the Stygian Dusk Domain, and he immediately flew to the palace in the domain to meet someone.
When Hun Lingwu arrived there, no one dared to take his place, and they seemed afraid of him, causing him to snort coldly.
Hun Lingwu immediately entered the place and made his way to the main room, where Linghu Minghua was concentrating on healing from his injuries.
"Hmm?" Linghu Minghua immediately opened his eyes and asked him. "What brings you to my place, old man?"
Hun Lingwu asked him back. "When did you get injured? Who injured you? How serious was your injury?"
"Sigh." Linghu Minghua sighed heavily. "The person who injured me was Jia Xianzu, and I sustained my injury half a year ago, from which I haven’t fully recovered to this day."
Hun Lingwu raised an eyebrow, as he knew the name. "Didn’t Jia Xianzu disappear long ago? How could he suddenly reappear?"

"You’re wrong about that, and he never disappeared." Hun Lingwu raised an eyebrow at Linghu Minghua, prompting him to tell the truth. "At that time, I chased Huang Xiaoyi to the Falling Star Domain, but I encountered Jia Xianzu there. He never disappeared, and he was hiding inside that tower using another identity for so many years, Wan Jiang. While I was waiting for her to come out of that tower with Xing Haoran, he attacked both of us, and he injured me seriously."
"Then?"
Linghu Minghua let out a heavy sigh. "I managed to escape from Jia Xianzu back then, but he managed to capture Xing Haoran, and the Xing Clan is now in ruins after Long Wuzhao attacked them."

"Hmm?" Hun Lingwu didn’t immediately believe Linghu Minghua, and he contacted his acquaintances in the Falling Star Domain, asking them about the Xing Clan. They informed him that Long Wuzhao had destroyed the clan, a revelation that completely shocked him. "Do you know the person who was with Huang Xiaoyi at that time?"

Linghu Minghua nodded at him. "According to Xing Haoran’s story, Zhang Fei caused a commotion in the Moon Illusion Domain during his breakthrough to the Five Celestial Realm, and many people witnessed the phenomenon on that day. Still, according to his story, he joined the Moonlit Passion Temple and became an elder of that sect. Additionally, I received information that he is the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, especially after he married Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi’s sole daughter."

"Hmm." Hun Lingwu frowned and took out some pills, handing them to Linghu Minghua. However, he didn’t mention Zhang Fei’s relationship with Feng Yao. "For now, I want you to recover from your injuries immediately, and you must help me capture that brat no matter what, especially since he stole something from me."

"Haha." Linghu Minghua immediately accepted the pills and swallowed them. "Although your pills are very effective, I still need time to recover from my injuries. At the very least, I need a month to fully recover, and I will immediately attack that sect once I recover."
"Good." Hun Lingwu left the place to search for other people, especially since he doubted that Linghu Minghua was capable of carrying out his task.
"Hahaha." Linghu Minghua laughed loudly. "Huang Xiaoyi and Luo Fenghan, I will destroy you both after I recover, and you will both end up miserable in my hands."
Hun Lingwu didn’t leave the domain immediately, instead going to another palace to meet someone. Just like at Linghu Minghua’s palace, no one dared to stop him, and he casually walked inside.
Hun Lingwu soon reached the throne room, where a young woman lay on an array of spiderwebs.
"Hmm? What brings you to my palace, Hun Lingwu?" The young woman asked him.

The woman has a mature and serious face. Her eyes were almond-shaped, with a pierced purple-pink gaze. Her eyebrows were slim and delicately arched. Her nose was narrow. Her lips were full but naturally shaped. Her lavender hair was long and straight, flowing well past her waist. She has a tall, slender, and delicate figure, with black tattoos running down her arms. She wore a sleek, form-fitting black dress. Her sleeveless dress highlighted her neckline and shoulders, and the lower part of her dress formed a long, flowing skirt.

"Xuan Meiyun, I need you to capture someone for me, especially since he has stolen something important from me. After you successfully capture him, you can use him for your cultivation furnace, and I will not stop you." The woman raised an eyebrow at Hun Lingwu, who immediately created qi screens, showing Zhang Fei’s image.
Xuan Meiyun’s expression immediately changed, and she stared at Zhang Fei’s image while licking her lips. "What is that man’s name? Which sect is he from?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is an elder of the Moonlit Passion Sect." Xuan Meiyun raised an eyebrow at Hun Lingwu. "Someone is watching me closely, so I can’t do it myself. I don’t need him, and I just need my artifact back. That’s why I came here to ask for your help, and you can have him after you capture him."

"Haha." Xuan Meiyun laughed at that. "Zhang Fei is indeed handsome, and I am happy to have him. However, I will not help you for free, and you must compensate me with your pills, especially the ones to help my subordinates break through."

Hun Lingwu gritted his teeth in annoyance, but he immediately took out several bottles of pills and showed them to the woman. "I’ll give you these pills after you successfully capture him, and you can use them to help your subordinates break through."

"Fine with me." Xuan Meiyun nodded in agreement. "Once I successfully capture him, I’ll send one of my subordinates to inform you. At that time, you can come to my palace again and bring the pills, and I’ll trade him for them."
"Sure." After that, Hun Lingwu immediately left the palace, and he returned to his domain.
"Ning Huayin."
"I’m here." The young female demon appeared.

"You’ve heard the old man’s words, right?" Ning Huayin nodded at Xuan Meiyun. "I want you to go to the Moonlit Passion Sect and find out information about Zhang Fei. You can report everything to me, so I can think of a way to capture him."
"Yes." Ning Huayin immediately left the palace and went to the Moonlit Passion Sect.

Xuan Meiyun climbed down from the spiderweb and sat on her throne. "Zhang Fei is definitely no ordinary man; otherwise, Hun Lingwu would have captured him himself. That old man is truly cunning, and he doesn’t hesitate to sacrifice others to achieve his goals, so I must be careful in my actions regarding this matter."

The notifications appeared as soon as Zhang Fei [5] left the training space, but he immediately entered his soul world to help Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang recover their soul power.

Zhang Fei [5] was amazed by the changes in his soul world because Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang had worked so hard to help him improve it, but he quickly ignored it and went to see Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang, where he helped them recover their soul power.
Yin Ling, the spirit of the Moon Flame, hovered by their side.
She was satisfied that her master’s soul was getting stronger every day, especially after Zhang Fei [5] helped her improve her soul power for half a year.
If Zhang Fei [5] continued to help Yin Yue, Yin Ling was confident that her master’s soul would become truly powerful, and she could reshape her body soon.
After thinking about it for a while, Yin Ling went to the location of the Moon Flame and took a fragment of it.
She brought it back to their place and shot the fragment into Zhang Fei [5]’s body, which allowed him to gain the power of the fire.

Zhang Fei [5] was taken aback for a moment by the appearance of the notification, but then he smiled happily because his collection of Ten Heavenly Flames was only two short, the Sun Flame and the Chaos Flame.

Zhang Fei [5] knew the location of the Sun Flame, but he still had to help Tian Taiyang reshape his body, especially since he could bring him to the Zenith Solar Sanctum without having to wait for the portal to open for a thousand years.
As for the Chaos Flame, Zhang Fei [5] had no information on its whereabouts, but he was certain Feng Yao knew something about it and its location.
He was confident she could take him there, but he needed the Sun Flame before he could retrieve the Chaos Flame.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately ignored that, and he completely focused on helping Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang to recover their souls.
Yin Ling floated beside them, observing Zhang Fei [5].
No one knew what was going through her mind because it was impossible to guess her thoughts.
She smiled faintly, thinking about something, and her smile widened as she made up her mind about him.
Meanwhile, Hun Lingwu had just arrived at the Stygian Dusk Domain, and he immediately flew to the palace in the domain to meet someone.
When Hun Lingwu arrived there, no one dared to take his place, and they seemed afraid of him, causing him to snort coldly.
Hun Lingwu immediately entered the place and made his way to the main room, where Linghu Minghua was concentrating on healing from his injuries.
"Hmm?" Linghu Minghua immediately opened his eyes and asked him.
"What brings you to my place, old man?"
Hun Lingwu asked him back.
"When did you get injured?
Who injured you?
How serious was your injury?"
"Sigh." Linghu Minghua sighed heavily.
"The person who injured me was Jia Xianzu, and I sustained my injury half a year ago, from which I haven’t fully recovered to this day."
Hun Lingwu raised an eyebrow, as he knew the name.
"Didn’t Jia Xianzu disappear long ago?
How could he suddenly reappear?"
"You’re wrong about that, and he never disappeared." Hun Lingwu raised an eyebrow at Linghu Minghua, prompting him to tell the truth.
"At that time, I chased Huang Xiaoyi to the Falling Star Domain, but I encountered Jia Xianzu there.
He never disappeared, and he was hiding inside that tower using another identity for so many years, Wan Jiang.
While I was waiting for her to come out of that tower with Xing Haoran, he attacked both of us, and he injured me seriously."
"Then?"
Linghu Minghua let out a heavy sigh.
"I managed to escape from Jia Xianzu back then, but he managed to capture Xing Haoran, and the Xing Clan is now in ruins after Long Wuzhao attacked them."
"Hmm?" Hun Lingwu didn’t immediately believe Linghu Minghua, and he contacted his acquaintances in the Falling Star Domain, asking them about the Xing Clan.
They informed him that Long Wuzhao had destroyed the clan, a revelation that completely shocked him.
"Do you know the person who was with Huang Xiaoyi at that time?"
Linghu Minghua nodded at him.
"According to Xing Haoran’s story, Zhang Fei caused a commotion in the Moon Illusion Domain during his breakthrough to the Five Celestial Realm, and many people witnessed the phenomenon on that day.
Still, according to his story, he joined the Moonlit Passion Temple and became an elder of that sect.
Additionally, I received information that he is the son-in-law of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, especially after he married Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi’s sole daughter."
"Hmm." Hun Lingwu frowned and took out some pills, handing them to Linghu Minghua.
However, he didn’t mention Zhang Fei’s relationship with Feng Yao.
"For now, I want you to recover from your injuries immediately, and you must help me capture that brat no matter what, especially since he stole something from me."
"Haha." Linghu Minghua immediately accepted the pills and swallowed them.
"Although your pills are very effective, I still need time to recover from my injuries.
At the very least, I need a month to fully recover, and I will immediately attack that sect once I recover."
"Good." Hun Lingwu left the place to search for other people, especially since he doubted that Linghu Minghua was capable of carrying out his task.
"Hahaha." Linghu Minghua laughed loudly.
"Huang Xiaoyi and Luo Fenghan, I will destroy you both after I recover, and you will both end up miserable in my hands."
Hun Lingwu didn’t leave the domain immediately, instead going to another palace to meet someone.
Just like at Linghu Minghua’s palace, no one dared to stop him, and he casually walked inside.
Hun Lingwu soon reached the throne room, where a young woman lay on an array of spiderwebs.
"Hmm?
What brings you to my palace, Hun Lingwu?" The young woman asked him.
The woman has a mature and serious face.
Her eyes were almond-shaped, with a pierced purple-pink gaze.
Her eyebrows were slim and delicately arched.
Her nose was narrow.
Her lips were full but naturally shaped.
Her lavender hair was long and straight, flowing well past her waist.
She has a tall, slender, and delicate figure, with black tattoos running down her arms.
She wore a sleek, form-fitting black dress.
Her sleeveless dress highlighted her neckline and shoulders, and the lower part of her dress formed a long, flowing skirt.
"Xuan Meiyun, I need you to capture someone for me, especially since he has stolen something important from me.

After you successfully capture him, you can use him for your cultivation furnace, and I will not stop you." The woman raised an eyebrow at Hun Lingwu, who immediately created qi screens, showing Zhang Fei’s image.
Xuan Meiyun’s expression immediately changed, and she stared at Zhang Fei’s image while licking her lips.
"What is that man’s name?
Which sect is he from?"
"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is an elder of the Moonlit Passion Sect." Xuan Meiyun raised an eyebrow at Hun Lingwu.
"Someone is watching me closely, so I can’t do it myself.
I don’t need him, and I just need my artifact back.
That’s why I came here to ask for your help, and you can have him after you capture him."
"Haha." Xuan Meiyun laughed at that.
"Zhang Fei is indeed handsome, and I am happy to have him.
However, I will not help you for free, and you must compensate me with your pills, especially the ones to help my subordinates break through."
Hun Lingwu gritted his teeth in annoyance, but he immediately took out several bottles of pills and showed them to the woman.
"I’ll give you these pills after you successfully capture him, and you can use them to help your subordinates break through."
"Fine with me." Xuan Meiyun nodded in agreement.
"Once I successfully capture him, I’ll send one of my subordinates to inform you.
At that time, you can come to my palace again and bring the pills, and I’ll trade him for them."
"Sure." After that, Hun Lingwu immediately left the palace, and he returned to his domain.
"Ning Huayin."
"I’m here." The young female demon appeared.
"You’ve heard the old man’s words, right?" Ning Huayin nodded at Xuan Meiyun.
"I want you to go to the Moonlit Passion Sect and find out information about Zhang Fei.
You can report everything to me, so I can think of a way to capture him."
"Yes." Ning Huayin immediately left the palace and went to the Moonlit Passion Sect.
Xuan Meiyun climbed down from the spiderweb and sat on her throne.
"Zhang Fei is definitely no ordinary man; otherwise, Hun Lingwu would have captured him himself.
That old man is truly cunning, and he doesn’t hesitate to sacrifice others to achieve his goals, so I must be careful in my actions regarding this matter."
